title: Assistant Director - UIC Extended Campus
description: UIC is seeking a Program Student Advisor (Assistant Director) to join our UIC Extended Campus department. This position is involved in all aspects of program development and delivery for UIC Extended Campus's portfolio of fully online market-driven degree and other non-degree offerings that operate on a full cost recovery basis and depend upon a full complement of "high touch" support services to ensure that students complete their degree programs in a timely manner. Responsible for program planning and development, enrollment growth, data analysis and student retention. Duties Responsibilities: Student Advising and Retention Act as the primary advocate and liaison for UIC EC’s students supporting them in all areas of their university experience and help ensure their academic success and timely graduation with emphasis on retention, customer service, and student advisement. Create regular student communications and manage all correspondence including communication about program requirements, deadlines, registration, graduation, etc. Planning and New Program Development Serve as primary program contact for academic unit partners. Work closely with these partners in all phases of program planning and delivery. Identify new courses/ workshops and educational events. Work with EC staff and college partners to ensure program financial viability; assist in the identification of annual program goals and strategies to accomplish those goals. Work with Associate Directors to conduct market research and develop business plans for new programs in collaboration with EC/ OVCI staff and other stakeholders. Program Evaluation/Data Analysis Evaluate effectiveness of individual courses and overall programs. Make recommendations for improvements, based on industry trends and/or data analytics, and coordinate with college partners on course and curricula revision. Develop course schedules consistent with approved courses, course sequencing, and credit hours as determined by college partners. Review and revise catalog information, EC websites and other program collateral. Represent UIC Extended Campus on University, campus, and departmental committees/teams, as appropriate. Perform other related duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

title: Service Technician (C Technician)
description:

The right candidate will have a strong service technician background, hold Ford certifciations and will be eager to work alongside team members on a broad spectrum of repairs. The day-to-day duties include performing work on specific repair orders and diagnosing what repairs need to be done, troubleshooting higher level repairs with the team lead, ordering parts, maintaining a cleanly work area, and retaining all required Ford certifications appropriate for the positon.

  • Growth opportunities

Job Description:

DEVOPS ENGINEER PRINCIPAL

GDIT is looking for a Engineer – AWS (DevSecOps Champion) a senior technical role supporting DOJ Homeland Security Task Force (HSTF) / National Coordination Center (NCC). This role leads secure CI/CD and DevSecOps practices for AWS-based solutions, designing and governing pipelines and automation that embed security, compliance, and risk management into the delivery lifecycle for mission‑critical systems.

Responsibilities

  • Define and enforce secure CI/CD and DevSecOps standards, patterns, and guardrails for AWS-hosted applications, in alignment with GDIT Cyber Security Policy, Cyber Security Handbook, and Cloud/Security standards.
  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) with integrated security scanning, compliance checks, approvals, and testing.
  • Lead infrastructure‑as‑code (IaC) implementations (CloudFormation, Terraform) with embedded security and configuration baselines, supporting secure provisioning of AWS environments.
  • Automate secure environment provisioning, configuration, and deployments across development, test, and production AWS accounts, in line with cyber and IT risk management requirements.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (CloudWatch, CloudTrail, centralized logging) to support secure, observable, and auditable delivery pipelines.
  • Integrate identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and compliance controls into CI/CD workflows as part of DevSecOps practices.
  • Ensure CI/CD pipelines and AWS solutions comply with applicable contractual and regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST 800‑53/171, CMMC, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) and internal cyber standards.
  • Collaborate with application development, cloud platform, cyber security, IT risk, and operations teams to ensure architectures are “DevSecOps-ready” and align with secure development standards.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, and documentation for project teams adopting DevSecOps and secure CI/CD practices; develop reusable secure pipeline templates and patterns.
  • Support proposals, technical reviews, and risk assessments where secure CI/CD, cloud security, and DevSecOps capabilities are required, including input to labor category mapping and staffing.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Cyber Security, or related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 8+ years of relevant IT experience, with significant experience in DevOps/DevSecOps and CI/CD for production systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch/CloudTrail) in security‑sensitive or regulated environments.
  • Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using one or more modern platforms (AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Strong experience with infrastructure‑as‑code (e.g. CloudFormation, Terraform) and secure configuration management and automation.
  • Demonstrated experience promoting signed builds into an air-gapped, classified, or otherwise network-isolated target environment, including artifact transfer procedures and post-deployment verification.
  • Experience with containers and orchestration (e.g. Docker, ECS, EKS, Kubernetes) including security aspects (image scanning, runtime security, least privilege).
  • Demonstrated experience integrating security testing, vulnerability scanning, and compliance checks into CI/CD workflows (DevSecOps).
  • Experience working under formal security and risk frameworks (e.g., NIST 800‑53/171, CMMC, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, customer‑specific cyber requirements).
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with ability to work across cyber, risk, engineering, and program management teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect).
  • Security/DevSecOps certifications.
  • Experience supporting or implementing secure cloud architectures.
  • Experience in enterprise DevSecOps or security transformation initiatives, or in a cloud/cyber center of excellence.
  • Experience with multi‑account AWS Organizations, landing zones, and centralized security/governance services.

Explore a career in software development at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your dedication to advancing innovation.

title: Technical Consultant – Shift Lead (Devices Tenant Migration)
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

The Role:
As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) within the Devices Factory, you will serve as the on‑shift technical authority for high‑volume device migrations between Microsoft 365 tenants for a global multi‑entity enterprise. You will lead execution across a 24x7 factory model, coordinating repeatable, runbook‑driven waves of Windows 10/11 device transition, Intune/Endpoint Manager re‑enrolment patterns and Autopilot/Entra join-state activities. You will be accountable for shift readiness (tooling, access, queues), quality gates, evidence capture and rapid issue resolution so that device migrations are delivered safely, predictably and at programme scale. This is a hands‑on leadership role: you will still troubleshoot complex device migration failures, but your primary success measure is consistent throughput with low rework and disciplined shift operations.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
- Own shift‑level triage for device migration failures (Autopilot registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
- Validate pre‑req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Autopilot profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce “go/no‑go” criteria.
- Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Autopilot where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re‑registration timing, end‑user reset/re‑provision coordination).
- Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; prioritise work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
- Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
- Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three‑shift model.
- Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
- Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Autopilot/Intune escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
- Lead post‑migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.


Who You Are

Must‑Have (or equivalent experience):
- Delivered at least one production tenant‑to‑tenant device migration as a technical lead/SME, specifically covering Windows device transition and endpoint management between tenants.
- Strong hands‑on expertise with Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11 provisioning, device compliance policies, configuration profiles and troubleshooting enrolment failures.
- Hands‑on experience with Windows Autopilot (device registration concepts, profile assignment, re‑provisioning) and practical migration sequencing across tenants.
- Competence in Microsoft Entra ID device identity/join states (Entra joined / hybrid joined / registered concepts) and how these affect access, compliance and conditional access behaviour.
- Demonstrated ability to operate in a runbook‑first factory model: strict execution steps, peer checking/quality gates and disciplined closure criteria.
- Proven experience working shift-based delivery with mandatory handovers, queue management and accountability for shift outcomes in a 24x7 environment.
- Strong PowerShell and automation capability for device readiness and operational scripting (inventory validation, hash collection, reporting, bulk actions), with safe change practices.
- Strong documentation discipline: ability to produce and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks and evidence packs per migration wave.

Good‑to‑Have:
- Experience using profile preservation / workstation migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) to reduce user disruption and post‑cutover issues.
- Familiarity with Microsoft security controls impacting devices (Conditional Access trust settings, compliant/hybrid joined trust, device-based access patterns).
- Relevant Microsoft certifications (examples: MD‑102, MS‑102, SC‑300 or equivalent).
- Experience supporting global migrations with remote user populations and proactive comms/coordination playbooks.
- ITIL practice awareness (incident/problem/change flow) or equivalent operational governance background.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills:
- Leads with calm operational control under pressure; sets the tone for disciplined factory execution and avoids “heroics” that compromise repeatability.
- Communicates clearly in shift handovers: concise status, crisp risk articulation, unambiguous next actions.
- Coaches engineers in-flight (without slowing throughput), raising capability by reinforcing patterns, not ad‑hoc fixes.
- Confident challenging readiness gaps (“not ready to migrate”) using evidence and agreed criteria.
- Builds trust quickly with cross‑functional teams (Identity, Security, Shared Data, Service Desk/hypercare) to remove blockers.
- Demonstrates ownership: takes problems to closure, documents learning and drives runbook improvements.
- Works effectively across cultures and time zones; assumes positive intent and maintains high standards.
- Treats the client environment with professional discipline: secure handling of access, data and evidence artefacts.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs:
- Throughput: devices migrated per shift / per wave vs plan.
- Quality: first‑time success rate and defect/rework rate (failed enrolments, repeat tickets).
- MTTR: mean time to restore/resolve for migration‑blocking device issues.
- Evidence capture completeness: percentage of migrations with full log/audit package attached.
- SLA adherence: on‑time completion of scheduled waves and timely escalation of blockers.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes:
- This role operates within a three‑shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
Job Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Solutions Architect to join our DoD Enterprise IT Modernization (DEIM) team supporting a large-scale digital modernization program critical to the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) and DoD Fourth Estate agencies. The Principal Solutions Architect works closely with Leidos and Government technical leadership to drive innovation, growth, and efficiency across the portfolio.

Clearance: Active DoD Secret clearance required. U.S. Citizen required.

**100% Remote Work - Candidate must be willing to travel to our Reston, VA headquarters on an as-needed basis for key meetings and events**

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support the DEIM Chief Engineer in identifying service gaps and improvement areas, and drive continual innovation to evolve DoDNet against current and future requirements.

  • Identify and assess opportunities to improve DEIM, then lead the analysis of alternatives and proof-of-concept development that establishes dedicated projects to implement approved improvements. Target areas include:

  • Standardizing, automating, and streamlining site surveys and migrations so they are repeatable, flexible, and efficient.

  • Expanding automation to reduce staffing demand, lower the risk of human error, and free staff for higher-complexity work.

  • Establishing open design principles that avoid vendor lock-in and minimize custom configuration.

  • Incorporating emerging technologies that strengthen cybersecurity, reduce total cost, and improve the end-user experience.

  • Partner with project teams to keep execution aligned to the intent of each approved improvement.

  • Conduct initial feasibility assessments of candidate initiatives, followed by detailed analysis of alternatives.

  • Document and present analysis results to Leidos and Government stakeholders through the engineering review boards.

  • Oversee proofs of concept, narrowly scoped efforts of three months or less that deliver demonstrable, measurable insight into a candidate improvement.

  • Draft detailed project plans covering technical approach, cost, schedule, and risk for full implementation.

Basic Qualifications:

  • BS degree and 12+ years of relevant experience in enterprise infrastructure and solutions architecture, including cloud and on-premise virtualized environments. Specific experience, education and training may be considered in lieu of degree

  • 8+ years architecting enterprise workloads on AWS or Azure, including architecture, deployment, and optimization of enterprise workloads.

  • Active DoD Secret clearance required.

  • Active DoD 8570 IAT Level II certification (CompTIA Security+ ce or equivalent) required at time of hire.

  • Experience designing secure, scalable, and resilient on-premise and cloud-based virtualized infrastructures.

Demonstrated ability to:

  • Design secure, scalable, and resilient on-premise and cloud-based virtualized infrastructures.

  • Lead the planning and execution of enterprise application and infrastructure migrations, including on-premise to cloud transitions.

  • Automate infrastructure and operational tasks with Python or PowerShell in a production environment.

  • Architect and manage enterprise identity and directory services at scale, including Entra ID and LDAP.

  • Work across enterprise network infrastructure, including Cisco and Aruba technologies, with network access control using Cisco ISE or Aruba ClearPass.

  • Produce architecture artifacts and present designs to both executive leadership and technical review boards.

  • Drive analysis of alternatives to evaluate and recommend technologies against performance, scalability, security, and cost criteria.

  • Operate in a DevSecOps environment of comparable scale and complexity.

  • Communicate effectively, in writing and verbally, across all levels of an organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining IT infrastructures for DISA or other DoD organizations.

  • Hands-on experience with Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM).

  • DoD 8570 IASAE Level II or higher certification.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and modern automation tooling in a regulated environment.

description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. Job Description:

We’re seeking a Product Management Analyst with deep, hands-on experience in data analytics, data governance, and data engineering, who can drive value from enterprise data platforms through disciplined Product Ownership and Agile delivery. You’ll own the backlog, translate complex data needs into actionable user stories, partner closely with engineering, and use SQL to validate data, troubleshoot issues, and inform decisions. Experience with Collibra and data quality frameworks is a strong plus.

*This is a remote position, but a preference for candidates in the DMV area*

Product Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for data products (datasets, pipelines, quality rules, and dashboards), ensuring alignment to business outcomes and compliance needs

  • Convert stakeholders’ requirements into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria; maintain a transparent, prioritized backlog.

  • Define measurable product metrics (adoption, data quality scores, SLA compliance, performance) and track value realization.

Agile Delivery (Scrum)

  • Run Scrum ceremonies: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Partner with Scrum Master and Technical Leads to remove impediments, manage scope, and keep delivery predictable.
  • Champion Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, ensuring data products meet quality, governance, and performance standards.

Data Analysis & SQL

  • Write and review SQL to validate datasets across environments;
  • Collaborate with analysts and data scientists to define KPIs, analytical features, and insight-driven use cases.

Data Governance & Collibra

  • Partner with Governance to establish stewardship workflows, standards, naming conventions, certification processes, and data issue resolution.
  • Use Data Catalog (Collibra or similar) to manage metadata, lineage, and data quality rules/scorecards; drive onboarding of governed datasets and monitor quality thresholds

Data Engineering Partnership

  • Work side-by-side with data engineers on ingestion, transformation, and orchestration patterns; ensure scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Provide clear requirements for schema design, partitioning, indexing, and performance optimization; validate outcomes via SQL and acceptance tests

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Lead discovery workshops; synthesize diverse viewpoints into consensus on priorities and release plans.
  • Create crisp artifacts: data dictionaries, business rules, lineage diagrams, workflow maps, and release notes; present progress and insights to business and leadership

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years as a Product Management delivering data-centric products (analytics, governance, engineering)
  • SQL proficiency
  • Proven ability to run Scrum end-to-end and translate complex requirements into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to present to clients and collaborate across engineering, governance, and business teams

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with Collibra or another Data Catalog tool (metadata, lineage, stewardship, DQ rules and scorecards
  • Exposure to modern data stacks (e.g., AWS/Azure, data lake/warehouse, orchestration tools), and working with data engineers, architects, and analysts
  • Background supporting federal, healthcare, or enterprise-scale data programs

The Associate Substation Protection and Controls Engineer will work under the direct supervision of an experienced licensed professional engineer and is expected to develop skills in the field of substation engineering and the ability to work with greater independence.

Responsibilities:

In this role the qualified individual will be expected to:

  • Assist project teams with Protection and Control design on utility substation engineering projects.
  • Perform basic engineering calculations to support engineering design.
  • Follow the established Quality Control Plan while completing assignments.
  • Assist with the preparation of project deliverables including but not limited to engineered drawings, technical reports, project-related correspondence and miscellaneous project documentation.
  • Collaborate with other substation engineering disciplines as required.
  • Assist the team with the development of processes and procedures to improve project execution efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records and files and a high level of organization.
  • Take opportunities to improve technical knowledge and understanding of the work.
  • Support Leidos’ goals and represent the company positively and professionally.

  • B.S. or M.S. degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university
  • 0 – 2 +years of prior relevant experience in utility substation engineering with a B.S. degree
  • 0 – 1 + years of prior relevant experience in utility substation engineering with a M.S. degree
  • Basic understanding of the utility grid (power generation, transmission and distribution) system
  • Solid understanding of the basic principles of electric power
  • Keen focus of quality and an appreciation for high quality deliverables
  • Strong attention to details
  • Understanding of basic engineering theories and principles
  • Understanding of basic practices of researching engineering and design issues, evaluating alternatives, making sound recommendations and preparing and presenting recommendations
  • Ability to meet deadlines under high pressure situations
  • Team player who can work effectively in team environment with an ability to deal with a variety of individuals from various socio-economic, cultural and ethnic backgrounds
  • Ability to multitask on assignments while maintaining schedule
  • Proactive communication with strong written and oral communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • High level of computer and internet competency
  • Proficiency with using Windows-based software programs

Desired Qualifications:

  • Major emphasis in Power Systems Design and Engineering
  • Received a passing grade on the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) Exam
  • Prior relevant experience in electric power engineering
  • Active membership in national engineering societies (IEEE, PES, etc.)

title: Associate Director, Clinical Science
description:
At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:

The Associate Director of Clinical Science plays a supportive role in clinical development of RazyeBio radiopharmaceuticals for oncology indications. Working in collaboration with clinical development, the position is responsible for various aspects of ongoing clinical trial program-related activities within the relevant therapeutic area. These activities include, but are not limited to, collaboration on functional area activities during program implementation, clinical study start-up/execution/close out, data analysis/reporting, and potentially support of NDA/MAA filings.

Job Responsibilities

  • Acquires and utilizes knowledge of clinical trial design to develop or oversee development of specific study concept synopses and protocols.

  • Participates in protocol review discussions concerning scientific and procedural aspects of study design.

  • In collaboration with Medical Writing and Clinical Operations, prepares study protocols, amendments, specific sections of study manuals and Investigator meeting materials, and other documents as needed with appropriate guidance and supervision.

  • Contributes to the design, development, and review of CRFs, Data Management Manuals, and Data Analysis Plans.

  • Reviews ongoing clinical data.

  • Organizes and oversees Data Review Committee meetings, including preparation of slides and other review and meeting materials.

  • With MD supervision, addresses questions regarding scientific and related procedural issues from Investigators.

  • Contributes to the preparation and/or review of data listings, summary tables, study results, manuscripts, and scientific presentations.

  • Assists in the preparation/review of INDs, regulatory documents, IND annual report/DSURs, Investigator Brochures, and NDAs/MAAs.

  • Supports priorities within functional area.

  • Anticipates moderately complex obstacles within a clinical study and, with guidance, implements solutions.

  • May be asked to coordinate teams and provide direction.

  • May lead two or more specific components of departmental strategic initiatives.

  • Able to enter a new therapeutic area and summarize scientific information that is available in published literature to integrate into new study development.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and interpersonal skills are required to maintain working relationship with team members to ensure scientific integrity of clinical studies.

  • May be sought out for advice by others within the company to help make better decisions and resolve moderately complex problems.

  • 20% of travel required

Qualifications

  • MS with a 6+ years of relevant drug development experience OR BS in Biological Sciences, health care, or a related field with 8+ years of relevant drug development experience

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in clinical research or clinical pharmacology in a biotech/pharmaceutical company or contract research organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PharmD or PhD preferred

Skills and Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to be a fast learner.

  • Demonstrated ability to be flexible and adaptable to change, to move between projects easily and provide support/expertise where needed.

  • Ability to apply AI to improve team execution and decision‑making

  • Experienced with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) as well as job-related programs such as SpotFire.

  • Knowledge of FDA, EMA and ICH regulations and guidelines a must.

  • Ability to effectively collaborate cross-functionally, across all levels of the organization.

title: Director - INNOPAY - Germany
description:
Company:

Oliver Wyman

Description:

What if your next consulting role gave you the opportunity not just to lead projects, but to help build a business?

INNOPAY is a specialist consultancy focused on the rapidly evolving world of digital transactions. We combine deep expertise in payments, digital identity and data sharing with an entrepreneurial way of working — and, as part of Oliver Wyman, the reach, relationships and opportunities of a global consulting firm.

We’re looking for a Director to help lead and grow our INNOPAY team in Germany.

This is a distinctive opportunity for an experienced payments consultant who wants to combine client delivery and commercial impact with team leadership, helping shape the next chapter of our business in the DACH market.

Why Join Us

  • Build something. This isn't simply another senior project delivery role. You’ll have the opportunity to help grow INNOPAY in Germany, develop our people, strengthen our client relationships and shape how our specialist business evolves.

  • Get the best of two worlds. Bring the agility, specialist expertise and entrepreneurial culture of INNOPAY together with Oliver Wyman’s global footprint, senior relationships and broader capabilities.

  • Work at the forefront of digital transactions. Help clients navigate the opportunities emerging across payments, Open Finance, digital identity, data sharing and ecosystem-based business models.

  • Have real leadership impact. Become a senior point of contact and management team member for our growing specialist team in Frankfurt, creating an environment where people can perform, develop and thrive.

  • Grow your commercial platform. Work alongside INNOPAY and Oliver Wyman senior leaders to originate opportunities, deepen client relationships and build your own network and market presence.

Meet The Team

INNOPAY has been specialising in digital transactions since 2002. With roots in payment innovation — including co-creating Dutch payment solution iDEAL — we have grown our expertise into digital identity and data sharing, working across strategy, proposition development and execution.

Today, INNOPAY is part of Oliver Wyman, giving our specialist teams access to a much broader international network of expertise, clients and senior relationships while retaining what makes INNOPAY distinctive.

You’ll be an important senior presence for our Frankfurt-based INNOPAY team, working closely with colleagues in the Netherlands and across Oliver Wyman.

On client engagements, you’ll typically lead multidisciplinary teams of 2–5 consultants, bringing together strategic, commercial, operational and technical perspectives.

How This Role Will Contribute To Team Success

You’ll help us achieve three things:

  • Grow our business in Germany. Partner with INNOPAY and Oliver Wyman leaders to turn client relationships and market opportunities into impactful work, while developing your own network

  • Lead exceptional consulting. Bring the judgement and consulting craft to take complex client problems from initial conversation through proposal, project delivery and lasting client impact

  • Build our team and capabilities. Be a visible leader for our people in Frankfurt, helping grow the team, develop colleagues and strengthen INNOPAY’s propositions and expertise.

Your Day-To-Day

No two weeks will look quite the same, but you can expect to:

  • Advise senior clients on digital strategy and transformation across areas including payments, Open Finance, digital identity, data sharing and related digital ecosystems.

  • Lead engagements end-to-end, from shaping the initial client problem and proposal through to managing the client relationship, leading the team and delivering the work.

  • Turn complexity into action, translating strategic, commercial, operational, regulatory and technical challenges into clear recommendations, roadmaps and propositions.

  • Develop business collaboratively, working with INNOPAY and Oliver Wyman senior leaders to identify opportunities, build trusted relationships and win work.

  • Lead and develop our people, coaching consultants on the job and acting as an important senior point of contact for our growing Frankfurt team.

  • Shape what comes next, helping develop new propositions and identifying where INNOPAY should play as the digital transactions landscape continues to evolve.

Skills & What You Bring to the Team

There are three things that matter most for this role:

Commercial effectiveness: You understand how senior consulting relationships develop into opportunities. You can build credibility with clients, identify where you can create value and help shape and win consulting work.

Strong management consulting leadership: You bring significant management consulting experience and can lead engagements end-to-end — managing senior clients, teams, delivery and the development of the people around you.

Expertise in our market: You know the payments and digital transactions landscape. Your experience could span payments strategy and technology, Open Banking/Open Finance, digital identity, data sharing, APIs, digital ecosystems, product innovation or relevant regulation.

In addition, you’ll bring:

  • Around 10+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally developed within a leading consulting environment.

  • Proven experience leading consulting teams and developing others.

  • The ambition to play a broader leadership role as our German team grows.

  • Fluency in German and English.

  • The ability to spend multiple days each week with our team in Frankfurt, irrespective of client assignments.

  • Flexibility to travel when client work requires it.

What Will Make You Stand Out

An established DACH network is valuable, but it isn't the only route to success here.

We’re equally interested in someone with the commercial instinct and relationship-building skills to take advantage of the broader Oliver Wyman network — collaborating with senior colleagues, building credibility with their clients and developing their own market relationships over time.

You might already be a senior consultant within payments, or you may have started your career in consulting before moving into industry and now be interested in returning. What matters is that you can combine consulting craft, commercial ambition, subject-matter credibility and people leadership.

Above all, we’re looking for someone excited by the opportunity to build, rather than simply inherit.

Living Our Values

At Oliver Wyman, we lead with heart — we love what we do and have fun while we do it. We strive for breakthroughs by seeking diverse perspectives and finding powerful and sustainable solutions.

INNOPAY brings its own distinctive culture to that environment: collaborative, entrepreneurial, forward-thinking and deeply focused on our clients.

We’re committed to building a diverse team, and we recognise that uncertainty about meeting every requirement can sometimes stop talented people from applying. If this opportunity excites you but your experience doesn't match every point above, we'd still like to hear from you.

If you require adjustments during the recruitment process, we're happy to discuss them.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh offers hybrid working arrangements that provide both the flexibility of mobile working and the benefits for collaboration, personal connections and professional development of working in the office. Employees are authorized to work remotely. If needed, some teams also schedule weekly “anchor days” where the entire team meets in person at the site office.

title: Future Professional (Student) Advisor
description:
Paul Mitchell The School Boise is seeking a qualified Future Professional Advisor to join our family! With over one hundred schools nation-wide, Paul Mitchell Schools is growing faster than ever. Our "One Size Fits All" and "Be Nice" culture creates a uniquely wonderful learning environment that attracts the most qualified staff team members who always put our Future Professionals first. Not only do we offer an education second to none, we also make time for personal and communal growth through opportunities such as FUNraising, monthly team trainings, student clubs and activities, fashion shows, photo shoots and much more.

Future Professional Advisor Role

The Future Professional Advisor is essential in creating and maintaining a positive and safe learning environment in the school. He or she acts as the liaison between the management team and the student body. He or she is a coach and an accountability buddy for the Future Professionals throughout their time in school, and helps to keep them on track with their requirements for attendance, academics, and overall school performance. All school and student programs are monitored by the Future Professional Advisor. Additionally, he or she creates and manages the education calendar, the clinic floor staffing calendar, and the annual team education training calendar. He or she maintains consistency with the school's polices and systems, provides support for students and staff, and game plans for improvement when necessary.

What We Are Looking For

While the Future Professional Advisor is not a professional counselor and cannot counsel Future Professionals on issues that require a professional agency or licensed counselor, the ideal candidate will have a strong advising and/or education background. This position requires passion, strong organizational and communications skills, a high level of commitment, and the ability to guide and motivate others.

Skills/Competencies Required:

  • Excellent organization, coaching, and communication skills
  • Skills in supervision, teamwork, and documentation
  • Solid work history with verifiable references
  • Passion for the beauty industry
  • Honesty and professionalism

Paul Mitchell The School Boise is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Route Driver - Dodgeville, WI
description:
Spee Dee Delivery is a family owned and operated company that was started in 1978 by Donald and Sylvia Weeres. Our core business is in standard, next-day, ground delivery. The corporate headquarters and main sort facility is located in St. Cloud, MN. We currently employ over 1,800 employees company wide and over the years we have expanded throughout the Midwest.

Job Summary

The Route Driver is responsible for representing the company while making deliveries and picking up freight.

Hours and Wages

  • Monday- Friday, 7:30AM- completion of route
  • 10-15 hours of overtime may be expected each week
  • Voluntary OT on weekends (as needed)
  • Paid OT at time and a half after 40 hours per week
  • Starting wage: $20.00- $24.00 per hour, based on experience

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Deliver and pick up freight in a timely manner from customers and shippers
  • Inspect and report any mechanical problems with the vehicle
  • Load the truck in an organized manner to effectively use space and prevent damage to packages
  • Collect payments for certain packages delivered
  • Verify the content of pickups on shipping papers
  • Notify management of any problems or discrepancies
  • Maintain professional personal appearance as well as cleanliness of vehicle
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to operate a manual transmission, or have the willingness to learn
  • Possess good customer service and can work independently

Education and Experience

  • At least 21 years of age
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred
  • Hold a valid Driver's License with a good driving record which meets company standards

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to pass a DOT physical exam
  • Ability to bend, lift, twist, climb stairs, while moving freight on and off company vehicle
  • Ability to lift and move freight weighing up to 100 pounds
  • Ability to work with all types to freight which include, but are not limited to hazardous material, perishable food and alcohol, firearms, ammunition, and live animals

Benefits

  • Health Insurance, Dental Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off (PTO), Employee Assistance Program, 401(k) Plan, Quarterly Bonuses, and more.

EEO and Affirmative Action Statement

Spee Dee Delivery Service, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Must be able to pass a pre-employment drug screening and a criminal background check.

title: Platform Engineer - Data
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Lead Platform Engineer to lead the design, implementation, modernization, and support of enterprise platform services across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in infrastructure engineering, platform operations, automation, middleware, scheduling, database management, file transfer solutions, and production support within large-scale enterprise environments.

The role requires leadership in driving platform stability, automation, observability, resiliency, security, and operational excellence while partnering with business, application, and infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Operations

  • Lead the design, deployment, and management of enterprise platform infrastructure across UNIX, Linux, and Windows environments.

Infrastructure & Systems Management

Workload Automation & Scheduling

Database & Data Platform Support

Middleware & File Transfer Services

Automation & Scripting

Security & Compliance

Monitoring & Incident Management

This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. title: Scientist, Molecular and Cellular Technologies
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

At Pfizer, our purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Your work will have a profound impact on improving patients' lives globally. Whether you are involved in discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy, or supporting clinical trials, you will leverage cutting-edge design and process development capabilities to accelerate and deliver best-in-class medicines to patients worldwide.

What You Will Achieve

We are seeking a highly motivated, collaborative Scientist with solid hands-on expertise in molecular biology and mammalian cell culture, paired with bioinformatics and coding capabilities to join our Molecular and Cellular Technologies team in Bothell, WA. The successful candidate will contribute to the development, characterization, and data-driven understanding of mammalian cell systems used to support biologics discovery and development. This role is ideal for a scientist who enjoys working at the interface of the bench and computation: designing experiments, generating high-quality biological datasets, building reproducible analysis workflows, and translating complex results into actionable scientific insights.

The successful candidate will bring scientific curiosity, technical rigor, and a collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable moving between the lab bench and data analysis environments, building reliable workflows, interpreting results, and communicating insights that support informed decision-making. This individual should enjoy learning new technologies, improving processes, and working across disciplines to solve complex biological and data-driven problems.

This role will work closely with colleagues in cell line development, molecular biology, bioinformatics, data science, automation, bioprocess development, and project leadership. The Scientist will be expected to contribute to study design, data generation, analysis strategy, interpretation, and communication of results across multidisciplinary teams.

How You Will Achieve It

In this role, you will:

  • Design, execute, and analyze molecular biology experiments to support cell line development, clone characterization, gene expression analysis, and biological mechanism-of-action studies.

  • Culture, maintain, and characterize mammalian cell lines using appropriate aseptic technique, experimental controls, and documentation practices.

  • Apply molecular and cellular techniques such as DNA/RNA extraction, PCR/qPCR/ddPCR, cloning, sequencing library preparation, transfection, cell-based assays, and protein or transcript-level characterization.

  • Generate, organize, and interpret high-dimensional biological datasets, including transcriptomic, genomic, proteomic, or other omics data, as appropriate for project needs.

  • Develop, maintain, and improve reproducible bioinformatics workflows and data analysis scripts using languages such as Python and/or R.

  • Analyze experimental and omics datasets using statistical, visualization, and computational approaches to identify biological patterns, process-relevant drivers, and actionable hypotheses.

  • Partner with laboratory scientists, data scientists, bioinformaticians, automation specialists, and project teams to integrate experimental and computational insights.

  • Clearly communicate study designs, results, limitations, and recommendations through presentations, technical reports, data visualizations, and cross-functional discussions.

  • Maintain accurate, timely, and compliant documentation in electronic laboratory notebooks, code repositories, and internal knowledge management systems.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to automate analyses, improve data quality, strengthen reproducibility, and accelerate decision-making.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • M.S. in molecular biology, cell biology, bioengineering, computational biology, bioinformatics, genomics, biotechnology, or a related discipline with 4+ years of experience; or B.S. with significant relevant industry or academic experience with 6+ years of experience.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, including maintenance, passaging, transfection or transduction, assay execution, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong working knowledge of molecular biology techniques used to interrogate DNA, RNA, and/or protein expression.

  • Experience analyzing biological datasets using coding or scripting approaches in Python, R, or a comparable scientific computing language.

  • Ability to work with structured experimental metadata and maintain high standards for data integrity, traceability, and reproducibility.

  • Familiarity with statistical analysis, data visualization, and interpretation of complex biological data.

  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal presentation skills.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to multidisciplinary project teams.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with RNA-seq, single-cell analysis, targeted sequencing, NGS data processing.

  • Experience developing reproducible pipelines using workflow tools such as SQL, Nextflow, Linux/Unix environments, or cloud computing platforms. Familiarity with AI-based tools is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with CHO or other production-relevant mammalian cell systems, recombinant protein expression, clone screening, cell line stability, or bioprocess development.

  • Experience with laboratory automation, high-throughput experimentation, data management systems, or electronic laboratory notebooks.

  • Ability to bridge experimental biology and computational analysis by designing studies that generate decision-ready datasets.

  • Track record of scientific contributions through publications, presentations, internal reports, patents, or cross-functional project impact.


Work Location Assignment: Hybrid


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $79,400.00 to $132,400.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 7.5% of the base salary. title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
Shape What’s Next at Select Custom Solutions

At Select Custom Solutions, we don’t just make ingredients—we create possibilities. From La Crosse, WI, our team brings innovation and expertise to contract manufacturing, branded dairy and non-dairy ingredients, custom blends, and ingredient distribution. With modern facilities and cutting-edge capabilities, we help some of the world’s most trusted brands deliver products that make a difference in people’s lives.

With a strong focus on growth, innovation, and excellence, Select Custom Solutions offers opportunities to be part of meaningful work that impacts industries worldwide. Whether you’re working hands-on in manufacturing or supporting operations, your contributions help drive the future of food and nutrition.

We’re proud to be partnered with Select Milk Producers, one of the nation’s most progressive dairy cooperatives. With over 110 family-owned dairies and multiple processing plants and joint ventures nationwide, our partnership connects us to a powerful network driving the future of food and nutrition.

Join us—and help shape what’s next.


What Select offers you:

Comprehensive benefits package focusing on your physical, financial and emotional health to include the following perks as well as the standard benefit offerings (health, dental, vision, etc.):

  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays Off
  • Uniform Program
  • Shoe Allowance
  • Onsite gym
  • Career Advancement Opportunities
  • Leadership Development
  • Opportunities to support our local communities
  • Chance to apply best practices in sustainability and environmental initiatives
  • Commitment to producing high quality nutritious products and providing nourishment around the world

What this role is all about:

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst in La Crosse, WI.

This position can sit onsite or hybrid.

Schedule: Monday through Friday 8 am to 5 pm (Hybrid)

The Supply Chain Analyst is a key resource in driving data-informed decision-making across Select Custom Solutions and Mill Haven Foods. This role partners with cross-functional teams to collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, using quantitative methods to improve supply chain planning, logistics, and overall operational performance. The analyst is responsible for developing and maintaining performance metrics, identifying trends, diagnosing issues, and delivering actionable insights that enhance efficiency and effectiveness. By building and refining reporting tools and KPI dashboards, this position strengthens visibility into supply chain performance and supports continuous improvement initiatives. The Supply Chain Analyst enables the organization to make smarter, faster, and more strategic decisions that improve customer satisfaction, cost effectiveness, and process reliability.

Job Duties:

  • Gather, analyze, and interpret data related to costs, productivity, demand, and forecasting to drive informed decision-making.
  • Perform statistical and quantitative analyses to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements, efficiency initiatives, and best practices across supply chain functions.
  • Identify and address barriers that impact operational efficiency within the supply chain.
  • Provide analytical support and insights for projects and process improvement initiatives across all departments.
  • Evaluate and validate customer-provided forecasts, cross-referencing them with internal forecasts to ensure customer service levels are achieved.
  • Partner with production planning and sales teams to manage forecasting data, ensuring fulfillment levels and stock floor programs are consistently maintained.
  • Support project implementations by analyzing forecasts and demand data to inform resource planning.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance KPI dashboards and scorecards to measure supply chain performance.
  • Use KPIs and benchmarks to evaluate results, recommend adjustments, and optimize decision-making.
  • Provide timely reporting and data-driven recommendations to leadership for strategic planning.
  • Work across all Select Custom Solutions facilities to identify synergies, streamline processes, and strengthen the overall supply chain.
  • Collaborate with sales, production, and operations teams to ensure alignment between supply chain capabilities and business needs.
  • Analyze raw material pricing, ensuring costs are appropriately managed and passed through while driving cost-reduction initiatives.
  • Work closely with other departments to gather financial information and support cross-functional initiatives.
  • Understand adhere to Good Manufacturing Practices.
  • Safety Protocol:
  • Stop any observed unsafe acts and obey facility safety rules and procedures.
  • Correct or report any observed safety hazards.
  • Support safety policies and programs.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

Qualifications:

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Economics, Statistics or Mathematics required.
  • Equivalent combination of education and/or experience may be considered.

Experience Required:

  • Minimum two (2) years of experience in a food manufacturing environment preferred.

Certification/Licensure Required:

  • APICS/ASCM certifications preferred.

Where you’ll be working:

Our La Crosse, WI, plant is home to approximately 330 employees. This facility supplies the food, beverage, and nutritional industries with innovative functional ingredients and superior quality contract manufacturing services.

La Crosse, WI, is nestled between the Mississippi River and the rolling river bluffs. This town is home to a plethora of colleges, high-quality health care, community events, and cultural opportunities. If you want to enjoy outdoor activities there are many opportunities, such as hiking, cycling, skiing, and boating. The town hosts multiple events annually and is famously known for their Oktoberfest celebration as well as offering a minor league baseball team. Visit the La Crosse Chamber site https://www.lacrossechamber.com/ for more information on local events.

Lead planning, execution, governance, and delivery for the United States Postal Inspection Service (USPIS) effort. The Program Manager will coordinate across USPS/USPIS, Appian, Appian Accelerate, CIO organizations, and the systems integrator to deliver a secure, scalable, user-centered solution that minimizes custom code, supports Agile delivery, integrates internal and external law enforcement systems, and adheres to USPS/USPIS policies (AS-805 security, TSLC, Section 508) and authorization processes (A&A).

  • Hands-on experience with testing governance (functional, performance, accessibility) and acceptance criteria for enterprise releases.
  • Exceptional communication skills; comfortable briefing executives and leading cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior USPS/USPIS delivery experience and familiarity with federal law-enforcement workflows and case management.

  • Experience with CJIS compliance and secure integrations with external partners.

title: Sheet Metal Laser Programmer
description:
Sheet Metal Laser Programmer

Location: Bettendorf, IA
Department: Manufacturing / Production
Position Type: Industrial Worker | Full-Time | Onsite
Schedule: 1st shift during training; transition to 2nd shift upon completion of training
Reports To: Production Manager or Operations Manager

Position Summary

Schebler Company is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Sheet Metal Laser Programmer to join our sheet metal fabrication team. The Laser Programmer will be responsible for creating, optimizing, and maintaining CNC laser cutting programs to support the efficient production of high-quality sheet metal components.

This role works closely with engineering, production, and quality teams to ensure accurate programming, effective material utilization, and on-time delivery of customer orders. The employee will initially train on 1st shift before transitioning to 2nd shift upon completion of training.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and modify CNC laser programs from engineering drawings and CAD files.
  • Develop nests to maximize material utilization and reduce waste.
  • Program and support fiber laser cutting equipment.
  • Review drawings, specifications, and work orders for accuracy and manufacturability.
  • Troubleshoot programming and machine-related issues to improve production efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineering and production personnel on new products and process improvements.
  • Maintain program revisions and documentation.
  • Support first-run part verification to ensure quality and dimensional requirements are met.
  • Monitor production performance and recommend process improvements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, and cost reduction.
  • Ensure compliance with all company safety and quality standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required; technical degree preferred.
  • Minimum two years of experience programming CNC laser cutting equipment in a sheet metal fabrication environment.
  • Proficiency with CAD/CAM and nesting software.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
  • Strong understanding of sheet metal fabrication processes.
  • Experience with ERP or MRP systems preferred.
  • Excellent problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with engineering, production, quality, and other team members.
  • Ability and willingness to train on 1st shift and transition to 2nd shift upon completion of training.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Trumpf, Cincinnati, Mazak, or similar laser systems.
  • Knowledge of press brake operations and downstream fabrication processes.
  • Experience with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor, TruTops, or similar programming software.
  • Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement experience.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout the facility.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to wear all required personal protective equipment.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay based on experience
  • Employee ownership through Schebler's Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Career development opportunities
  • Stable and growing manufacturing environment

Why Join Us?

For more than 130 years, The Schebler Company has built a reputation for quality craftsmanship, innovation, and highly engineered metal products. We are proud of our long-standing Quad Cities roots and our commitment to continued growth in Bettendorf.

Schebler is also an employee-owned company, which means our employees share in the company's success and have a direct stake in the quality of the work we produce.

As a Sheet Metal Laser Programmer, you will play a critical role in optimizing manufacturing processes, improving material utilization, and supporting the production of high-quality sheet metal products for our customers.

Apply today and help drive precision, efficiency, and excellence in manufacturing.

description:
Are you highly organised and comfortable coordinating multiple deadlines, stakeholders and schedules at once? Do you enjoy being the person who keeps the details moving and ensures people have what they need, when they need it? CFA Institute is looking for a Speaker Coordinator to provide end-to-end administrative coordination for approximately 400 speakers each year across our Global Event Solutions portfolio, including webinars and in-person events.

You will manage the practical journey from speaker confirmation and onboarding through preparation, event delivery and closeout. You will coordinate schedules, agreements, logistics, documentation and payments, working across multiple events and time zones while providing speakers and internal teams with accurate, timely information.

What You’ll Do

  • Coordinate the end-to-end administration of approximately 400 speakers and contributors annually across webinars and in-person events.

  • Own and maintain the master speaker schedule, tracking deadlines, dependencies, outstanding actions and risks across multiple concurrent events.

  • Coordinate preparation, rehearsal and technical-check calls for webinar speakers, including invitations, briefing materials, attendance, actions and follow-up.

  • Support preparation calls for in-person speakers, capturing and following up on requirements covering session timings, audiovisual needs, staging, travel, access and onsite arrangements.

  • Act as an administrative point of contact for speakers, contributors and their agents, providing practical information and coordinating virtual and in-person logistics.

  • Manage webinar contributor agreements and the agreement process for paid and unpaid in-person speakers, ensuring documentation and permissions are completed and recorded.

  • Coordinate vetting, due diligence, Procurement approvals, supplier onboarding, purchase orders, invoices and payment records for paid speakers.

  • Maintain accurate speaker information across event webpages, marketing materials, event platforms and internal communications, including biographies, titles, headshots and permissions.

  • Work closely with Content, Marketing, Multimedia, Event Operations, Finance and Procurement to track ownership and keep outstanding actions moving.

  • Manage the collection, version control, circulation and filing of abstracts, presentations and speaking notes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrable experience in contract administration, procurement or supplier onboarding, alongside maintaining accurate schedules and records.

  • Proven ability to coordinate multiple concurrent event, speaker or content workstreams with interconnected deadlines.

  • Strong experience managing complex calendars, preparation meetings and deliverables involving senior stakeholders and multiple time zones.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a track record of maintaining accurate records and providing clear status updates.

  • The ability to respond effectively to changing priorities, ambiguity and fast-moving deadlines.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a professional and diplomatic approach when working with speakers, agents and internal stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

  • A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Why Join Us

  • Coordinate a significant global speaker portfolio spanning approximately 250 webinar and 150 in-person speakers each year.

  • Work across multiple events and collaborate with teams including Content, Marketing, Multimedia, Event Operations, Finance and Procurement.

  • Build broad exposure to the operational delivery of both virtual and in-person events.

  • Take ownership of a high-volume coordination role where accurate administration, communication and follow-through directly support successful event delivery.

The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”.   • Establish and manage product roadmaps, investment priorities, and OKRs

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across Product, Operations, Technology, Business Line Stakeholders and Risk partners
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, epics, and backlog priorities

Job Description

We are looking for a Southern Indiana Fetal-Infant Mortality Review (FIMR) Coordinator to lead and support efforts in reducing fetal and infant mortality in Southern Indiana. This position will be Full-Time and Remote.

Only work authorizations that will not require sponsorship now or in the future will be considered.

  • Build and maintain relationships with Indiana Department of Health (IDOH) staff, other state agencies, and community organizations serving women, infants, and families

  • Prepare grant applications and reports to expand resources for the Division of Fatality Prevention (DFP) and local FIMR teams

  • Strengthen interagency relationships to expand health promotion resources
  • Prepare abstracts and proposals for presentation at local, state, and national events
  • Present program findings and initiatives at conferences and professional meetings
  • Work with IDOH leadership, local teams, and hospital systems to advance bereavement support, follow-up care, and maternal mental health services after a loss

What You'll Need

Required:

title: Data Analyst / Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Lead Data Engineer / Data Analyst to lead enterprise-wide data engineering, analytics, reporting, and regulatory data initiatives within the Banking and Financial Services domain. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Data Engineering, Python, SQL, PLSQL, ETL/ELT, Snowflake, Data Warehousing, MicroStrategy Reporting & BI, ODI, and Data Analytics, coupled with deep functional knowledge across Lending, Risk, Securities, Tax, Payments, Treasury, and Customer Data Management.

This role will be responsible for driving data strategy, data integration, business intelligence, regulatory reporting, and stakeholder engagement while ensuring data quality, governance, and operational excellence across critical banking data platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering & Data Platform Management

  • Lead the design, development, and enhancement of enterprise data warehouse and data lake solutions.
  • Build and support scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT frameworks, and reporting data marts.
  • Drive data integration initiatives across multiple banking platforms and source systems.
  • Establish data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, and governance standards.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of enterprise data platforms.

Data Analysis & Business Intelligence

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to generate business insights and support decision-making.
  • Develop reporting frameworks, executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and management information systems.
  • Perform data profiling, trend analysis, root cause analysis, and business impact assessment.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to improve reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

Oracle & SQL Development

  • Design and optimize Oracle database solutions supporting enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL programs, procedures, packages, functions, and performance tuning solutions.
  • Perform data extraction, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Troubleshoot database performance, data integrity, and reporting-related issues.

Lending Data Management

  • Support end-to-end lending data covering loan origination, servicing, repayments, collateral, and exposure management.
  • Develop reporting and analytical solutions supporting credit risk and lending operations.
  • Ensure accurate lending data integration across upstream and downstream systems.

Risk & Regulatory Reporting

  • Support enterprise risk data platforms and regulatory reporting initiatives.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and controls testing to meet compliance requirements.
  • Partner with Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Audit teams to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Support internal and external regulatory reporting submissions.

Securities & Capital Markets Data

  • Support securities reference data, trading, settlements, custody, and investment reporting functions.
  • Manage reconciliations and reporting across securities and capital market platforms.
  • Analyze transaction and holdings data to support operational and regulatory requirements.

Tax Data & Compliance Reporting

  • Support tax reporting processes and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Validate tax-related data and ensure data integrity across reporting platforms.
  • Support audit, compliance, and regulatory data requests.

Payments Data Management

  • Support payment processing platforms, transaction monitoring, clearing, settlements, and reconciliation activities.
  • Analyze payment transaction data and investigate operational exceptions.
  • Develop reporting solutions supporting payment operations and regulatory compliance.

Treasury Data Management

  • Support Treasury business functions including liquidity management, cash positioning, funding, investments, and financial risk reporting.
  • Develop and maintain Treasury reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Ensure accurate reconciliation and reporting of Treasury-related financial data.
  • Collaborate with Treasury stakeholders to enhance data quality and reporting capabilities.

Customer Data Management

  • Support Customer Master Data and Customer 360 initiatives.
  • Ensure data consistency, integrity, and governance across customer information systems.
  • Collaborate with business teams to develop customer analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Support regulatory requirements related to customer information management and compliance.

Production Support & Data Operations

  • Provide L2/L3 support for critical enterprise data platforms and reporting applications.
  • Lead incident resolution, problem management, and root cause investigations.
  • Ensure compliance with SLAs, operational KPIs, and production support standards.
  • Drive operational improvements through automation and process optimization.


Who You Are

Desired Candidate Profile

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Warehousing, and BI Reporting environments.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in DataIKU, MicroStrategy, Oracle, SQL, ODI,TWS and Reporting & BI platforms.
  • Extensive experience in Banking and Financial Services organizations.
  • Strong functional understanding of Lending, Risk, Securities, Tax, Payments, Treasury, and Customer Data domains.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting, management reporting, and enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Proven leadership experience managing global teams and stakeholder engagements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Experience working with senior business leaders, risk teams, and regulatory stakeholders.

title: Senior Process Engineer
description:

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. Job Description

Senior Process Engineer

Location: Milpitas, California
Join Teledyne e2v HiRel Electronics and help develop the manufacturing processes behind high-reliability microelectronic products. You will play a key role in taking advanced packaging and assembly processes from concept and evaluation through production qualification, while partnering with manufacturing teams, suppliers, customers, operators, and management.

What you'll do
