  • Partner with suppliers and customers to address material and production concerns.
  • Contribute to design reviews, program readiness, design for manufacturability, and new product development.
  • Design and document precision tooling, fixtures, bills of materials, and assembly drawings.
  • Program, troubleshoot, and qualify manufacturing equipment.
  • Create clear process documentation and step-by-step production instructions.
  • Apply statistical analysis, process control, problem-solving, and design of experiments.
  • Communicate complex technical topics effectively across technical and operational audiences.

What you need

  • Process development, scale-up, and manufacturing problem-solving skills - Required
  • Die attach, wire bonding, flip chip, underfill, encapsulation, hermetic sealing, and packaging experience - Required
  • Knowledge of electronic materials, equipment qualification, statistical analysis, and process control - Required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills - Required
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field - Required
  • 8+ years of experience developing microelectronic assembly processes - Required
  • Hands-on equipment programming and troubleshooting experience - Preferred
  • Knowledge of MIL-PRF-38535 - Preferred

What we offer

At Teledyne e2v HiRel Electronics, you'll have the opportunity to work on advanced microelectronics technologies that support critical and high-reliability applications. You'll collaborate with experienced engineering professionals, influence manufacturing innovation, and contribute to products that make a meaningful impact. Teledyne offers a comprehensive benefits package, opportunities for professional development, and a collaborative work environment focused on continuous improvement and technical excellence.

U.S. citizenship and fluency in English are required. Ability to travel to customer sites within the United States is required. An active Department of Defense security clearance may be required.

Job Description:

The Senior Functional and Automated Tester plans, designs, and executes functional and automated testing for modern applications, with a focus on quality, security, performance, and operational readiness. This role works closely with product, development, DevSecOps, and stakeholders to ensure solutions meet business requirements and are released with confidence. The tester leads test strategy and automation approaches, drives defect prevention through early engagement, and helps establish consistent testing standards across teams and projects.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

  • Lead or contribute to project planning by identifying testing scope, risks, environment needs, test data requirements, and tooling to support delivery timelines.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into test strategies, test plans, and detailed test cases, covering functional, integration, regression, performance, and security-related validation.
  • Design and build automated tests (unit, API, integration, and user interface) using a disciplined approach that supports repeatable and reliable execution within a continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
  • Perform hands-on functional testing of workflows, edge cases, data validations, and error handling; verify that solutions meet user and operational expectations.
  • Validate event/message-based services and distributed workflows, including systems that use message queues such as Apache Kafka, ensuring correct processing, resiliency, and traceability.
  • Test and validate API-centric and cloud-friendly designs (microservices, serverless applications), including backward compatibility, contract expectations, and integration with internal and external partners.
  • Partner with DevSecOps and engineering teams to ensure consistent application of development standards, procedures, and processes, including secure development expectations.
  • Support system compatibility and environment readiness by coordinating with technical teams on test environments, deployments, configuration changes, and release readiness.
  • Apply data security procedures in testing activities; identify potential data security risks and ensure defects and risks are documented, escalated, and tracked through resolution.
  • Produce and maintain clear testing documentation (test evidence, defect reports, dashboards, charts/diagrams, and runbooks as needed) suitable for leadership and audit reviews.
  • Drive defect triage and root-cause analysis with developers and stakeholders; verify fixes and help implement preventative quality controls.
  • Promote strong operational practices including observability validation (logging, metrics, tracing), performance baselines, and readiness checks.
  • Use AI-assisted development and testing workflows (where approved) to accelerate test creation, analysis, and triage while maintaining quality and security expectations.
  • Perform other job-related duties assigned to support delivery and operational goals.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field from an accredited College/University
  • Alternative Path: If the candidate does not possess a relevant four-year degree, an additional four years of relevant work experience will be required.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or software development with significant testing/automation responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience owning test strategy and automation for complex, distributed, or cloud-based systems.
  • Strong experience leading and executing functional testing and test automation across the software development lifecycle.
  • Proven ability to define and implement an effective test strategy for distributed/cloud applications, including regression planning and release readiness.
  • Experience with automated testing tools for unit, API, and user interface testing; familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) concepts and automation-first approaches.
  • Experience working in CI/CD pipeline environments using source code management and build/deployment tooling (for example: GitLab, Jenkins) within a DevSecOps/SecDevOps culture.
  • Working knowledge of secure coding and secure engineering expectations, including risk identification and validation of security controls.
  • Experience validating message/event-driven systems, including Kafka-based workflows and asynchronous processing behaviors.
  • Experience testing API-centric architectures such as microservices and serverless applications, including contract validation and integration testing.
  • Cloud and data pipeline familiarity, including one or more of the following: Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Redis.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including analyzing logs/metrics/traces, isolating failures across components, and supporting defect triage.
  • Solid technical fluency in one or more languages used for test automation and validation, such as Java, Python, SQL, and/or JavaScript (and familiarity with modern web stacks such as React is a plus).
  • Knowledge of performance and reliability concepts, including performance tuning, multi-threading awareness, and validation of high observability principles.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain quality risks and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience working in Agile delivery teams and applying Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
  • Familiarity with change/configuration management and lifecycle tooling (for example: VersionOne, ServiceNow) and Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) practices.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (for example: Docker, Kubernetes), including security and environment considerations.
  • Experience with Kubernetes security practices and testing in containerized production-like environments.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development/testing tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, and Gemini Vertex AI to improve efficiency in test creation and analysis (within approved governance).
  • Experience producing test evidence and documentation suitable for audit or compliance reviews.

Security Clearance Level:

  • This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.
  • This position has a U.S. residency requirement. The USPS security clearance process requires the selected candidate to have resided in the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for the last five years as follows: U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 6 months consecutively in the last 3 years (unless they meet certain exceptions). Non-U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 90 days consecutively in the last 3 years.

title: Analista de Controle de Qualidade II - HPLC
description:
Missão: Desenvolver procedimentos padrões para diversas áreas assegurando a melhoria contínua dos processos, através de auditorias internas e externas, tratativas de não conformidades identificando oportunidades de melhorias nos processos e fornecendo treinamentos aos colaboradores. Garantir o atendimentos dos requisitos regulamentares da empresa.

Experiência: Desejável experiência Mínima de 2 anos em laboratórios de universidade ou indústria.

Formação:

Mínimo: Ensino superior completo em Química, Biologia, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Física, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Alimentos e áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos: Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF), análises físico-químicas e microbiológicas, conhecimento e experiência prática em HPLC (Cromatografia), cromatografia gasosa, pacote Office intermediário, elaboração de documentos técnicos (protocolos, relatórios e procedimentos), gestão de amostras, estudos de estabilidade e monitoramento ambiental, inglês básico. Desejável: escrita científica, 5S e Lean Six Sigma (Yellow Belt).

Atividades:

  • Ser agente ativo do processo, garantindo as entregas nos prazos acordados através da execução das análises físico-químicas de ME, MP e PA, utilizando técnicas de HPLC (Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência) e cromatografia gasosa, análises microbiológicas e monitoramento ambiental, em caráter de liberação ou investigativo;
  • Operar, executar e acompanhar análises por HPLC, incluindo preparo de amostras, preparo de soluções e fases móveis, execução das análises, avaliação dos cromatogramas e interpretação dos resultados, conforme métodos analíticos e procedimentos estabelecidos;

  • Acompanhar a cadeia de custódia das amostras, garantindo a rastreabilidade e a confiabilidade dos resultados, assim como o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Fabricação;
  • Realizar análises microbiológicas de produtos, insumos, ambiental e de caráter investigativo;

  • Executar ações inerentes a desenvolvimentos analíticos, de processos, fornecedores, entre outros, e investigações de desvios;
  • Realizar análises de rotina, prezando pela integridade dos dados, e auxiliar nas investigações de resultados fora de especificação (OOS) e fora de tendência (OOT);
  • Realizar aprovação de laudos de terceiros e análises internas no sistema;
  • Zelar pelos cronogramas de estudos de estabilidade, monitoramento ambiental e demais estudos pertinentes ao Controle de Qualidade, assim como pela execução das análises envolvidas;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e manutenção do laboratório, assim como seguir a obrigatoriedade do uso de EPIs adequados;
  • Realizar demais tarefas pertinentes ao cargo quando solicitadas;

title: Mainframe Batch & Console Operations
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Computer Operators at Kyndryl are key in helping revolutionize the way we operate complex computer systems. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, supervise and control intricate networks and applications, and operate distributed systems in a multi-vendor environment.

As a Computer Operator you will be on the technical frontline – performing batch operations as per service agreements, analyzing first-level issues across systems, and resolving/routing issues as appropriate. You will also have the opportunity to develop support system management processes specific to customer requirements, ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers.

Key Responsibilities Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve JCL abends, override issues, and symbolic parameter problems. Allocate and manage BIOS, TIF, GDG, and VSAM datasets. Identify ownership of Production and QA jobs and coordinate with appropriate development groups. Perform file out-of-space (FOOS) recovery and support batch/online recovery activities. Coordinate batch job restarts, abend recovery, and customer escalations. Utilize break-glass procedures for emergency production support access when required. Monitor and manage OPC/TWS job scheduling activities including hold/release actions, predecessor/successor analysis, and database lookups. Support NDM/Connect: Direct operations including process monitoring, troubleshooting transfer failures, DR transfers, and client file transfers. Perform PDX activities including installs, promotes, backouts, and password reset support using Power IDs. Manage ITSM incidents, problem tickets, FACHA/Hot Item creation, ticket reassignment, and closure activities. Process TSSR work orders, manage production/QA job requests, and respond to operational emails within SLA timelines. Execute weekend IPL support activities, validate environment availability, and coordinate fixes for out-of-sequence abends. Ensure Production, QA, and Test regions are operational following maintenance and IPL activities.

If you have a passion for technology and a desire to continually improve your skills – this is the position for you. You will work with a talented team of professionals and collaborate on exciting projects that are shaping the future of our industry.

Your Future at Kyndryl
As a Computer Operator, you will be interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams which makes identifying career paths with Kyndryl easy. Whether you want to delve into the intricacies of automating complex processes, drive essential systems, or ensure top-notch delivery to our customers, there is a path for you – and we’re invested in paving the way.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 4 to 5 years of experience in Mainframe Batch & Console Operations.
  • Strong experience in Mainframe Production Support, including:
    • JCL troubleshooting and abend resolution
    • OPC/TWS scheduling
    • NDM / Connect:Direct
    • VSAM, GDG, DB2, and TSO/ISPF dataset management
    • PDX deployment support
    • ITSM ticket management
    • Batch monitoring and recovery
    • Incident and problem management
    • IPL support activities
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Experience with job scheduling tools, reporting, and logging systems.
  • Proficiency in Windows and Mac operating systems.
  • Experience in troubleshooting, backup and recovery, and basic networking concepts.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Ability to work in a 24x7 production support environment.
  • Experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and service restoration activities.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Outreach Pharmacy Specialist-3
description:
We are hiring a Pharmacy Specialist at BCBST!

In this role, you will support the Senior Care Outreach and Retention team by serving as a key point of contact for members navigating their pharmacy and healthcare needs. You will focus on medication adherence and member education, helping ensure members understand their prescriptions, benefits, and available resources to support their overall health and well-being.

This position combines inbound and outbound phone support, allowing you to engage directly with members while providing guidance and assistance related to their medications and health plan benefits. You will build meaningful connections with members, address questions and concerns, and help remove barriers that may impact medication adherence and health outcomes.

You will play an important role in improving the member experience by delivering compassionate, member-centered support and helping members stay engaged in their care. Responsibilities include documenting interactions, collaborating with internal teams, and contributing to outreach efforts that promote quality care and positive health outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) with strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a passion for helping others. Preferred qualifications include proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, Word, and Copilot, as well as a basic understanding of medications evaluated under Medicare's Star Ratings system and the impact of medication adherence on member outcomes.

We foster a culture where innovation is encouraged. That includes using AI enabled tools responsibly to support everyday work — guided by proven workflows, templates, and policies. As roles become more advanced, we expect employees to leverage AI more broadly to transform how we serve members.

Note:

• This is a remote role within a collaborative and supportive team environment
• Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:45 a.m. – 5:15 p.m. EST
• Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) certification is required for this role
• Position includes both inbound and outbound member phone interactions throughout the day

Job Responsibilities

  • Reviewing, updating, maintaining and monitoring pharmacy information disseminated to external and internal customers (as necessary).
  • Conducting outbound educational telephone calls regarding medication adherence to members, prescribers and pharmacists as directed.
  • Motivating members to become compliant by refilling their prescriptions and/or coordinating necessary communication or scheduling with providers and pharmacies.
  • Handling customer service inquiries and problems via the telephone.

Job Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Experience

  • 2 years-Experience in a retail pharmacy or comparable customer service environment required
  • 1 year - Experience in a pharmacy setting with knowledge in medical terminology required
  • 1 year - Technical or operational experience required

Skills\Certifications

  • Certified Pharmacy Technician (PTCB or NHA) required.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel and Powerpoint)
  • Must be a team player, be organized and have the ability to handle multiple projects
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills

title: Solution Architect - VP
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To lead the portfolio management team in the delivery of successful projects, while ensuring that portfolio management processes and practices are aligned with controls and governance standards and that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives.

Accountabilities

  • Leading of portfolio management team, including setting of portfolio vision, management of portfolio performance, and provision of guidance and support to portfolio analysts.
  • Monitoring of portfolio performance, including tracking of project progress, managing budgets, identification of thematic risks and issues, and reporting on portfolio status to senior management.
  • Management of portfolio documentation, including aggregation of portfolio book of work, schedules, and budgets, and ensuring that portfolio documentation is up-to-date and accurate.
  • Facilitation of portfolio governance, including ensuring that projects are aligned with the organisation’s strategic objectives, aligned with the controls and governance standards and that portfolio thematic risks and issues are managed effectively.
  • Managing the portfolio Book of Work outlining the sequence and dependencies of change initiatives, considering factors like resource availability, stakeholder buy-in, and potential risks.
  • Facilitation of change management activities, to ensure that change initiatives are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.
  • Continuous improvement of portfolio management practices, including identification of areas for improvement and implementation of changes to improve portfolio performance.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders, including senior management, project teams, and external partners, to ensure that portfolio management practices are aligned with their needs and expectations.
  • Development of portfolio management processes that are aligned with controls and governance standards and that support the delivery of successful projects.

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Vice President – Solution Architect where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as Vice President – Solution Architect you should have experience with:

  • Enterprise-scale solution architecture leadership, defining target architectures, technology roadmaps, design standards, and architectural governance across complex banking platforms.
  • Experienced in architecting strategic banking platforms using event-driven, API-led, cloud-native, and domain-centric design principles.
  • Extensive experience in designing and implementing large-scale modernization of legacy banking applications, including migration of Deposits, pricing, interest, and accounting capabilities to strategic platforms.
  • Cloud and platform transformation, leading large-scale implementations on BCP (Barclays Cloud) or AWS with a strong focus on resilience, security, scalability, observability, and regulatory compliance.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

  • Good understanding of Demand Deposit Accounts (DDA), Cash Management, and Liquidity Management, including account servicing, balance management, cash concentration, sweeping, pooling, virtual accounts, and liquidity optimisation solutions.
  • Strong understanding of corporate banking products and services, including payments, collections, receivables, account services, and treasury management.
  • Strong data architecture and database expertise across enterprise relational, distributed, and NoSQL platforms.
  • Proven experience in regulatory-driven architecture and design, ensuring auditability, traceability, data governance, and compliance with banking regulations.
  • Experience delivering highly resilient and available banking platforms supporting critical customer journeys and large-scale transaction processing.
  • Excellent senior stakeholder engagement and technology leadership skills, including mentoring architects, influencing strategic investment decisions, driving cross-functional alignment, and partnering with business and operations leadership.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune.

Uniquely Interesting Work, Life-changing Careers

Job Responsibilities

GDIT is your place. You make it your own by bringing your ideas and unique perspective to our culture. By owning your opportunity at GDIT, you are helping us ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on a Business Process Analyst Senior with Scrum Master experience joining our team to support our customer activities in Washington, DC. This position can be worked Remote.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. The prospective candidate should have experience in Agile methodologies, requirements gathering, and user story development, as well as proficiency with tools like Jira and Confluence. Day-to-day responsibilities include analyzing and improving business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, documenting workflows, identifying operational efficiencies, and supporting data-driven decision-making. This role requires strong knowledge and application of Agile and Scrum practices to facilitate ceremonies, support backlog refinement, remove impediments, track sprint progress, and help cross-functional teams deliver high-quality solutions on time. The ideal candidate is a collaborative problem-solver who can bridge business needs and technical execution, communicate clearly with diverse stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement in a fast-paced customer environment.

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies such as Scrum, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

  • Analyze existing business processes and end-to-end optimizing to drive operational excellence and efficiency through automation of strategic alignment.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements and translate them into user stories.
  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows to support customer.
  • Partner with business leaders, SMEs, technical teams, data analysts and operational staff to ensure end-to-end requirements are understood and implemented correctly.

  • Proven experience writing requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for requirements and project tracking while leveraging AI.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience writing requirements and creating user stories.

Preferred Qualifications:

title: Director, Finance Commercial Operations
description:
ABOUT US:

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

OUR PEOPLE:

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers!!

ROLE SUMMARY:

Do you enjoy partnering with commercial leaders to shape high-value deals, influence business decisions and drive commercial performance?

As Director, Finance Commercial Operations, we will look to you to lead the Commercial Operations agenda for Sales & Account Management (SAM), partnering with regional commercial leaders, deal teams and business divisions to support growth, profitability and strong customer outcomes.

We work closely with our commercial teams to provide financial oversight on customer deals, ensuring decisions align with business objectives, pricing frameworks, licensing models, commercial policy and regulatory requirements. The role plays a central part in deal governance, providing recommendations on deal structures, approvals, risk considerations and commercial outcomes while working across Legal, Product, Tax, Order Management, Compliance, Credit Management and Commercial Policy to help ensure agreements are practical, commercially sound and executable.

We are committed to creating consistency in how commercial decisions are made across our markets. This role supports the interpretation and application of commercial policies, manages exceptions and helps deliver global initiatives locally. It also leads annual price increase activity, balancing customer needs with commercial objectives to maximise value and performance. Working closely with Sales & Account Management teams, the successful candidate will help strengthen negotiation strategies, financial outcomes and deal quality while supporting improvements to commercial processes, governance materials and team capability.

In addition to its commercial responsibilities, this role provides leadership for a geographically dispersed team of approximately 17 professionals located across multiple regions. The successful candidate will create a collaborative and high-performing environment, setting clear priorities, supporting professional development and ensuring consistent execution across locations. Working across different cultures, time zones and business priorities, they will foster engagement, strengthen capability and build a team culture focused on accountability, customer outcomes and continuous improvement.

Leadership responsibilities include resource planning, workload prioritisation, performance management, escalation support, talent development and succession planning. The role requires a leader who can balance day-to-day operational excellence with longer-term capability building and organisational effectiveness.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

We are looking for a commercially minded leader with the judgement to balance growth, profitability, risk and customer outcomes in complex situations. Success in this role requires the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build alignment across Finance, Sales, Product, Legal and Operations, and translate complex information into clear, practical recommendations.

Strong collaboration, attention to detail and sound decision-making are essential. We value individuals who take ownership, build strong relationships across teams and geographies, and look for opportunities to simplify processes and improve outcomes.

The successful candidate will also be an experienced people leader with a proven ability to lead, motivate and develop large, geographically dispersed teams. They will be comfortable managing performance, coaching individuals at different stages of their careers, navigating complex stakeholder environments and creating alignment across regions. The ability to build trust, promote collaboration and maintain engagement within a global matrix organisation will be critical to success.

Above all, candidates should demonstrate LSEG's values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change through their approach to leadership, decision-making and teamwork.

Knowledge & Skills

A strong understanding of commercial finance, deal governance, pricing, profitability analysis and business performance drivers is essential. Experience reviewing and approving complex customer deals, including commercial exceptions, licensing considerations, contractual terms and risk trade-offs, will be highly valued. Strong analytical, financial modelling and Excel skills are also important, alongside the ability to interpret large volumes of commercial and performance data.

Strong people leadership experience is equally important. Candidates should demonstrate success leading multi-location teams within global organisations, managing resources effectively, balancing competing priorities and developing talent at scale. The ability to create an inclusive culture, drive accountability, enhance team capability and lead through change will be highly valued.

Knowledge of sales, order management, billing, product and quote-to-cash processes would be advantageous, as would experience working within regulated environments where controls, compliance, tax and reporting requirements are key considerations. We encourage candidates who have helped deliver operational improvements, governance enhancements or commercial transformation initiatives within global, matrixed organisations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Significant experience in Finance, Commercial Operations, Sales Finance, Commercial Policy, Strategy, Deal Desk, Legal, Product, Order Management or a similar commercial environment, with a track record of influencing senior partners and supporting complex business decisions.

  • Significant experience operating within global, matrixed organisations and leading geographically dispersed teams. This should include performance management, coaching, workforce planning, capability development, succession planning and escalation management.

  • Demonstrated success leading larger teams across multiple locations, creating high-performing and engaged environments while delivering consistent operational and commercial outcome

Career Stage:

Director

London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

title: Cloud Systems Owner
description:
Leidos is seeking Lead Cloud Systems Owner to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of next-generation flight service and air traffic systems. This work aligns with the FAA’s broader initiative to modernize legacy flight service capabilities, replacing aging infrastructure with scalable, cloud-based platforms designed to improve safety and operational efficiency—particularly in remote and high-dependency aviation environments. These efforts focus on delivering mission-critical, future-ready solutions that provide safety-critical flight services to the pilot community.

Please note, this exciting position is currently unfunded and is in anticipation of future work.

In this position, you will serve as the Cloud System Owner for one or more cloud-hosted environments supporting Agile software development teams and production systems. You will be responsible for provisioning, securing, automating, maintaining, and continuously improving cloud infrastructure that supports mission-critical FAA applications. Working closely with software engineers, systems engineers, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, and Product Owners, you will ensure development, integration, test, and production environments remain reliable, secure, scalable, and compliant throughout the software lifecycle.

This position supports government programs and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, administer, and maintain cloud infrastructure supporting development, integration, testing, and production environments.

  • Administer and maintain Kubernetes cluster infrastructure including node groups, upgrades, networking and RBAC.

  • Manage Kubernetes platform-level configurations including ingress controllers, network policies, storage classes and cluster-wide Helm releases.

  • Own and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, defining approved modules and management deployment state across all environments.

  • Configure and manage AWS cloud services including networking, compute, storage, identity, and security services.

  • Automate system provisioning and configuration management using Ansible or comparable tools.

  • Develop automation scripts using Bash and Python to support infrastructure operations, system health, and compliance tasks.

  • Configure and manage Linux servers, storage, package management, services, and security controls.

  • Implement identity and access management using AWS IAM, RBAC, Active Directory, LDAP, or related technologies.

  • Manage secrets, certificates, encryption keys, and PKI assets using AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, or similar technologies.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, container, and application issues across cloud environments.

  • Monitor platform health, availability, performance, and operational metrics.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies while supporting development teams through rapid infrastructure delivery.

At Pfizer, our purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. As a Senior Associate Scientist Biology, you will be at the forefront of our mission, contributing to the development of innovative therapies and vaccines that have the potential to transform patient care. What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will support Pfizer’s biotherapeutics portfolio, contributing to support of analytical testing to support process development of antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) and monoclonal antibodies (mAbs).

How You Will Achieve It

GDIT is currently seeking a Senior Proposal Solutions and Writer to join our team!

The Senior Proposal Solutions and Writer is a senior proposal writer responsible for shaping winning strategies, improving proposal quality at scale, strengthening proposal operations, and writing compelling, compliant proposals in response to complex, high-value federal pursuits. This role operates above individual proposal execution—driving consistency, risk management, and measurable improvements in win performance across the proposal portfolio.

The Senior Proposal Solutions and Writer partners closely with Capture, Solution Architecture, Pricing, and Proposal Leadership to translate customer priorities into clear, compliant, and compelling proposals across the entire GDIT enterprise. This role also plays a key part in mentoring senior staff, refining proposal processes, and evolving how proposal organizations operate in increasingly complex and AI-enabled environments.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

  • Partner with Capture and Solution teams to ensure proposals clearly articulate people, process, and tools
  • Shape win themes, discriminators, and proof points for management and technical volumes that align to customer mission priorities and evaluation criteria

Job Description

Title: Lead - Business Analyst

About Fidelity International

Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.

Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. We are honest, respectful and make tough calls, challenging the status quo to achieve better outcomes through innovation. Above all else, we always put our clients first.


Department Description

The Distribution & Client Technology department comprises of Client Reporting, Client Billing, Data and CRM Technology teams that enable and support the business in the UK, EMEA and Asia Pac regions and is a strategic area targeted for growth over the coming years. The Distribution & Client Technology has been acting as the key enabler for the business in achieving their goals. Purpose of your role

Landscape of applications client reporting, client billing, sales, client servicing functions. These platforms ensure availability of consistent data across all client reporting applications and offer best in class tools and solutions that run on advanced applied technologies.

Lead Business Analyst is a key role within the team and the successful candidate will liaise with the various business and systems groups to assist the application development and support from India. In addition, the manager BA would be expected to contribute to the development of business analysis capability in India, provide thought leadership to identify functional innovation opportunities, resolve functional issues, impart business knowledge to the systems’ team members and contribute to the global BA community.

Key Responsibilities

 Identifying and documenting Business Requirements

 Be the functional champion for the identified business areas - build deep expertise on FIL business processes & domain expertise, lookout for industry patterns and have the ability to sense what’s coming up in the near future.
 Serve as mentor/coach to more junior business analysts on assigned program or within the broader Solution Delivery organization

title: IOS Service Performance Controller
description:
Job Description:

Your impact

Can you build confidence, resolve challenges before they escalate, and become the trusted link between customers, stakeholders, and service delivery teams? If you're passionate about turning data into meaningful insights for a wide range of stakeholders, then the IMOS Service Performance Controller could be the perfect next step in your career.

As part of the UK MOD Integrated Merlin Operational Support (IMOS) Service Management Organisation (SMO), you will play a key role in delivering expert service management across the full range of IMOS products and services.

Acting as the primary interface between service providers, customers, and key stakeholders, you will combine strong technical and operational knowledge with excellent relationship management skills to ensure the effective delivery of services.

Working in a complex stakeholder environment, you will proactively manage issues, risks, and challenges, resolving potentially contentious situations before they escalate. Success in this role requires the ability to influence without direct authority, build trusted relationships, and drive timely, effective outcomes that support both customer and business objectives.

This is a hybrid position, with the opportunity to work 3 days on site and 2 days working from home per week, subject to business requirements.

For the awareness of internal applicants, this is a JFF level 4 role.

What you will do as the IMOS Service Performance Controller:

  • Assist in the management of the UK MOD IMOS Service, representing the IMOS SMO as required, to ensure that integrated solutions are provided by the functional areas.
  • Be the IMOS SMO focal point for the IMOS Performance Reporting activities, proactively monitoring and recording activities across all elements of the service and prepare specific reports, briefs and presentations in support of the IOS service, as required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the IMOS contracted Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) and Measurements of Effectiveness (MOE’s) and the application of alleviation measures when and where applicable.
  • Continuous monitoring of all IMOS KPI performance levels, escalating to the IMOS Service Support Manager or Service Delivery Manager and functional stakeholders when performance risk is identified and in advance of KPI failure being realised, allowing time for corrective action where possible.
  • Ensure root cause of any KPI failures is suitably understood and reported to Key Stakeholders for corrective actions where appropriate
  • Proactively liaise directly with Customer Stakeholders for recorded KPI agreement and be able to suitably demonstrate reasons for applicability of alleviations where appropriate.
  • Monitoring and reporting of internal LH IMOS, non KPI/MOE measured activities, identifying areas of performance risk and opportunity to the business
  • Escalating to SMO and key functional stakeholders, identified risks and opportunities in both contractual and non-contractual performance measures
  • Development of improved reporting tools, utilising new technologies where available and in close collaboration of LH Digital Service functions
  • Contribute to the motivation and development of the IMOS IPT, across the business to provide the level of support activity within the timescales demanded by the business.
  • Compile and publish the monthly and annual contracted Performance Reports indicating all KPI, MOE performance levels and any ad hoc reporting as requested by the Customer, relevant to the IMOS service.
  • Collaborate with the WIST IOS, to identify, develop and implement common and best practices across both services into a combined solution
  • Develop and implement a common reporting tool/format for a future combined service contract e.g. RWE/MAWES
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Highlight any individual training requirements identified to maintain team skill levels in line with developments in Company processes and systems and industry ‘best practice’ procedures.
  • Identify opportunities for new support business and ensure that all such opportunities are highlighted to the appropriate areas of the Business.
  • Identify commercial and technical difficulties such that LH risks are managed and minimised.
  • Ensure that general performance and specific performance measurement relating to the areas of business within your control are managed and reported using identified/new reporting mechanisms.
  • Promote the capabilities of the Company to increase Customer confidence in the Company’s services.
  • Utilise Information Systems, e.g. SAP, SharePoint, Serena, GOLDEsp, Wingman, MJDI where appropriate to perform your daily tasks.

What you’ll bring

  • Ability to provide trusted advice, guidance, and support to colleagues, enabling the successful delivery of Performance and Risk Management objectives while fostering collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • A digital mindset, using data, analytical tools, and innovative thinking to deliver practical solutions and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to collect, collate, analyse and present complex information clearly and concisely in writing or verbally to audiences comprising of multi–disciplinary groups.
  • Team player, able to communicate effectively with colleagues, Prime Contractor, Subcontractors and Key Stakeholders within the MOD Customer community at all levels.
  • Developed problem solving abilities and the ability to apply them in an operational environment.
  • To represent LH in a positive manner, building positive and trusted relationships with MOD customers and key stakeholders through effective day-to-day engagement.
  • Knowledge of the Integrated Operational Support construct and associated support disciplines.
  • Detailed knowledge of military aircraft operations and/or manufacturing and support processes
  • Experience of dealing with the relevant DT organisations of the DE&S.
  • Business acumen and commercial awareness to identify and develop profitable new business opportunities.

Ability to maintain a clear focus on goals & priorities. This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

RUDOLPH AND SLETTEN has an immediate need for an Assistant Superintendent to coordinate field operations for medium- to large-scale projects with a commitment to quality and safe construction processes.   • Ensures subcontractors follow safety procedures

  • Posts jobsite work rules, signage, and bulletin boards

  • Primary field safety representative responsible for an organized and clean project for safety and productivity

  • Monitors work quality, and implements and oversees the field Quality Control Program

  • Educates subcontractors as to the importance of doing it right the first time and managing the Zero Punch List (ZPL)

  • Develops and manages the Quality Assurance/Quality Control Plan (QA/QC) as defined in the Quality Management Protocol

  • Knowledge of Lean/Last Planner practices for pull planning, weekly work plans, performance percent complete, and visual tools is a plus

  • Implements established job plan, monitors progress, and reports results to supervisor

  • Responsible for all daily reports and reporting of any job-specific impacts that may occur regarding time delays, scheduling conflicts, and/or cost implications to the Jobsite Project Manager or General Superintendent

  • Oversees field operations, including supervising and managing personnel and subcontractors

  • Manages and monitors construction activity to maintain compliance with contract specifications, company quality, and safety standards

  • Generates all requisitions, purchase orders, tool acquisitions, inventory, returns, and equipment rentals

  • Supervises and monitors the performance of Assistant Superintendents

  • Interfaces with Project Manager to settle any union jurisdictional disputes that may arise. Works cooperatively and proactively to maintain labor union relations

  • Monitors schedule with Project Manager and Project Engineers, approves all layoffs, assigns work to field personnel

  • Reports labor time and signs timesheets

  • Prepares, reviews, and initials Daily Construction Reports

  • Administers jobsite mobilization

  • Participates in or chairs weekly subcontractor coordination meetings and verifies minutes

  • Reviews and verifies weekly quantities for the percentage of work in place or completed

  • Participates in weekly coordination meetings with architect and owner

  • Leads schedule meetings, weekly coordination meetings, and all safety meetings. Chairs the finish subcontractor coordination meetings

  • Oversees the maintenance of jobsite security

  • Coordinates special inspections as required

  • Coordinates and manages all permits/inspections

  • Knows thoroughly all active subcontractor agreements

  • Has detailed knowledge of client expectations with respect to what is contained in the contract documents

  • Participates in the formulation of subcontractor scope of work, Instructions to Bidders, and post-bid evaluations

  • Participates in preconstruction meetings

  • Implements established job plan, monitors progress, and reports results to supervisor

  • Responsible for reporting cost codes and daily labor units

  • Prepares labor production budget, establishes and maintains labor control in coordination with Superintendents, and reviews cost reports with General Superintendent

  • Completes and processes back-charge documentation

  • Obtains acceptance of completed work and owner sign-off

  • Demonstrates basic knowledge of commercial construction projects (surveying, soil nailing, excavation, site rough grading, masonry installation and framing, and interior finishes)

  • Communicates job status to Project Manager and other management team members on a regular basis

  • Maintains a good line of communication with owner, subcontractors, building trades, and local unions. Uses conflict mediation and troubleshooting skills to resolve any issues, questions, or concerns

  • Handles a varied workload and multiple priorities while working as a team with coworkers to accomplish company and project goals

  • Always represents the company with professionalism and a commitment to quality

  • Performs all other duties as assigned by supervisor

  • Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations to include health, safety, and welfare as appropriate

  • Develops and instills confidence, competence, and trust with subcontractors

REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred; certification

  • Minimum of Five (5) years of experience in the field or in a related area required

  • Work experience in all disciplines of construction (civil, structural, architectural, electrical, mechanical, and plumbing) preferred

  • Experience managing multiple subcontractors

  • Excellent communication, organizational and interpersonal skills

  • Intermediate knowledge/proficiency of MS Office Suite (strong Excel skills in particular)

  • Basic knowledge of scheduling, estimating and cost principals.

We strive to be the preeminent full-service civil, building, and specialty contractor by delivering innovative, transformative projects through world-class execution. title: Yard worker
description:
Join the LKQ Family! We're looking for motivated individuals to join our team at LKQ Corporation. With opportunities for growth, competitive benefits, and a supportive work environment, LKQ is the place to be. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career!

Locate and remove parts from vehicles in the yard in a safe manner.

  • Clean out debris from cars before they go into the processing area.
  • Pull out batteries to be tested to be resold. Bring charged batteries to the retail area.
  • Work with the Loader Operator to properly stage or pull cars in the yard.
  • Walk the yard and place debris in the cars being removed from the yard.
  • Dismantle tires.
  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment.
  • Ensure all EPA and OSHA regulations are being met.
  • Wear all required PPE.

description:
Job Summary**

Responsible for the safe and efficient transportation of live chicks (HC PNKLN LADA-5) to designated locations, ensuring their well-being and timely delivery.

* Report any vehicle malfunctions, accidents, or incidents promptly to supervision.
* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene of the transport vehicle.

* Minimum of a high school diploma or equivalent.
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
* Experience in commercial driving, preferably with livestock or delicate cargo.
* Familiarity with operating specialized transport vehicles (e.g., LADA-5) is a plus.
* Ability to perform physical tasks such as lifting, loading, and unloading.
* Strong understanding of animal welfare principles and safe handling practices for live chicks.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, and weekends, as required.
* Knowledge of local roads and delivery routes.

title: Oliver Wyman – Consultant Intern (m/f/d) 2027 – Stockholm
description:

Oliver Wyman

Description:

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

As an intern, you'll join us for an 8-12 weeks internship and be a fully integrated member of a project team, working alongside colleagues and clients on real business challenges from day one. You'll contribute to meaningful client work, gain firsthand consulting experience, and develop the skills that will support your future career.

  • Contribute to client projects through research, analysis, problem solving, and the development of client recommendations and deliverables.
  • Work alongside experienced consultants, participating in team discussions and client interactions to gain firsthand consulting experience.
  • Receive ongoing coaching, mentorship, and feedback while collaborating with colleagues across industries and capabilities.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

  • Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.
  • Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.
  • Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a Leader

  • From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective.
  • Learn how to structure problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to team discussions and client conversations.
  • As you grow, you’ll build confidence, take on greater responsibility, and see the impact your contribution can make.

Learn and grow without limits

  • Build real consulting skills through hands-on project experience, formal training, continuous coaching, and mentoring.
  • Learn from experienced consultants and industry experts while developing your analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Expand your network across the firm and gain insight into the many career paths available at Oliver Wyman.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

  • Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.
  • Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.
  • Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

  • Participate in a structured internship program designed to accelerate your professional growth.
  • Build your network through intern events, social activities, and connections across the firm.High-performing interns may be considered for future internship or full-time opportunities, subject to business needs and local hiring practices.

Who can apply?

  • Students currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree and expected to graduate within the next 1–2 years.
  • Strong academic performance and demonstrated intellectual curiosity.
  • We welcome students from all academic backgrounds; no specific major or prior consulting experience is required.
  • Individuals who display initiative, creativity, adaptability, and a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Evidence of leadership positions, teamwork, entrepreneurship, extracurricular involvement, or other meaningful achievements is highly valued.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
  • Language skills: Swedish or any other Nordic language (Norwegian/Danish/Finnish) and English (native/fluent).

How to apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

What to expect during the interviews process?

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business.

If you want to learn more about consulting interviews and start your preparation, please visit our careers page:

Job Description

Director, Non-Product Software Validation (NPSS)

In this role you

The Director, Non-Product Software Validation provides enterprise leadership for Quality Management Systems (QMS) Validation, regulatory compliance, and lifecycle governance of non-product software that support or interface with regulated business processes. The role ensures that validation, compliance, and risk-based controls are embedded throughout the system lifecycle and aligned with global regulatory requirements.

  • Define and govern enterprise NPSS validation strategy, standards, controls, and operating models for regulated business and IT systems, including SAP ERP platforms.

  • Build, coach, and lead high-performing and optimally engaged global teams responsible for validation, compliance, audit support, and process excellence.

You're the right fit if

  • 20+ years of experience in Medical Devices, Pharmaceuticals, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Compliance, Quality Systems, Computer System Validation, or regulated industries.

  • The ideal candidate will possess significant leadership experience building and managing globally distributed and cross-functional teams.
  • Extensive experience leading NPSS validation programs and computerized-system implementations across enterprise in regulated environments.
  • Demonstrates expertise in SAP ERP validation, including implementation, remediation, upgrades, maintenance, and lifecycle management. Having gone through multiple green field and brownfield SAP deployments.
  • Proven experience supporting external regulatory inspections, internal audits, supplier audits, and quality-system assessments.
  • Strong stakeholder-management, leadership, communication, negotiation, conflict resolution and organizational-influence capabilities.
  • Experience driving CAPA, SCARS, change control, nonconformance management, process improvement, transformational programs, and audit readiness initiatives.
  • Experience translating business processes into compliant technology solutions and governing enterprise-wide deployment of regulated applications.

Technical and Regulatory Expertise

  • Computer System Validation (CSV) /Computer Software Assurance (CSA)
  • Quality Management Systems (QMS) – CAPA, SCAR, Deviation Management, Change Control

  • EU MDR, EU Annex 11

We believe that we are better together than apart. For this role, it means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

title: Sports Reporter
description:
Sports Reporter, Toronto, Canada

This is a Fixed Term Contract based in Toronto, Canada.

Reuters is seeking an ambitious, digitally minded Sports Reporter with outstanding knowledge of international sport and excellent written and spoken English, ready to thrive in a fast-paced global newsroom.

You will operate as a fully multi-media journalist, working seamlessly across text, video and pictures as part of a dynamic global sports unit delivering to digital and broadcast clients worldwide.

The successful candidate will join a team of talented reporters, delivering breaking news with speed and accuracy and have a demonstrated ability to seamlessly shift between multiple sports and coverage areas in a single day – from soccer, the NFL, NHL, MLB, NBA, tennis and golf to combat sports, doping and breaking news – while maintaining accuracy, speed and depth.

You will also produce deeper, investigative stories that appeal to a wide range of Reuters subscribers, from media clients to financial specialists.

A key part of this role will also be working closely with our colleagues in the visuals department. Experience in combining text, video, and pictures in news editing and story planning is a distinct advantage, as this role requires a multimedia approach to ensure our sports coverage stands out across platforms.


This is a full-time role requiring flexibility and commitment, working within a rotating shift system that will include weekends, afternoons, evenings and some travel.

The position will be based in Toronto and will report to the Global Sports Editor.

About the Role

As Sports Reporter, you will:

  • Break news and deliver fast, accurate, compelling sports stories for a global audience.

  • Write clean, authoritative copy under deadline pressure — from quick-turn match reports to deeper enterprise pieces.

  • Work closely with video producers, picture editors and graphics teams to shape integrated, multi-platform storytelling.

  • Provide on-camera analysis when required.

  • Identify strong visual elements and collaborate to ensure pictures and video enhance your reporting.

  • Adapt stories for digital platforms with strong headlines and audience engagement in mind.

  • Contribute ideas that travel across formats — from text to video to live digital coverage.

About You

You’re a fit for the role of Sports Reporter if your background includes:

  • A track record of leading impactful and innovative sports journalism.

  • Deep knowledge of global sport and a strong instinct for what matters in live competition.

  • Experience filing fast, accurate copy in a breaking news environment.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across different platforms and regions.

  • Familiarity with business and financial aspects of sports is a plus.

  • A commitment to Reuters Trust Principles: independence, integrity and freedom from bias.

Please note: Applications close on Monday 31st August 2026.

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider. Founded in 1851, it is committed to the Trust Principles of independence, integrity and freedom from bias. With unmatched coverage in over 16 languages, and reaching billions of people worldwide every day, Reuters provides trusted intelligence that powers humans and machines to make smart decisions. Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions.
