title: Water Superintendent
description:
General Purpose of Position

Manages and oversees the maintenance of water department and cemetery operations, completion of complex projects, and work on capital projects

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Develops and manages the departmental budget

  • Proposes line item budget based on prior year
  • Tracks expenditures on a monthly basis
  • Receives and tracks monthly expenses to stay within budget
  • Prepares and distributes the appropriate information needed to prepare annual budget
  • Oversees and maintains annual budget

Supervises departmental personnel

  • Supervises all employees, establishing all scheduling practices and assigning appropriate tasks
  • Completes employee performance evaluations on a regular basis
  • Tracks and posts all scheduling, vacation time, comp time, and sick leave according to procedure
  • Oversees needed discipline and tracks all applicable documentation
  • Assures professional development for each employee

Performs administrative duties related to departmental functions

  • Maintains adequate inventories of supplies and equipment
  • Purchases supplies following City policies and procedures
  • Advises City Administrator regarding progress of projects and assigned jobs
  • Assists and works with the City Administrator on departmental projects
  • Develops bid specifications for equipment and/or projects
  • Participates in the City's comprehensive planning process
  • Complete all reports and paperwork as required

Maintains well houses

  • Cleans equipment and facility
  • Maintains proper pressure and chemical balance in system
  • Make sure water towers are at proper levels
  • Troubleshoots gauge or pumps malfunctions
  • Refills chemicals, air tubes, etc. when necessary

Installs and maintains potable water system

  • Checks and maintains well houses, pumps and other system components
  • Removes and replaces components when needed
  • Determines if components can be repaired or must be replaced
  • Checks system components to assure proper operation

Oversees City Cemetery

  • Sells cemetery plots to public
  • Maintains and updates records of cemetery plots
  • Mark plots when necessary
  • Meet with families
  • Assure proper maintenance of cemetery

Participates in public relations and education

  • Communicates regularly with various stakeholders, including City staff, other government entities, contractors and developers
  • Attends Board meetings and other meetings as required
  • Provides technical assistance to city officials and the general public regarding water and wastewater issues as requested

Oversees the City's safety programs for all but Police Department

  • Prepares agenda for monthly safety meetings
  • Types and distributes minutes
  • Schedules employee training, as required
  • Maintains separate safety files
  • Completes annual safety evaluation according to insurance provider

May occasionally serve as an equipment operator

Serves as other departmental personnel as needed

Performs similar duties for other City departments as assigned

Performs other duties as directed

Education and Experience

The person in this position must have a high school diploma or its equivalent; some college or vocational training in civil engineering or a related field is preferred. At least five years of progressively responsible water or wastewater construction or maintenance experience is strongly recommended, with at least three years of supervisory experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

Licenses and Certifications

The person in this position must have a valid Class B commercial driver's license with airbrakes certification and must be able to obtain a class C Missouri Water Operator's license, a class C Wastewater Operator's license, and a DS3 license.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Knowledge

  • Supervisory principles, practices, and procedures
  • Project management practices and procedures
  • City's purchasing policies and procedures Inventory management principles and methods
  • Proper maintenance, repair and use of heavy equipment, including aerial bucket lift truck, tandem axle dump truck and skid loader
  • Minor mechanical repairs on the truck and other machinery
  • Proper installation, maintenance, and repair of water and wastewater systems
  • Proper storage and use of various chemicals
  • Lift station operations and maintenance
  • Basic civil engineering for determining and digging grades
  • Basic environmental standards for water, sewer, and wastewater treatment systems
  • The layout of city streets
  • Turf management principles and practices
  • Basic carpentry, plumbing, electrical and concrete techniques
  • Maintenance methods of grounds, buildings, and equipment
  • Basic equipment maintenance and repair
  • Basic civil engineering principles
  • Proper materials and equipment
  • Federal and state statutes concerning the work of the department
  • Mathematical skills, including addition, subtraction, division, and multiplication as well as algebraic and geometric functions
  • General functions and operations of municipal government

Skills and Abilities

  • Apply supervisory techniques to practical situations
  • Manage a departmental budget
  • Develop bid specifications
  • Effectively negotiate contracts and other agreements
  • Effectively manage personnel, equipment, and supplies to maximize departmental efficiency

Who Are We?

We at Pine Rest believe in the power of healing and that everyone in our community has the right to expert care for mental health and substance use disorders. We are much more than just the third largest non-profit behavioral health system in the country, our 220-acre main campus, and our network of clinical sites across Michigan. We are a tight-knit community of healers who witness the impact of our life-changing work each day.

Each day, we are closing the gaps in access to care. We are innovating through leading-edge research, testing, programs, and treatment modalities that others replicate across the country. Our services include a state-of-the-art psychiatric urgent care center and a soon-to-be-built pediatric behavioral health center, outpatient, inpatient, partial hospitalization (day programs), assessment and testing, residential, addiction treatment and specialty services such as crisis response, employee assistance programs, forensic psychiatry and psychology, and neuromodulation. On-the-job educational programs for nurses, psychologists, advanced practice providers, psychiatrists, and chaplains are equipping the next generation of care providers.

We are passionate about serving and are honored to be a part of this incredible work.

Advance Practice Practitioner Psychiatry Training Program

Pine Rest is the third largest, freestanding, mental health institution in the country. We are called to express the healing ministry of Jesus Christ by providing behavioral health services with professional excellence, Christian integrity, and compassion.

What Will You Do?

The APP Psychiatry Training Program is a 24-month program with a combination of didactics and on the job training in an outpatient and high acuity setting. The Pine Rest model will focus on developing highly trained APPs capable of working in collaboration to meet the ever-growing need for mental health services in the West Michigan area. It is our belief this closely supervised, and hand-on training provides an excellent opportunity for those desiring to continue their work in the mental health specialty.

Upon successful completion of the first year of the training program, individuals will begin to experience other areas of the organization through part time rotations in high acuity settings while maintaining a part time outpatient practice. Each APP will work in collaboration with a supervising psychiatrist. Trainees will provide initial psychiatric assessments, medication management, work in a multidisciplinary team, and navigate the continuum of services that Pine Rest provides for patients.

  • Master’s level graduates of accredited PA program and/or PMHNP (license psychiatry nurse practitioner). We are unable to accept family nurse practitioners.

  • Base Salary $80,000 - $90,000

Join our Aerodrome team supporting the PAS Contract!

About the Role

We are proud to become a new Australian Department of Defence partner, offering career opportunities to support the delivery of Property and Asset Services across South Australia and the Northern Territory.

We have opportunities available for an Aerodrome Reporting Officer to join our Defence division and support this contract. This is a full-time position based at RAAF Darwin

About us

Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries - we keep communities connected.

Your next role comes with these perks:

  • Career development – we offer growth opportunities and support internal mobility. You will have access to skill enhancement through our online learning system and onsite training.

  • Access - discounts for hundreds of businesses such as Woolworths, Air BNB, The Iconic, JB HI-FI, Dan Murphys, Bupa Health Care, and Specsavers. We also offer access to novated leasing and a share matching program.

  • Culture – we are dedicated to fostering a workplace environment that values diversity and inclusion, and meaningful recognition. You will play a key role in building the culture of our new team.

About the role

You will be responsible for the oversight and provision of day-to-day operational control, compliance and reporting to ensure compliance with DASR / MOS 139 and the AO services plan.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting inspections and maintaining reporting and documentation to support airbase operability and certification.

  • Managing Aerodrome data updates, aircraft manifests, NOTAMs, and OLS impacts, CASA, and Defence protocols.

  • Drafting and monitoring NOTAMs to meet safety and compliance standards.

  • Maintaining FOD register.

  • Completing dangerous cargo documentation and ensure SOPs are current for AO safety and compliance.

  • Coordinating AO maintenance and liaising with BST providers for safe operations.

  • Supporting internal and external audits to ensure regulatory compliance.

  • Investigating incidents and security breaches, reporting outcomes to Aerodrome Operators.

  • Performing sweeping and mowing duties across airside operational zones.

  • Conducting hazard inspections and manage wildlife, environmental, and maintenance risks.

  • Providing ground handling support including fuelling, marshalling, fireguard duties, and equipment operation.

  • Baggage and aircraft loading assistance as required and in compliance with the relevant SOP.

  • Managing of pedestrian and vehicle movements, including escorting duties.

  • Supporting air terminal operations including customer service, passenger and aircrew support, operation of Defence screening equipment in accordance with the relevant SOP.

About you

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Prior experience in a similar role, or a Certificate III in Aviation (Aerodrome Operations).

  • Current certification as an Aerodrome Reporting Officer (ARO) and Aerodrome Works Safety Officer (WSO).

  • Valid Aviation Security Identification Card (ASIC).

  • Aircraft Radiotelephone Operator Certificate (AROC) for airport radio communications.

  • Flexible, adaptable, and effective at prioritising tasks.

  • Skilled in problem-solving and implementing corrective actions.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

You must be an Australian Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Defence Security Clearance.

title: Senior Auditor, Operations
description:
ABOUT US

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs.

It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific.

OUR PEOPLE

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and the rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder. That is why we encourage and enable a wide range of opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and build a meaningful career.

ROLE SUMMARY

This role is based in Bengaluru, India, and forms part of LSEG’s global Internal Audit function.

The role will primarily support audit coverage of the Operations business across Asia Pacific, while also contributing to global audit engagements and priorities. You will work with Internal Audit colleagues and business partners across different countries, functions and time zones.

You will support delivery of the Internal Audit plan by taking ownership of defined areas of audit engagements. You will identify key business risks and controls, complete audit testing, document conclusions and draft clear audit findings in line with Internal Audit methodology.

Working with Audit Managers and Senior Audit Managers, you will contribute to audit planning and scoping, communicate emerging risks and support the timely delivery of high-quality audit work.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

  • Contribute to the planning and scoping of regional and global audit engagements.
  • Develop an understanding of LSEG’s Operations activities, business objectives, risks and controls across APAC and other relevant global locations.
  • Identify and assess key risks and controls within assigned areas of an audit.
  • Design and complete audit procedures in line with the agreed scope and Internal Audit methodology.
  • Perform testing and analysis of business processes, risks and controls.
  • Prepare clear, accurate and evidence-based audit workpapers.
  • Document the conclusions reached from the audit work performed.
  • Draft audit findings that clearly explain the risk, root cause, impact and required action.
  • Validate and communicate the results of audit work with relevant business partners.
  • Confirm the factual accuracy of audit findings and conclusions with business partners.
  • Take ownership of agreed components of audit engagements under the supervision of an Audit Manager or Senior Audit Manager.
  • Coordinate colleagues supporting assigned areas of an audit, where appropriate.
  • Ensure work completed by colleagues on related audit sections follows agreed audit procedures and quality standards.
  • Work collaboratively with Internal Audit colleagues and business partners across APAC and other global locations.

  • Experience using data analysis or audit analytics.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced international or matrix organisation.

We recognise that relevant skills and experience can be gained through different career paths. You do not need to meet every desirable criterion to apply.

This is an opportunity to join LSEG’s global Internal Audit function from our Bengaluru office and gain exposure to a complex Operations environment across APAC and the wider organisation.

You will work with experienced audit, risk and business partners across multiple locations. The role will give you opportunities to develop your understanding of different markets, operating models and regulatory environments while contributing to both regional and global audit priorities.

title: Aerodrome Reporting Officer - RAAF Tindal
description:
Primary Location

NT - RAAF Tindal

Job Description Summary

Join our Aerodrome team supporting the PAS Contract!

About the Role

We are proud to become a new Australian Department of Defence partner, offering career opportunities to support the delivery of Property and Asset Services across South Australia and the Northern Territory.

We have opportunities available for Aerodrome Reporting Officers to join our Defence division and support this contract. We have positions available at RAAF Tindal, Katherine Northern Territory.

About us

Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries - we keep communities connected.

Your next role comes with these perks:

  • Career development – we offer growth opportunities and support internal mobility. You will have access to skill enhancement through our online learning system and onsite training.

  • Access - discounts for hundreds of businesses such as Woolworths, Air BNB, The Iconic, JB HI-FI, Dan Murphys, Bupa Health Care, and Specsavers. We also offer access to novated leasing and a share matching program.

  • Paid leave - parental, cultural, community service, defence, study, corporate volunteering and purchased leave available.

  • Culture – we are dedicated to fostering a workplace environment that values diversity and inclusion, and meaningful recognition. You will play a key role in building the culture of our new team.

About the role

You will be responsible for the oversight and provision of day-to-day operational control, compliance and reporting to ensure compliance with DASR / MOS 139 and the AO services plan.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting inspections and maintaining reporting and documentation to support airbase operability and certification.

  • Managing Aerodrome data updates, aircraft manifests, NOTAMs, and OLS impacts, CASA, and Defence protocols.

  • Drafting and monitoring NOTAMs to meet safety and compliance standards.

  • Maintaining FOD register.

  • Completing dangerous cargo documentation and ensure SOPs are current for AO safety and compliance.

  • Coordinating AO maintenance and liaising with BST providers for safe operations.

  • Supporting internal and external audits to ensure regulatory compliance.

  • Investigating incidents and security breaches, reporting outcomes to Aerodrome Operators.

  • Performing sweeping and mowing duties across airside operational zones.

  • Conducting hazard inspections and manage wildlife, environmental, and maintenance risks.

  • Providing ground handling support including fuelling, marshalling, fireguard duties, and equipment operation.

  • Baggage and aircraft loading assistance as required and in compliance with the relevant SOP.

  • Managing of pedestrian and vehicle movements, including escorting duties.

  • Supporting air terminal operations including customer service, passenger and aircrew support, operation of Defence screening equipment in accordance with the relevant SOP.

About you

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Prior experience in a similar role, or a Certificate III in Aviation (Aerodrome Operations).

  • Current certification as an Aerodrome Reporting Officer (ARO) and Aerodrome Works Safety Officer (WSO).

  • Valid Aviation Security Identification Card (ASIC).

  • Aircraft Radiotelephone Operator Certificate (AROC) for airport radio communications.

  • Flexible, adaptable, and effective at prioritising tasks.

  • Skilled in problem-solving and implementing corrective actions.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).

If you have a strong interest in this role but don't hold all the relevant qualifications, please still apply! We are open to providing training for these with the costs fully covered.

You must be an Australian Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Defence Security Clearance.

How to apply

Please submit your interest with the apply button where you will be directed to create a profile on our system. Applications may be reviewed before the closing date, so please don’t hesitate to apply!

We celebrate diversity at Service Stream and welcome applications from people who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, people with a disability or neurodivergence, and those from LGBTIQA+, Veteran or other diverse groups. Applications are unable to be accepted via email. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please email talent.defence@servicestream.com.au.

Department

Field Services

How to Apply

If this sounds like you apply now to the Service Stream Recruitment Team via the online application button.

Would you like to join a truly international, talent driven company that values Safety, Ethics, Quality, Innovation and Employee Opportunity?

Sigma is growing and is looking for a Quality Inspection Technician for our Malaysian market. Your priority is to fulfill all of the duties as prescribed under the Occupational Safety And Health (PLANT REQUIRING CERTIFICATE OF FITNESS) Regulation 2024 and as below.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare corrective action report for all deficiencies found during 14th Schedule inspection and follow-up with the respective PIC and or Section Manager for prompt closure of the deficiencies.

  • Notify DOSH of any accident or incident involving the lifts and or escalator.

  • Conduct investigation with QP1 and or QP2 and provide Technical Accident Report and remedial action.

  • Support EHS Dept in area of Safety & Health of the employee of the Organization, other people during installation, testing, routine maintenance and repair according to OHSAS Act 1994 and Otis WWJSSS compliances.

  • Conduct ASR/AES/OFAR (annually), update and escalate findings to Department Head.

  • All other responsibilities assigned to you from time to time.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Certificate in Electrical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering/Mechatronics/Electronic Engineering or related technical disciplines

title: Data Analyst / Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Lead Data Engineer / Data Analyst to lead enterprise-wide data engineering, analytics, reporting, and regulatory data initiatives within the Banking and Financial Services domain. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Data Engineering, Python, SQL, PLSQL, ETL/ELT, Snowflake, Data Warehousing, MicroStrategy Reporting & BI, ODI, and Data Analytics, coupled with deep functional knowledge across Lending, Risk, Securities, Tax, Payments, Treasury, and Customer Data Management.

This role will be responsible for driving data strategy, data integration, business intelligence, regulatory reporting, and stakeholder engagement while ensuring data quality, governance, and operational excellence across critical banking data platforms

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering & Data Platform Management

  • Lead the design, development, and enhancement of enterprise data warehouse and data lake solutions.
  • Build and support scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT frameworks, and reporting data marts.
  • Drive data integration initiatives across multiple banking platforms and source systems.
  • Establish data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, and governance standards.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of enterprise data platforms.

Data Analysis & Business Intelligence

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to generate business insights and support decision-making.
  • Develop reporting frameworks, executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and management information systems.
  • Perform data profiling, trend analysis, root cause analysis, and business impact assessment.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to improve reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

Oracle & SQL Development

  • Design and optimize Oracle database solutions supporting enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL programs, procedures, packages, functions, and performance tuning solutions.
  • Perform data extraction, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
  • Troubleshoot database performance, data integrity, and reporting-related issues.

Lending Data Management

  • Support end-to-end lending data covering loan origination, servicing, repayments, collateral, and exposure management.
  • Develop reporting and analytical solutions supporting credit risk and lending operations.
  • Ensure accurate lending data integration across upstream and downstream systems.

Risk & Regulatory Reporting

  • Support enterprise risk data platforms and regulatory reporting initiatives.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and controls testing to meet compliance requirements.
  • Partner with Risk, Finance, Compliance, and Audit teams to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Support internal and external regulatory reporting submissions.

Securities & Capital Markets Data

  • Support securities reference data, trading, settlements, custody, and investment reporting functions.
  • Manage reconciliations and reporting across securities and capital market platforms.
  • Analyze transaction and holdings data to support operational and regulatory requirements.

Tax Data & Compliance Reporting

  • Support tax reporting processes and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Validate tax-related data and ensure data integrity across reporting platforms.
  • Support audit, compliance, and regulatory data requests.

Payments Data Management

  • Support payment processing platforms, transaction monitoring, clearing, settlements, and reconciliation activities.
  • Analyze payment transaction data and investigate operational exceptions.
  • Develop reporting solutions supporting payment operations and regulatory compliance.

Treasury Data Management

  • Support Treasury business functions including liquidity management, cash positioning, funding, investments, and financial risk reporting.
  • Develop and maintain Treasury reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Ensure accurate reconciliation and reporting of Treasury-related financial data.
  • Collaborate with Treasury stakeholders to enhance data quality and reporting capabilities.

Customer Data Management

  • Support Customer Master Data and Customer 360 initiatives.
  • Ensure data consistency, integrity, and governance across customer information systems.
  • Collaborate with business teams to develop customer analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Support regulatory requirements related to customer information management and compliance.

Production Support & Data Operations

  • Provide L2/L3 support for critical enterprise data platforms and reporting applications.
  • Lead incident resolution, problem management, and root cause investigations.
  • Ensure compliance with SLAs, operational KPIs, and production support standards.
  • Drive operational improvements through automation and process optimization.


Who You Are

Desired Candidate Profile

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Warehousing, and BI Reporting environments.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in DataIKU, MicroStrategy, Oracle, SQL, ODI,TWS and Reporting & BI platforms.
  • Extensive experience in Banking and Financial Services organizations.
  • Strong functional understanding of Lending, Risk, Securities, Tax, Payments, Treasury, and Customer Data domains.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting, management reporting, and enterprise analytics platforms.
  • Proven leadership experience managing global teams and stakeholder engagements.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Experience working with senior business leaders, risk teams, and regulatory stakeholders.

Mandatory Skills

Data Engineering

  • Data Warehousing
  • Data Modelling
  • ETL / ELT Development
  • Data Integration
  • Data Quality Management
  • Data Reconciliation
  • Data Governance
  • Data Lineage & Metadata Management

Technical Skills

  • Oracle Database
  • DataIKU
  • Advanced SQL / PLSQL
  • SAP BODS
  • Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Python
  • Shell Scripting
  • Unix / Linux
  • Performance Tuning
  • Data Analysis
  • TWS
  • Snoflake

Reporting & BI

  • Business Intelligence (BI)
  • MicroStrategy
  • PowerBI
  • Reporting & Analytics
  • Dashboard Development
  • Executive Reporting
  • KPI Reporting
  • Data Visualization
  • Operational & Regulatory Reporting
  • Report Reconciliation & Validation

Banking & Financial Services Domain

  • Lending
  • Risk Management
  • Securities & Capital Markets
  • Tax Reporting
  • Payments
  • Treasury
  • Customer Data Management
  • Regulatory Reporting
  • Financial Reporting
  • Compliance & Audit Support

Preferred Skills

  • Business Objects
  • Jira
  • ServiceNow
  • Git
  • DevOps Practices


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Network and Firewall Engineer - Lead
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Kyndryl’s Network, Security & Resiliency is one of our most critical practices, ensuring enterprises, regardless of their size and complexity, remain secure, available, reliable, and resilient. We take Cybersecurity seriously. We're not just invested; we're committed. We're not just protecting data; we're empowering. Kyndryl is committed to making the world safer, not only by investing in state-of-the-art services and technologies but also by empowering underserved communities with essential cyber skills.

When you walk through our doors, you're not only joining a team but you're also becoming part of a legacy. Welcome to Kyndryl, where Cybersecurity isn't just a job – it’s a passion; a commitment to designing, running, and managing the most modern and reliable technology infrastructure that the world depends on every day.

Are you ready to take on the cyber threats of tomorrow? As a Cybersecurity Engineer working alongside our Cybersecurity Architecture team, you'll be on the front line of protecting computer systems and networks from the ever-evolving landscape of hacking, viruses, and malicious attacks. Through the implementation, deployment, and maintenance of security solutions you’ll ensure the utmost confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data. We're not looking for ordinary; we need individuals with deep expertise in specific technologies, a flair for automation, and a passion for developing innovative use cases.

This role isn’t just protecting data – it’s a vital operation for facilitating trust with our customers. With your technical expertise in cybersecurity and infrastructure, covering everything from networks and servers to systems and hardware devices, you'll lead the charge in deploying high-tech solutions that not only meet compliance with regulations and industry standards but also exceed expectations.

As a Network and Cybersecurity Engineer you'll oversee incident response, vulnerability management, and cyber threat hunting. You'll execute security solutions applying cutting-edge technologies like firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, antivirus software, and vulnerability scanners. You will be instrumental in not only addressing threats but also proactively recommending system tuning, identifying new use cases, and providing additional insight from customer and industry data to continually enhance the value of our services.

If you're ready to take on a role where every line of code and every solution you implement could be the difference between security and vulnerability, then Kyndryl is the place for you. Your expertise is not just welcome here – it’s celebrated and valued. Join us as a Cybersecurity Engineer, and together we’ll fortify our cyber defenses making the world a safer place in the digital age.

Your Future at Kyndryl
When you join Kyndryl, you're not just joining a company – you're entering a space of opportunities. Our partnerships with industry alliances and vendors mean you'll have access to skilling and certification programs needed to excel in Security & Resiliency, while simultaneously supporting your personal growth. Whether you envision your career path as a technical leader within cybersecurity or transition into other technical, consulting, or go-to-market roles – we’re invested in your journey.


Who You Are

Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

    • 5 + years of enterprise network/security engineering experience.

    • Proficiency in routing, switching, TCP/IP, VLANs, and troubleshooting network issues.

    • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco Switches, Cisco Wireless LAN controllers, Palo Alto/Cisco firewalls (including Global Protect), Cloudflare, Akamai, Infoblox, and F5

    • Ability to configure, deploy, and maintain firewall policies, security rules, and user authentication (including Global Protect).

    • Experience with VPN technologies (IPSec/SSL), NAT, HA, clustering, and performance tuning.

    • Experience with centralized management tools (e.g., Cisco Catalyst Center, Strata Cloud Manager, Panorama, and Netbrain).

    • Experience with packet analysis tools (tcpdump, Wireshark) and log correlation.

    • Hands-on experience with AI agents or automation frameworks such as integrating LLM based assistance (ex: Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT)

    • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

    • Strong collaboration communication, skills.



    Preferred Skills and Experience

    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

    • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP)

    • Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)

    • Experience building custom AI agents for network operations.

    • Build, train, and tune AI models using network log data for diagnostics and incident triage.

    • Develop and maintain Ansible/Netbrain playbooks and roles to automate configuration management, application deployment, and orchestration tasks.

    • Ability to lead and participate in group projects with global teams.

    • Strong documentation and continuous improvement mindset.

    • Automation skills (Python, Ansible, APIs) are a strong plus.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:

About this role:

Reasonable Accommodations Statement
To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**This position is open to California residents only**

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Job Function & Responsibilities

• Perform advanced statistical and quantitative analysis of healthcare, operational, claims, encounter, membership, and other enterprise data.
• Develop statistical models and algorithms to identify anomalies, patterns, trends, risks, and opportunities that support operational and strategic decision-making.
• Apply appropriate statistical methodologies including regression, hypothesis testing, forecasting, segmentation, outlier detection, trend analysis, and other quantitative techniques.
• Develop and maintain analytical solutions using SQL, Python, R, Power BI, and other approved analytical tools.
• Serve as the analytical owner or subject matter resource for assigned operational domains.
• Develop enterprise dashboards, reports, data visualizations, and analytical products that translate complex information into actionable business insights.
• Automate recurring analytical processes, regulatory metrics, operational KPIs, and data validation activities.
• Analyze large and complex datasets from multiple sources and identify relationships, trends, data-quality issues, and opportunities for improvement.
• Perform data profiling, validation, reconciliation, and quality analysis to ensure analytical outputs are accurate, complete, and appropriate for their intended use.
• Develop and maintain data models, analytical datasets, data definitions, and source-to-target mapping documentation.
• Partner with business stakeholders to define analytical questions, identify appropriate methodologies, establish measures of success, and translate findings into business recommendations.
• Collaborate with Information Technology, Enterprise Analytics, developers, data engineers, consultants, and other technical resources to improve enterprise data assets and analytical capabilities.
• Support development and enhancement of enterprise data warehouse solutions, including Microsoft Azure Synapse and other approved platforms.
• Develop analytical solutions supporting regulatory and operational functions including Grievances & Appeals, Encounters, Risk Adjustment, Claims, Membership, and related areas.
• Evaluate patterns and anomalies within claims and encounter data that may indicate operational issues, payment variation, data-quality concerns, or opportunities for further investigation.
• Develop methodologies to measure operational performance, identify statistically significant variation, and evaluate the effectiveness of operational interventions.
• Perform exploratory data analysis to identify opportunities for new analytical models, measures, and decision-support tools.
• Clearly document analytical methodologies, assumptions, limitations, data sources, and results.
• Present complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences in a clear and actionable manner.
• Provide analytical guidance and technical support to Data Analyst I staff and other members of the Operations Analytics team as appropriate.
• Participate in cross-functional projects and enterprise initiatives requiring advanced analytical expertise.
• Maintain awareness of emerging analytical techniques and technologies and recommend opportunities to improve the department's analytical capabilities.
• Ensure analytical solutions meet business requirements, organizational standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
• Provides subject matter expertise.Perform other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Education & Experience:
• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or another quantitative or related field.
• Five plus (5+) or more years of progressively responsible experience performing data analysis, statistical analysis, business intelligence, or related analytical work.
• Demonstrated experience writing complex SQL queries and working with relational databases.
• Demonstrated experience developing reports, dashboards, or analytical solutions using Power BI or another data visualization platform.
• Experience applying statistical methods to business or operational problems.
• Makes informed decisions within scope of role.

Equivalent In lieu of degree: Will accept experience in any combination of academic education, professional training, or work experience, which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position.
• Nine (9) or more years of progressively responsible experience performing data analysis, statistical analysis, business intelligence, or related analytical work


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES
Preferred Qualifications:
• Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Economics, Analytics, Computer Science, or another quantitative field.
• Healthcare or managed care analytics experience.
• Medi-Cal/Medicaid or Medicare managed care experience.
• Experience analyzing healthcare claims, encounters, membership, eligibility, or risk adjustment data.
• Experience developing statistical models using large and complex datasets.
• Experience with anomaly detection, predictive modeling, forecasting, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, or other applied statistical techniques.
• Experience developing automated analytical workflows.
• Experience working with enterprise data warehouses and cloud-based analytical platforms.
• Experience communicating analytical findings and recommendations to business leaders and executive audiences.
• Knowledge of healthcare regulatory reporting and data-quality requirements.


Technology & Software Skills:
Required
• Advanced SQL/T-SQL
• Relational databases
• Power BI or comparable data visualization platform
• Advanced Microsoft Office skills
Preferred:
• Python and/or R for statistical analysis and data manipulation
• Microsoft Azure
• Azure Synapse Analytics
• Databricks
• Git or other version-control tools
• Statistical modeling and machine-learning libraries
• Data warehouse and data modeling tools

Competency Statements:
• Advanced Analytical Skills – Ability to apply quantitative and statistical methods to complex business problems and develop meaningful conclusions from data.
• Statistical Reasoning – Ability to select appropriate analytical methodologies, evaluate statistical results, recognize limitations, and communicate findings accurately.
• Business Acumen – Ability to understand operational objectives and translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.
• Problem Solving – Ability to independently investigate complex problems, identify root causes, and develop data-driven solutions.
• Data Quality – Ability to assess the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and appropriateness of data used for analytical purposes.
• Systems Analysis – Ability to understand relationships among business processes, information systems, data structures, and analytical outputs.
• Decision Making – Ability to formulate sound recommendations using available quantitative and qualitative information.
• Strategic Thinking – Ability to identify how analytical capabilities can support long-term organizational and operational objectives.
• Communication, Oral – Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Communication, Written – Ability to document analytical methods, findings, assumptions, and recommendations clearly and concisely.
• Presentation Skills – Ability to effectively present analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
• Relationship Building – Ability to establish effective partnerships with operational, technical, and analytical stakeholders.
• Collaboration – Ability to work effectively across departments and disciplines to solve complex business problems.
• Initiative – Ability to independently identify analytical opportunities and develop solutions with appropriate guidance.
• Time Management – Ability to prioritize and complete multiple analytical initiatives within established deadlines.
• Continuous Learning – Ability to remain current with evolving analytical methods, technologies, and industry practices.

title: Director, Enterprise AI Communications
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.

We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world’s most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come. As the Director, Enterprise AI Communications at Gilead, you will own Gilead's internal AI communications narrative, helping employees, leaders and key stakeholders understand what AI means for the company, how it connects across workstreams and how it supports our mission, employee experience and impact for patients.

Reporting into the Corporate & Enterprise Communications team, this role will serve as the communications lead for Gilead's broader AI ecosystem, including Responsible AI, enterprise governance, AI literacy and adoption, priority use cases, executive visibility, employee engagement, cross-functional storytelling and the internal joint council that connects AI work across the enterprise.

The Director will partner closely with Information Technology, Human Resources, Development, Legal, Compliance and other enterprise functions to translate complex concepts into clear, meaningful and people-centered communications that build trust, understanding and engagement. The role will also serve as a strategic communications advisor to senior technology leaders and support broader enterprise technology communications priorities.

We are open to this position sitting at our Foster City or Parsippany campus. Foster City is strongly preferred.

Enterprise AI Strategy & Narrative

  • Develop and execute an enterprise communications strategy that supports Gilead's AI vision, priorities and long-term roadmap.

  • Create compelling narratives that connect AI capabilities to business outcomes, employee experience, responsible use and patient impact.

  • Own and maintain a consistent internal AI narrative and messaging platform across workstreams, audiences, channels, leadership teams and the internal joint council.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible and engaging communications for non-technical audiences.

  • Monitor AI developments across the healthcare, biopharma and technology landscape to inform Gilead's internal narrative, leadership messaging and employee communications.

Executive Communications & Thought Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic communications advisor to senior leaders across IT and enterprise functions.

  • Support AI-related communications for leadership forums, enterprise meetings, Board discussions and other high-visibility business moments.

  • Partner with executives to strengthen internal and external visibility around AI innovation and responsible use.

Employee Engagement & Adoption

  • Lead enterprise engagement strategies that build employee awareness, understanding and confidence in AI.

  • Design communications campaigns that promote AI literacy, adoption and responsible use.

  • Showcase priority use cases, success stories and measurable impact across functions and geographies.

  • Partner with HR, IT and functional leaders to support learning, change management and employee engagement initiatives.

Responsible AI & Governance Communications

  • Develop communications supporting Responsible AI principles, governance frameworks and enterprise policies.

  • Ensure clear, transparent and consistent communication around AI risk management, compliance, oversight and employee expectations.

  • Support strategic change communications related to emerging AI capabilities, governance structures and enterprise initiatives.

  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk Management and other stakeholders to ensure messaging is accurate, aligned and responsible.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Technology Communications

  • Lead communications planning and execution for AI initiatives spanning multiple functions and teams.

  • Build strong partnerships across IT, HR, Development, Legal, Compliance, Public Affairs and Corporate Communications.

  • Align stakeholders around integrated communication plans, priorities, milestones and enterprise narratives.

  • Support broader enterprise technology, digital and transformation communications initiatives as needed.

  • Manage agency and vendor relationships as appropriate.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in communications, liberal arts, business or science-oriented field and minimum 12+ years of experience required OR

  • Masters degree in communications, liberal arts, business or science-oriented field and minimum 1+ years of experience required OR

  • PhD in communications, liberal arts, business or science-oriented field and minimum 8+ years of experience required

  • Relevant experience can be defined as years of healthcare public relations experience

  • Effectively manages all aspects of public relations agency relationships, such as providing direction and project management

  • May manage department staff, as appropriate

  • Develops and implements media relations strategies for specific areas of responsibility, such as product and/or corporate related initiatives

  • Serves as media spokesperson for product and/or corporate news; responds to media requests and arranges interviews with management and opinion leader spokespeople as appropriate

  • Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.

  • Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.

  • Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

title: ASSISTANT, DIAGNOSTIC IMAGING SERVICES
description:
GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Admin Assistant is responsible for providing comprehensive administrative and clerical support to ensure the safe, efficient, and effective operation of the Diagnostic Imaging Services Department. The role includes patient registration, appointment coordination, accurate data entry, management of medical records, preparation and maintenance of departmental documentation, and administrative support for Radiologists, Radiographers, and other healthcare professionals.

As the first point of contact for patients, relatives, visitors, and referring clinicians, the Admin Assistant provides professional, courteous, and patient-centred service while maintaining effective communication and ensuring timely assistance. The position requires excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

The Admin Assistant supports patient safety by ensuring accurate patient identification, maintaining complete and accurate documentation, protecting the confidentiality, privacy, and security of patient information, and promptly communicating relevant information or identified discrepancies to the appropriate healthcare personnel. The role also includes printing and distributing radiology reports, maintaining departmental records, monitoring stationery and stock requests, and supporting departmental administrative workflows.

When required, the Admin Assistant serves as a female chaperone during ultrasound examinations involving female patients, ensuring patient dignity, privacy, comfort, and compliance with hospital policies and professional standards.

In addition, the Admin Assistant participates in departmental quality improvement activities, audits, accreditation programmes, Infection Prevention and Control initiatives, and emergency preparedness activities, while performing all duties in accordance with hospital policies, departmental procedures, regulatory requirements, and applicable accreditation standards.

Through effective administrative support and adherence to patient safety principles, the Admin Assistant contributes to the delivery of safe, high-quality, efficient, and patient-centred Diagnostic Imaging Services.

RESPONSIBLE FOR

  • Performing patient registration, scheduling, and appointment management for Diagnostic Imaging procedures, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Verifying patient demographic details, orders, and documentation before imaging procedures, ensuring compliance with hospital standards.

  • Maintaining and updating patient records in the Hospital Information System (HIS) / PACS, ensuring confidentiality and data accuracy.

  • Coordinating communication between patients, Radiographers, doctors, and other departments to support smooth patient flow.

  • Assisting in billing, and charge entry processes in accordance with hospital finance policies.

  • Monitoring, filing, and retrieving reports, films, and digital images, ensuring timely delivery to physicians and patients.

  • Handling patient inquiries politely and professionally, providing necessary information and directing them appropriately.

  • Supporting the department in clerical tasks such as correspondence, filing, inventory record updates, and document control.

  • Reporting issues related to patient records, scheduling conflicts, or documentation errors promptly to the Head of Diagnostic Imaging Services.

  • Adhering to hospital policies, patient confidentiality guidelines, and regulatory requirements at all times.


JOB DESCRIPTION

ORGANIZATION AND MANAGEMENT

  • Upholds and promotes the vision, mission, goals, and objectives of the Diagnostic Imaging Services (DIS), ensuring clerical and administrative duties support smooth departmental operations.

  • Handles patient registration for all imaging services, ensuring accurate data entry, correct patient identification (two identifiers), and compliance with hospital policies.

  • Arranges and coordinates appointments for Ultrasound, MRI, and other imaging procedures, ensuring schedules are updated and communicated effectively to patients and Radiographers.

  • Acts as a chaperone during Ultrasound examinations, providing comfort and reassurance to patients, while ensuring dignity and privacy are maintained.

  • Updates billing and charges accurately into the system, verifying procedures and consumables used, and ensuring compliance with financial documentation requirements.

  • Notifies and coordinates with duty Radiographers regarding patient arrivals, special requests, and urgent cases to support timely imaging workflow.

  • Prints and distributes imaging reports to requesting doctors and ensures filing is completed in accordance with hospital and departmental standards.

  • Manages front desk activities, acting as the first point of contact for patients, families, and visitors, ensuring clear communication, professionalism, and patient-centered service.

  • Monitors and maintains cleanliness of the registration counter and waiting areas, ensuring a safe, welcoming, and professional environment for patients and visitors.

  • Ensures refreshment stock in the waiting area is available, sufficient, and replenished regularly to promote patient comfort.

  • Oversees linen logistics (clean and soiled linen), ensuring adequate supply of patient gowns, blankets, and related items are consistently available.

  • Maintains stock records for consumables and participates in monthly stock take, ensuring expiry dates are monitored and “soon-to-expire” reports are escalated promptly.

  • Ensures equipment readiness in assigned rooms (e.g., ultrasound), by coordinating routine cleaning, restocking, and maintaining logs in collaboration with radiographers.

  • Supports departmental quality initiatives, including audits, patient feedback, and data entry for reporting purposes.

  • Escalates issues promptly (workflow disruptions, patient concerns, stock shortages, or safety incidents) to the Head of Diagnostic Imaging Services or delegated supervisor for timely resolution.


ADDITONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE SPECIFIC AREA

  • Monitor and replenish clerical supplies (e.g., request forms, labels, stationery) to avoid service interruptions.

  • Provide administrative support during departmental meetings, audits, and inspections by preparing minutes, documents, or required data.


JOB REQUIREMENT ​

1.Education

  • Minimum SPM qualification or equivalent.

  • Additional certification in office administration or related field is an advantage.

2. Knowledge and Experiences:

  • Preferably 1–2 years of working experience in clerical, administrative, or healthcare support roles.

  • Familiarity with hospital or clinical environment is an added advantage.

  • Basic understanding of record management, filing systems, and customer service.

title: Automation Specialist
description:
Hledáte práci, která má smysl a zároveň vás bude technicky bavit? V Zentivě vyrábíme kvalitní a cenově dostupné léky pro více než 100 milionů lidí ve 40 zemích. Přidejte se k našemu týmu v Praze a buďte součástí výroby, která má skutečný dopad na zdraví lidí.

Rozšiřujeme náš tým údržby a hledáme zkušeného kolegu nebo kolegyni se zájmem o automatizaci a výrobní technologie. Budete se starat o spolehlivý chod automatizovaných výrobních zařízení, hledat příčiny technických problémů a podílet se na modernizaci a rozvoji našich technologií.

Pokud vás baví technika, rádi hledáte řešení a chcete se podílet na tom, jak fungují moderní výrobní technologie, můžete být právě vy náš člověk.

Co u nás budete dělat?

  • Zajišťovat technickou správu, diagnostiku a podporu automatizačních technologií výrobních zařízení.
  • Řešit technické problémy a poruchy automatizovaných výrobních zařízení a pomáhat zajistit jejich spolehlivý provoz.
  • Podílet se na modernizaci výrobních zařízení, implementaci technických změn a zavádění nových technologií.
  • Aktivně se účastnit investičních projektů včetně FAT, SAT, IQ/OQ a commissioning aktivit.
  • Spolupracovat na správě a rozvoji systémů serializace a agregace a souvisejících softwarových aplikací.
  • Spolupracovat s PLC Engineery, techniky MaR, výrobou, údržbou, IT a externími dodavateli.
  • Podílet se na standardizaci automatizačních technologií a kontinuálním zlepšování výrobních zařízení.
  • Vést technickou dokumentaci, evidovat změny, konfigurace a servisní zásahy.
  • Podílet se na školení obsluhy a dalších činnostech souvisejících s podporovanými technologiemi.
  • Pracovat v souladu s požadavky GMP, GAMP5, HSE a interními standardy společnosti.
  • Pracovat v jednosměnném provozu.

Jste náš člověk, pokud:

  • Máte SŠ nebo VŠ vzdělání technického směru – automatizace, elektrotechnika, mechatronika nebo příbuzný obor.
  • Máte alespoň 3 roky praxe v oblasti průmyslové automatizace, výrobních technologií nebo technické podpory automatizovaných zařízení.
  • Automatizace vás baví a máte technické a analytické myšlení.
  • Umíte pracovat s elektrotechnickou, projektovou a technickou dokumentací.
  • Máte zkušenosti s konfigurací, diagnostikou a technickou podporou automatizačních zařízení.
  • Dokážete pracovat samostatně, systematicky a berete za svou práci odpovědnost.
  • Umíte spolupracovat s kolegy z různých oddělení i s externími dodavateli.
  • Máte odbornou způsobilost dle NV č. 194/2022 Sb., případně předpoklady pro její získání po nástupu.
  • V angličtině zvládnete práci se základní technickou dokumentací. Pokročilejší znalost angličtiny je výhodou.

Výhodou bude, pokud:

  • Máte zkušenosti se serializací, agregací nebo dalšími automatizačními technologiemi.
  • Orientujete se v průmyslových komunikačních sítích a řídicích systémech.
  • Máte zkušenost s implementací technických změn nebo uváděním zařízení do provozu.
  • Máte zkušenost z farmaceutického nebo jiného regulovaného výrobního prostředí.
  • Znáte prostředí GMP/GAMP5 a výrobní technologie či automatizované linky.

Co Vám nabízíme?

  • Jistotu práce u stabilního zaměstnavatele. Zentiva navazuje na více než 100letou historii výroby léčiv v Praze.
  • Práci v čistém a moderním výrobním prostředí.
  • Možnost pracovat s moderními automatizačními technologiemi a podílet se na jejich dalším rozvoji.
  • Jednosměnný provoz, díky kterému budete mít pravidelný pracovní režim.
  • Možnost profesního rozvoje a dalšího vzdělávání.
  • Podporu zkušených kolegů a důkladné zaškolení, abyste se na nové pozici dobře zorientovali.
  • Veškeré potřebné pracovní vybavení od nás samozřejmě dostanete.
  • Příležitost podílet se na zajímavých technických a investičních projektech a vidět výsledky své práce přímo ve výrobě.
  • Práci, která má konkrétní dopad – pomáháte udržovat technologie, díky nimž vyrábíme léky pro miliony lidí.

Jak probíhá výběrové řízení?

  • Pošlete nám svůj životopis a my se na něj co nejdříve podíváme.
  • Pokud budete splňovat naše požadavky, pozveme vás na osobní pohovor.
  • Na pohovoru se dozvíte více o pozici, týmu i prostředí Zentivy a budete mít prostor zeptat se na vše, co vás zajímá.

Těšíme se na vás! 😊

title: Specials Production Specialist
description:
Role Purpose

The Production Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining an effective production plan to ensure customer demand is met safely, efficiently, and on time. The role acts as the key link between Commercial, Customer Care, Materials Planning, Production, and Logistics, balancing customer requirements with manufacturing capacity, material availability, and inventory targets.

The Production Planner will utilise systems such as SAP, POMS, and Excel to create and manage production schedules, monitor operational performance, and drive continuous improvement within the planning process.

Key Responsibilities

Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Create and maintain production schedules for a portfolio of Special Cables products.
  • Develop short, medium, and long-term production plans that optimise available manufacturing capacity.
  • Monitor production run rates and line performance, adjusting plans where necessary to meet business priorities.
  • Balance customer demand, manufacturing constraints, and inventory targets to achieve optimum service levels.
  • Ensure production plans are communicated clearly and effectively to all relevant stakeholders.

Capacity & Performance Management

  • Monitor manufacturing capacity and identify potential bottlenecks or constraints.
  • Work closely with Shift Coordinators and Production teams to ensure the appropriate resources and production lines are available to execute the plan.
  • Support production recovery plans following downtime, delays, or changes in demand.
  • Participate actively in daily production stand-up meetings and lead daily production planning review meetings.

Materials & Inventory Management

  • Collaborate closely with Material Planners to ensure material availability aligns with production requirements.
  • Communicate changes in demand, priorities, and schedule adjustments to the material planning team in a timely manner.
  • Ensure materials are requisitioned and available at the production line before scheduled production starts.
  • Maintain appropriate levels of Work in Progress (WIP) inventory to support efficient production flow.
  • Maintain finished goods inventory levels in line with agreed stock policies and customer service requirements.

Customer Service & Demand Management

  • Monitor Available to Promise (ATP) performance and support actions to improve service levels.
  • Monitor On Time Delivery (OTD) performance and proactively address risks to customer deliveries.
  • Work closely with Commercial and Customer Care teams to evaluate customer requests, expedite requirements, and changes in demand.
  • Provide accurate delivery commitments based on capacity, material availability, and business priorities.

KPI & Continuous Improvement

  • Support weekly KPI review meetings as part of the wider Supply Chain team.
  • Analyse planning performance and identify opportunities to improve service, inventory, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain planning reports and data analysis using SAP, POMS, and Excel.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across planning, scheduling, inventory management, and customer service processes.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On Time Delivery (OTD)
  • Available to Promise (ATP)
  • Schedule Adherence
  • Production Plan Attainment
  • Finished Goods Inventory
  • Work in Progress (WIP) Levels
  • Manufacturing Capacity Utilisation
  • Customer Service Performance
  • Inventory Days of Cover (DOC)

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Experience in production planning, supply chain planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and capacity planning principles.
  • Experience using ERP systems such as SAP.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable

  • Experience within cable manufacturing or a similar process manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of POMS or equivalent manufacturing planning systems.
  • APICS/CPIM or equivalent supply chain qualification.
  • Experience working with inventory optimisation and KPI management.

Behaviours

  • Customer focused with a strong service mindset.
  • Proactive and solutions-oriented.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively across functions.
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and escalating risks when required.
  • Driven to continuously improve processes and performance.
