  • Right to Work in the UK

What to expect

  • Full time position, averaging 40 hours per week

  • 4 on, 4 off working pattern

  • 12 hour shifts, typically 8.00pm to 8.00am

  • Flexibility required to work weekends, public holidays, and varying shift times in line with business needs

What we offer

At Four Seasons Hotel London at Tower Bridge, we support passionate people who want to grow, lead and build long term careers within a world class luxury brand.

  • £37,000 annual package inclusive of base salary and service charge plus cash tips

  • Structured 40 hour working week

  • Excellent training and clearly defined career development pathways

  • Strong internal progression opportunities across London and the global Four Seasons portfolio

  • Holiday entitlement increasing with service up to 33 days

title: Tech Hub & Technology Lead
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Tech Hub & Technology Lead

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

This is an exciting opportunity to support Mastercard Multi Centre Strategy, in support of a Mastercard business, which provides Critical National Infrastructure to the UK.



The Mastercard UK company that enables the payments of 90% of salaries, 70% of utility bills, most ATM transactions and every cheque cleared in the UK.

We provide services to over 60 million citizens, and the UK private, public and third sectors.

In 2024, we processed 14 billion transactions, with a value of more than £10 trillion.

The Mastercard UK companies products include Bacs Direct Credits, Bacs Direct Debits, Faster Payments, the LINK ATM network for cash withdrawals, and the Image Clearing Service (ICS) that supports cheque clearing.

Overview
This is an exciting opportunity to join Mastercard as a Pune Site and Technology Leader. This new role has dual responsibilities: acting as the single leadership point of contact for all Pune-based Mastercard colleagues and providing overall Technology leadership for the Pune team.

The ideal candidate is an experienced and credible leader who can build strong relationships, provide clear direction in a dynamic environment, and bring the strategic perspective needed to support Mastercard colleagues and technology priorities.


Role
This role involves supporting and coordinating multiple technology deliveries to ensure alignment with organizational goals and objectives. Responsibilities include managing timelines, budgets, and resources while collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes via Agile frameworks and methodologies. The position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks and implement effective solutions.

The main purpose of this role is:
• Act as the local leadership and escalation point for Mastercard colleagues based in Pune, ensuring clear accountability, appropriate empowerment and effective connection with UK People Leaders.
• Build strong working relationships with Pune-based senior leaders, support functions, partners and vendors to enable effective local delivery and collaboration.
• Communicate Mastercard’s and Vocalink’s strategic vision for future-state business and technology architecture, ensuring stakeholders understand key design and operating model developments.
• Strengthen employee engagement by ensuring Pune-based colleagues are included in local activities, have an appropriate voice, and can raise common barriers to execution.
• Facilitate a collective country’s view on key issues, taking action where appropriate and escalating matters that require broader leadership support.
• Support hiring, retention and colleague experience for Pune-based teams, working in partnership with relevant People Leaders and support functions.
• Oversee the promotion of future-oriented platform technology initiatives and business processes that support innovation and Mastercard’s business strategy.
• Drive improvement initiatives across design and implementation, identifying opportunities for automation, simplification and reduced time to deployment.
• Partner with security, A&T, database and platform teams to ensure architectural standards, operational resilience and appropriate safeguards are maintained.
• Serve as a Technology leader, leading the broader technical community to develop innovations and technological advancements.

All About You
The ideal candidate for this position should:
• Demonstrate senior leadership experience in a complex, multi-national technology or payments environment, ideally with exposure to critical national infrastructure, complex customers and regulators.
• Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to set direction, communicate priorities clearly and translate business and technology objectives into actionable plans.
• Experience leading teams working in Agile methodologies, including SAFe Agile frameworks, with the ability to lead technology delivery through iterative planning, cross-functional collaboration and continuous improvement.
• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage effectively across senior executives, technical teams, support functions, partners, vendors and regulators.
• Proven ability to lead, motivate and develop diverse matrix teams directly and indirectly, creating clarity, accountability and an inclusive culture across locations.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present to senior leadership level and explain complex technical, operational and change impacts clearly and concisely.
• Commercially aware and financially disciplined, with experience managing resources, budgets and priorities across multiple functional areas or complex programmes.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability, using analysis and judgement to identify risks, resolve barriers and drive effective outcomes.
• Commitment to customer focus, operational excellence, continuous improvement and innovation, including opportunities for simplification, automation and more efficient delivery.
• High personal integrity, strong professional ethics and a leadership style that embodies Vocalink and Mastercard values.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The Director provides direct supervision and leadership to the Dining Staffing Manager, Assistant Director of Dining – Retreat Operations, and Dining Services Supervisors. The position maintains a strong and visible presence throughout Dining Services operations and is responsible for providing direction, coaching, accountability, and support to the operational management team. The Director works closely with the Head of Dining, Executive Chef, and Bon Appétit leadership to coordinate operational priorities, staffing, service execution, catering, and the student dining experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide daily operational leadership and maintain a visible presence throughout Dining Services facilities to ensure that service, staffing, food presentation, sanitation, safety, and customer service meet established expectations.

  • Supervise and provide direction to the Dining Staffing Manager, Assistant Director of Dining – Retreat Operations, and Dining Services Supervisors.

  • Oversee staffing, scheduling, and daily employee deployments to ensure appropriate coverage across Dining Services operations.

  • Responsible for the recruiting and hiring process for dining employees including a successful orientation and onboarding process.

  • Manages employee relations in partnership with Human Resources and the union CBA, attend labor relations meetings, and implement relevant action plans.

  • Provide clear direction to supervisors and employees, address operational concerns promptly, and hold employees accountable for established performance and service expectations.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop direct reports and Dining Supervisors.

  • Oversee the day-to-day operation of Gordon Commons, The Retreat, The Express, Street Eats, Catering, and other dining services.

  • Serve as the primary contact for catering needs and provide operational leadership for Dining Services catering, including staffing, scheduling, logistics, and coordination with campus departments and the culinary team.

  • Monitor operational practices and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, staffing, service, and the student dining experience.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, sanitation, food allergy, and Dining Services policies and procedures.

  • Coordinate with Facilities and other campus partners to address equipment, facility, maintenance, and operational needs affecting Dining Services.

  • Collaborate with the Executive Chef to coordinate service execution, ensuring effective communication between culinary and front-of-house operations while maintaining clear areas of responsibility.

  • Respond to student and customer concerns and work with Dining Services leadership to address issues and implement improvements.

  • Monitor labor utilization and operational expenses and identify opportunities for efficient use of resources.

  • Participate in Dining Services planning, leadership meetings, campus committees, and other meetings as needed.

  • Support the development and implementation of Dining Services training, operational procedures, and service standards.

Required knowledge, skills and abilities

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

  • Five years of progressively responsible experience in food service, hospitality, or a high-volume operational environment.

  • Demonstrated supervisory and management experience, including the ability to coach, mentor, develop, and hold employees accountable.

  • Experience with staffing, scheduling, and operational deployment.

  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work effectively with employees, students, campus partners, and external partners.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in an environment with Vassar College and Bon Appétit employees.

  • Comfort using technology to support scheduling, operational, and administrative functions.

  • Availability and flexibility to work evening and weekend hours year-round to support campus dining.

Preferred knowledge, skills and abilities

  • A degree in hospitality, restaurant management, business administration, or culinary arts.

  • Experience working in higher education.

  • Experience working in a unionized environment.

  • Experience managing high-volume dining operations and/or catering.

  • ServSafe Certification.

Compensation

The compensation for this position is $70,300 - $91,500 per year.

When extending an offer, Vassar College considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, budget, and other market and organizational considerations. The starting salary range represents the College’s good faith and reasonable estimate at the time of posting.

title: Security Specialist
description:
Are you ready for a rewarding career challenge?

Unleash your potential at Leidos, where we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customer’s success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Leidos is seeking a Security Specialist at Kadena Air Base in Okinawa, Japan. This role will support a major program aligned with Air Combat Command’s Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) mission. Candidates must already possess an active Top Secret/SCI clearance with Polygraph. As a Security Specialist, you will be a key contributor to the protection and success of this critical mission. If you’re ready to elevate your expertise and play a vital role in national security, we encourage you to apply.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage facets of a Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) program and Special Access Program (SAP) including physical, personnel, information or industrial security.

  • Implement necessary standards, such as SCIF accreditation standards, to ensure physical separation and TEMPEST.

  • Provide security office services, ensuring personnel assigned to SCI and SAP billets meet and maintain all security clearance requirements.

  • Manage the following programs/procedures: Periodic Reinvestigation Program, SAP Nomination Process (SAPNP), Program Access Request (PAR), Media Control Procedures, and Intrusion Detection System (IDS) and the Access Control System (ACS).

  • Manage personnel, visitors and visit requests in databases used by the Intelligence Community to record eligibility and access to SCI, SAP and other caveated programs such as DISS, JADE, Scattered Castles and Air Force Space Command (SCIBS).

  • Maintain the Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) accreditations on SCIFs and SCIF accreditation on any future SCIFs.

  • Maintain Special Access Program Facility (SAPF) accreditations on SAPFs and SAPF accreditation on any future SAPFs.

  • Validate clearances/accesses and prepare and process outgoing Visit Access Requests.

  • Maintain records of incoming and outgoing VARs in accordance with established practice.

  • Conduct Personnel Security functions within special access guidance.

  • Conduct Tier 1 personnel security reviews.

  • Complete and coordinate access request packages for access authorization authority.

  • Create and process waiver packages, to include suspense tracking until completed.

  • Create and manage personnel folders.

  • Create, update and distribute entry authority lists.

  • Prepare classified material for shipment and prepare appropriate forms (AF Forms 310 and 12).

  • Review documents for proper security classification markings and provide guidance for proper overall classification issues.

What Sets You Apart (Required):

  • Active DoW Top Secret/SCI with polygraph

  • Knowledge of DoW, IC and USAF security directives

  • Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years of experience or an Associate’s degree and 6+ years of experience, with 2 years of direct security experience (i.e. junior SSO, Security Assistant or Facilities Manager). Relevant intelligence backgrounds will also be considered. Additional experience can be substituted in lieu of a degree.

title: Associate/Assistant Director, Enterprise Risk Management
description:
[What the role is]

You will work closely with MAS senior management and the Board Risk Committee to provide an enterprise-wide view of the key risks and vulnerabilities that could affect MAS' ability to fulfil its mandate. This unique role offers exposure across the full breadth of MAS' responsibilities, spanning central banking, financial supervision, markets and development, and corporate functions.

[What you will be working on]

As part of a small, high-impact team, you will analyse complex issues, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape management decisions on matters that require enterprise-level attention. You will have the opportunity to engage senior stakeholders across the organisation, influence strategic risk discussions, and contribute directly to strengthening MAS' resilience in an increasingly uncertain environment.

  • Monitor developments across MAS and the external environment to identify emerging risks, evolving threats, and cross-cutting vulnerabilities that may affect the organisation's resilience and effectiveness.

  • Develop enterprise-wide risk insights by synthesising diverse information sources and highlighting implications for senior management and the Board Risk Committee.

  • Prepare high-quality risk reports, assessments, and briefing materials that distil complex issues into clear, actionable recommendations and support informed decision-making.

  • Lead the coordination and review of annual operational risk self-assessments and assurance exercises, providing independent challenge on the adequacy of risk management practices and controls across the organisation.

  • Strengthen MAS' enterprise risk management frameworks, policies, and governance processes to ensure they remain robust, forward-looking, and fit for purpose.

  • Analyse operational risk incidents and significant events to identify root causes, systemic themes, and opportunities to strengthen organisational controls and resilience.

  • Support MAS' participation in whole-of-government resilience and crisis preparedness initiatives, including scenario assessments, contingency planning, and resilience reviews.

  • Partner departments and corporate functions to enhance risk awareness, reinforce accountability, and embed a strong and proactive risk culture across MAS.

[What we are looking for]

We seek intellectually curious and highly adaptable individuals who enjoy tackling complex problems and translating ambiguity into practical insights and solutions.

  • Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to rapidly develop understanding across a wide range of subject areas.

  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to develop clear, coherent, and persuasive narratives supported by sound analysis.

  • Sound judgement and strategic thinking, with an appreciation of both the broader organisational context and operational realities.

  • A practical, solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to develop recommendations that are proportionate and effective.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively and engage senior stakeholders on sensitive matters.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and perform effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

  • Experience or familiarity with enterprise risk management, operational risk management, assurance, audit, policy development, or related disciplines would be advantageous.

  • Familiarity with data analytics, dashboards, or risk reporting tools is a plus.

  • Singapore citizenship is required for this role due to the sensitivity to the nature of work involved for this role.

You will be working in a fast-paced environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and needs of stakeholders, as well as the agility to respond to changes and developments..

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting.

title: Consultant - Legal Technology, eDiscovery and Data Intelligence
description:
We have an exciting opportunity to join Clayton Utz's market-leading Data Intelligence Practice as a Consultant, based in our Brisbane office.

Join our nationally collaborative, high-performing team led by industry leaders Owen Bourke (Partner and Head of Data Intelligence), Loren Harper-Moeskops and Scott Murphy. In this role, you’ll contribute to the design and delivery of cutting-edge technology and AI-augmented workflows that enhance and transform our legal service offering.

We are open to candidates who are recent graduates (or will graduate shortly) with the right aptitude and attitude, or candidates with experience in similar roles. We will provide training and coaching to set you up for success.

The Role

As a Consultant in the Data Intelligence practice, you’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team leading the transformation of how legal services are delivered. In this role, you’ll play a key part in delivering legal technology, AI-driven workflows, and eDiscovery services across a range of matters including class actions, regulatory investigations, large-scale disputes, and other data-intensive matters. Partnering closely with our legal teams and clients, you’ll be part of a team dedicated to turning complex data challenges into structured, defensible solutions.

This role harnesses skills in technology, project management, and client engagement to deliver innovative, high-quality, and value driven solutions for our clients and legal teams. Leveraging industry-leading eDiscovery and AI platforms, including advanced AI-powered review technologies, you’ll create customised solutions designed to address the unique challenges of our clients.

To support your success, you’ll have access to industry leading tools such as Harvey AI, Relativity, Mary, and bespoke solutions like CaseTrace (and more), alongside the people and infrastructure needed to deliver exceptional results.

Skills & Experience

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Qualifications: A tertiary qualification in Law, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Commerce, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: A logical and proactive approach to tackling technical and non-technical challenges, paired with curiosity and a willingness to embrace new skills in a rapidly evolving environment.

  • Analytical Ability: Strong analytical abilities to assess and interpret data effectively, with the capability to prioritise tasks and delegate when necessary.

  • Technical Expertise: Familiarity with legal technology platforms and eDiscovery tools such as Relativity, Harvey, Mary Technology, or similar AI and data analytics tools. While formal experience is a plus, a keen interest and willingness to learn are equally important.

  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail, with the ability to simplify complex data or technology concepts and present them in a clear, accessible way.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling you to explain technical solutions to non-technical audiences, build strong relationships, and positively influence clients and colleagues.

  • Organisational Skills: Solid time management and organisational skills to juggle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced, solutions-driven environment.

  • Teamwork: A collaborative and team-oriented mindset, with the ability to work seamlessly within multidisciplinary teams of lawyers, technologists, and data specialists.

  • Creativity and Innovation: A bold, creative mindset with a passion for challenging the status quo.

Our Data Intelligence Team

Clayton Utz is one of Australia’s leading law firms, representing a diverse range of domestic and international private sector and government clients. As part of our broader Advisory, Risk & Regulation stream, the Data Intelligence practice plays a pivotal role in delivering multidisciplinary solutions tailored for the modern practice of law.

Operating at the intersection of law, data, and technology, the Data Intelligence practice develops innovative solutions that integrate people, processes, and technology. We work closely with legal teams and clients to improve service quality, reduce risk, and deliver defensible outcomes for complex matters.

Our team is a dynamic mix of technologists, lawyers, project management specialists, forensic accountants and data scientists. Together, we form a national collaborative group, leveraging diverse expertise to support matters across all Australian offices and pushing the boundaries to deliver innovative solutions.

Why Join Clayton Utz?


At Clayton Utz, we’re more than just a law firm – we’re a community that values our people and their contributions.

When you join us, you’ll enjoy:

  • Access to professional development programs and career growth opportunities.

  • A focus on health and wellbeing, with initiatives to support your physical and mental health such as discounted health insurance and gym memberships.

  • Up to 26 weeks’ paid parental leave, with flexibility over two years, plus paid superannuation.

  • The option to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave annually.

We prefer to work directly with candidates, if you are interested in this role, please click the ‘Apply’ button or contact the consultant, details below, for more information. Job Description

You will be working on a flexible hybrid schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

The work location for this role is 483 Bay Street in Toronto until approximately late 2026, when the work location will change to the new Mississauga office at 3 Robert Speck Parkway.

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

The Product Manager, Investly is responsible for identifying, prioritizing and supporting new and enhanced product to grow the Investly digital investing platform. This includes research and analysis to identify new or enhanced products and features that support maintaining and evolving the product roadmap for Investly aligned to commercial growth. From this, they will work with Finance for business cases, create high-level business requirements for technical teams and be creating briefs and providing input for go-to-market strategies for brand, paid social, advertising, PR, content, email/mobile, web and other channels for Marketing and other partners. They will also use data to influence and adjust Growth strategies. They will work with Marketing, who would be responsible for journey design, content, MarTech execution and campaign design and delivery related to these priorities.

This role will support long-term strategic product growth plans and translate those plans into tactics for Software Product and Customer Experience teams that align with the business goals and product roadmap.

  • Build and own the product roadmap — setting strategic business priorities and direction — in close partnership with software product and customer experience
  • Lead the strategic roadmap that aligns product priorities, customer insights, and business outcomes across Investly
  • Request and prioritize data requests from technical colleagues and Finance, including qualitative customer experience insights as well as hard financial data
  • Ideate and track in-product A/B tests or experiments to achieve or exceed business outcomes, working alongside technical teams to support delivery
  • Recommend Digital product and Marketing optimizations based on data-driven insights
  • Conduct competitive scans and analysis to monitor and find product opportunities and challenges
  • Work with development teams to prioritize Growth-related product backlog, supporting technical teams to select the items that will deliver the most business impact alongside the Growth strategy
  • Craft compelling briefs for products/services launches and enhancements with unique value propositions
  • Support Marketing and Social teams with guidance for creating product information or educational content (blogs, case studies, videos) aligned to business goals
  • Contribute to brand definition, consistency, communications, and management across all channels
  • Partner with legal, risk and compliance to establish and maintain appropriate oversight in delivery of all marketing materials, through all channels

What We’re Looking For

  • Completed University degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years’ experience with direct to customer digital product, developing strategies, roadmaps and feature prioritization frameworks
  • 2+ years of digital assets experience, crypto is a nice to have
  • Product lifecycle experience, managing a product from concept to launch
  • Defining Product requirements, creating user stories and prioritizing backlogs
  • Knowledge and experience in general marketing, including Customer Journey Analytics or equivalent
  • Experience conducting or leveraging user research, customer interviews, usability testing and or analytics

The Expertise You Bring

  • Strong ability to think strategically by defining a long-term product vision and roadmap
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions in uncertain or ambiguous situations
  • Go to Market experience by partnering with stakeholders in marketing and sales to launch new products or features
  • Strong communicator, with the ability to communicate product strategy to partners and stakeholders at all levels and being able to write clear requirements for technical stakeholders
  • Expert skills in stakeholder management (in particular working with technical developers, marketing and legal) & driving cross-group and cross-functional decision-making
  • Technical fluency with an understanding of system architecture, APIs and technical constraints
  • Execution and Project Management skills with the ability to manage timelines, scopes, priorities and keeping teams aligned and moving forward

Total Rewards That Reflect Your Impact

We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional recognition. That’s why we offer a competitive compensation package designed to support your success today—and your financial well-being tomorrow.

For this role, your total rewards include:

  • Base Salary and Discretionary Performance Bonus: Total annual cash compensation (base salary plus target bonus) ranges from $110,000 to $129,000, based on experience and qualifications.
  • RRSP Contribution: After 6 months of employment, we invest in your future with an RRSP contribution—no employee matching required.

We’re proud to offer a compensation package that aligns with provincial pay transparency requirements.

This posting represents an existing vacancy within our organization—an opportunity to step into a role where your talents will make a meaningful difference.

Some of the ways we’ll help you feel valued and supported as part of our team:

  • Flexible working arrangements - 100% remote, hybrid, and in office options
  • Competitive total compensation, including company contributions to your group RRSP without a matching requirement from you
  • Comprehensive health benefits that start on your first day, with 100% employer-paid premiums, that include up to $6000 annually for mental health services and therapy
  • Parental leave top-up to 100% of your salary for a period of 25 weeks
  • Up to $650 for home office equipment
  • Generous time off policy, including 2 paid days annually to volunteer at a charity of your choice
  • Diversity and inclusion programs, including an active network of Employee Resource Groups
  • Extensive professional development opportunities, including access to over 11,000 training and development courses, tuition reimbursement, and monetary rewards for completing a required designation

We care a lot about fostering a compassionate, people-centric culture, and are proud to have been named one of Canada’s Top 100 employers for the last five years.

title: Senior Blockchain DevOps Engineer - AVP – Digital Assets
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

Accountabilities

  • Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
  • Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
  • Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
  • Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
  • Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
  • Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

  • To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  • Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  • Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  • Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Blockchain DevOps Engineer - AVP – Digital Assets. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. In this role, you will join a team working at the ground floor of a 0-to-1 build. You will help build and operate the DevOps, automation, deployment, and observability capabilities that support Barclays’ next-generation Digital Assets Platform (BDAP). This role will, you will focus on enabling secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of blockchain infrastructure and institutional wallet services that support tokenized deposits, digital cash, stablecoins, tokenized securities, and other regulated digital asset use cases across open and permissioned networks. You will work closely with blockchain engineers, wallet engineers, security teams, infrastructure, architecture, risk, and operations to automate deployments, strengthen production readiness, improve observability, and ensure platform components can be delivered and operated safely within a highly controlled banking environment.

To be successful as a Senior Blockchain DevOps Engineer - AVP – Digital Assets, you should:

  • Have experience building and operating DevOps capabilities for mission-critical production platforms, including CI/CD, release automation, environment management, infrastructure automation, and production deployment support

  • Demonstrate hands-on experience deploying and operating blockchain infrastructure and wallet services, including validators, RPC services, bootnodes, transaction relayers, signing services, wallet APIs, and supporting middleware components

  • Have practical expertise operating platforms within controlled on-premises and hybrid environments, including network segmentation, secrets management, certificate and PKI lifecycle management, firewall controls, infrastructure hardening, and secure service connectivity

  • Be comfortable implementing end-to-end observability across blockchain and wallet service components, including metrics, logs, traces, transaction monitoring, node health, chain synchronization, signing workflows, service dashboards, and automated alerting

  • Apply AI-assisted engineering, DevSecOps, and automation practices to improve deployment quality, accelerate troubleshooting, reduce operational risk, enhance release consistency, and support continuous improvement across BDAP delivery teams

Other highly valued skills include:

  • Experience supporting Ethereum, Solana, Besu, and other blockchain technologies, including node lifecycle management, protocol upgrades, chain-data storage performance, validator operations, and multi-chain platform support

  • Knowledge of institutional wallet infrastructure, transaction authorization flows, signing services, key management integrations, custody workflows, and digital asset transaction orchestration

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Infrastructure-as-Code, configuration management, artifact repositories, API gateways, event streaming, and enterprise platform engineering patterns

  • Understanding of digital asset use cases including tokenized deposits, stablecoins, digital cash, securities tokenization, wallet-driven settlement, and interoperability across open and permissioned networks

  • Ability to work effectively across blockchain engineering, wallet engineering, cyber security, infrastructure, architecture, operations, risk, compliance, and business teams to deliver secure, observable, and resilient platform capabilities

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in our Whippany, NJ office.

Minimum Salary: $120,000

Maximum Salary: $175,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above includes only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

This position is eligible for an incentive award.

title: Human Resource Generalist
description:
At Saputo, we bring good to the table by making high-quality products, investing in our people, and supporting communities around the world . As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best?

The HR Generalist will assist with the administration of the day-to-day operations of the Human Resources functions and duties. You will help support the Human Resources Manager and other department managers with HR related matters. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a high level of trust, confidentiality, good judgment and collaboration.

How you will make contributions that matter…

  • Resolve employee concerns, support coaching and discipline, conduct investigations, and address performance issues.

  • Manage recruiting from staffing needs and job postings through screening, interviews, offers, and onboarding.

  • Compile time and attendance data, submit payroll inputs, complete Workday transactions, and generate reports as needed.

  • Coordinate and communicate employee benefit programs, including health, dental, disability, FMLA, life, flex spending, and retirement plans.

  • Serve as a resource to managers and employees on HR policies, procedures, practices, and benefits.

  • Maintain employee records in HRIS and timekeeping systems, update pay rates, enter new hire data, and review payroll for accuracy.

  • Coordinate employee events and activities with support from employee committees.

  • Support internal and external audits.

  • Help identify and plan development strategies for internal talent.

  • Lead change initiatives and encourage adoption with a positive, proactive approach.

  • Develop employee relations programs that support workforce growth and engagement.

  • Support and implement training initiatives.

  • Coach and support management on workforce and people planning processes.

  • Follow the Saputo code of ethics and apply Saputo Values.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

You are best suited for the role if you…

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • 3 to 5 years HR experience in employee relations, payroll, recruiting, consulting, leadership development, talent development, and/or compensation/benefit administration.

  • Ability to consult with business partners on talent management and organizational design issues.

  • Demonstrates business maturity and integrity, especially when dealing with highly confidential information.

  • High level of Emotional Intelligence (EQ) including strong self-awareness/management and ability to build strong relationships with business leaders.

  • Ability to lead others through the problem-solving and decision-making process.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, HRIS/Workday a plus!

We support and care for our employees by providing them with…

  • Development opportunities that enhance you career fulfillment

  • Meaningful compensation & benefits that help you care for your family

  • Opportunities to contribute to your community and enhance the lives of others through Saputo products

Additional Job Description

Pay Range: $61,820 to $77,275

In the USA, Saputo ranks among the top three cheese producers and is one of the top producers of extended shelf-life and cultured dairy products, with a portfolio of well-loved brands such as Stella, Frigo Cheese, Montchevre, Stella, and Treasure Cave. We also boast a strong foodservice presence, partnering with reputable chain restaurants and broadline distributors.

Whether your expertise lies in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, sales, quality assurance, or in any other function, your role is integral to our success. Associate Content Analyst

Entity Content maintains a central database that connects and unlocks the true value of our content across our products and internal services. We are the starting point for all organization information. The data we provide helps our customers run their business successfully and in accordance with the law and regulations of the markets they operate in. We provide Entity data and Qualified financial content as services to the Industry.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Process and maintain data accurately and in a timely manner onto databases
  • Ensure data accuracy, timeliness and completeness are maintained as per company standards
  • Developing expertise in database and financial knowledge through continuous learning and development. Build up knowledge of financial regulations and market practices/conventions in relevant markets.

title: Head of Growth – DTC Wellness Brand
description:
We’re working with one of the UK’s fastest-growing DTC wellness brands to find a brilliant Head of Growth to join their senior leadership team.

The business has scaled incredibly quickly since launching and is now entering its next stage of growth, with ambitious plans across international expansion, new product launches, retention and subscription.

This is a big role, but they’re not looking for someone who wants to sit above the detail.

They need someone commercial, driven and very hands-on who has already helped scale another DTC brand through a similar stage of growth. Someone who can set the strategy, but is equally comfortable getting into the numbers, challenging creative, looking at CAC and LTV, understanding why a landing page isn’t converting or where customers are dropping out of the funnel.

You’ll have ownership across the full DTC growth engine, including:

  • Paid acquisition across Meta, Google, affiliates, influencer and emerging channels

  • Creative strategy and testing

  • Retention, CRM and lifecycle

  • Subscription growth and reducing churn

  • Shopify, CRO, landing pages and customer journey

  • Growth budgets, forecasting and performance reporting

  • Building and developing a high-performing growth team

We are particularly interested in people who have worked in high-growth DTC businesses across wellness, supplements, beauty or other relevant consumer categories and can demonstrate that they’ve genuinely helped scale a brand.

You will have experience scaling significant paid media budgets, strong knowledge of Klaviyo, CRM and retention, and understand how acquisition, conversion, repeat purchase and subscription all work together.

Subscription experience would be a big plus.

This could suit an established Head of Growth, but we’re equally open to someone ready to step up into their first Head of Growth role. The important thing is that you’ve been part of scaling a high-growth DTC brand, understand what it takes to get to the next stage, and are excited by the opportunity to take real ownership of growth.

There’s meaningful equity, the opportunity to build your own team and a genuine seat at the table alongside the Founder and senior leadership team.

We would love to respond to every application however due to the volume of applications we receive this isn't always possible. If you have not heard within 2 weeks of applying, please assume on this occasion that your application has not been shortlisted. We may retain your CV to contact you about future employment opportunities that are being managed by The Growth Foundation Talent.

The Growth Foundation Talent is deeply committed to building a diverse & inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

title: Manager DevOps Engineer
location: United States of America, Eagan, Minnesota
description:
About the Role

Our Platform Engineering team builds and operates the core backend systems that power CoCounsel's AI agent platform — the infrastructure that lets legal AI agents run reliably at scale. We own the services that sit between product-facing chat/agent experiences and the AI runtime layer, the CI/CD and deployment infrastructure that ships them safely, and the internal developer tooling that other engineering teams build on. We work closely with product, applied-AI, and platform teams to ship AI-driven capabilities faster and more reliably across the business.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of platform engineers, owning both their technical output and their growth — staying close enough to the architecture and code to make sound calls, while driving the team's roadmap and priorities in partnership with engineering leadership.

What you will do

  • Own people-management responsibilities for a team of platform engineers — hiring, performance management, career development, and workload/priority balancing — while remaining technically engaged in architecture and code-level decisions.

  • Set and communicate team-level technical strategy and roadmap in partnership with engineering leadership, translating business priorities into an execution plan.

  • Guide the design and delivery of backend and platform services that power AI agent workflows — request/event ingestion, agent orchestration, document and file handling — ensuring reliability and delivery speed for product teams building on the platform.

  • Steer the evolution of the CI/CD and progressive-delivery infrastructure that lets both customer-facing product systems and internal developer tooling ship safely and continuously — including release-decoupling work that separates code deployment from customer-facing exposure.

  • Ensure the team owns and evolves the cloud infrastructure the platform runs on — provisioning, capacity planning, and environment configuration — using Infrastructure-as-Code practices.

  • Champion sound backend architecture with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability across a microservices/event-driven system, influencing long-term platform direction.

  • Drive cross-functional technical initiatives with product, applied-AI, and infrastructure teams, aligning priorities and de-risking complex, multi-system projects from design through production.

  • Raise the bar on engineering practices — code quality, automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence — across the platform stack.

  • Champion observability across the platform — metrics, logging, and tracing — ensuring your team and downstream teams have the visibility needed to operate complex systems with confidence.

  • Ensure strong operational posture for the team's services — monitoring, incident response, and root-cause analysis for production systems running on managed cloud AI runtimes (e.g. AWS Bedrock AgentCore) and Kubernetes.

  • Ensure the team maintains a healthy on-call rotation supporting our customer-facing systems and critical internal tooling, and participate in it yourself — treating every incident as an opportunity to protect the customer experience.

  • Grow technical leadership within the team, fostering a culture of learning, ownership, and continuous improvement.

About you

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including prior technical leadership or people-management experience, with a track record designing, building, and operating large-scale backend systems in production.

  • Demonstrated experience leading a team directly — 1:1s, performance reviews, hiring, career development — while staying credible at the code/architecture level.

  • Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or similar) or another backend language, with deep experience in distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native development.

  • Hands-on expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL), caching/messaging systems (Redis), API design, and AWS, including container orchestration with Kubernetes (EKS).

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline engineering and progressive/safe delivery patterns, and release engineering (decoupling deployment from release exposure).

  • Infrastructure-as-Code practices for managing cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Datadog) for building and operating production systems.

  • Experience operating systems built on or integrating with LLM/Generative AI infrastructure is a strong plus.

  • Demonstrated strength in system design, debugging, and performance optimization, with the ability to make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term scalability.

Nice to Have

  • Proven ability to influence technical direction without direct authority, and to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences and leadership.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS CDK specifically is a nice-to-have.

title: Part-Time Financial Services Representative
description:
The Financial Services Representative (FSR) is responsible for driving loan sales, managing past-due accounts, preparing tax returns, and working directly with customers to meet financial needs. This role requires daily outbound calling, including high-volume collection activity, meeting with customers in person, and closing loans. The FSR is accountable for keeping accounts current while consistently generating new business. Success in this role requires the ability to manage a fast-paced workload, handle challenging conversations, and meet performance goals across sales, collections, tax services, and branch operations, with opportunities for performance-based earnings and advancement.

Compensation

$15 per hour, based on experience and location, plus performance-based bonus opportunities. Total earnings increase with strong individual and branch performance.

Why Join World:

  • Strong growth opportunities – Many of our leaders, including executives, started in this role

  • Promote-from-within culture – A large percentage of team members advance into leadership roles

  • Performance-based earnings – Bonus opportunities tied to branch results

  • Comprehensive benefits for all stages of life – Including major medical, dental, vision, life insurance, long-term disability, and free mental health support

  • Retirement and time off – 401(k) with company match, paid holidays, and vacation time

  • Community focus – Paid volunteer time and a strong commitment to giving back

  • Work-life balance – Predictable schedules with a focus on time outside of work

About World Finance:

World Finance has been recognized as a Top Workplace USA for six consecutive years and a Newsweek Most Trustworthy Company. Since 1962, we have helped millions of customers meet their financial needs through personal loans, tax services, and credit-building solutions. With over 1,000 branches across 16 states, we are committed to serving the communities where we live and work.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Drive and close loan sales by taking applications, explaining terms, and asking for the business

  • Conduct substantial daily outbound customer outreach for collections, application follow-up, tax services, and new business generation; thrive in a high-volume, phone-intensive environment

  • Manage delinquent accounts by securing payments and setting payment arrangements

  • Contact approved, pending, and former borrowers to drive loan volume and identify opportunities for additional financial products and services

  • Prepare individual tax returns, gather and review required documentation, and assist customers with tax-related questions in compliance with company policies and applicable regulations

  • Assist customers in person with loan applications, tax preparation services, payments, account questions, and issue resolution

  • Process payments, account updates, tax-related documentation, and document all activity in company systems

  • Maintain accurate and compliant records, including timely credit denial letters and required tax documentation

  • Handle and balance cash, and complete required bank runs to deliver deposits

  • Follow company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements

  • Complete required training and meet performance expectations for sales, collections, tax preparation, and account management

Basic Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, and current insurance

  • Must be able to independently perform all required bank runs, including transporting deposits, without relying on non-employees for transportation

  • Ability to obtain required insurance licensing

Experience & Skills:

  • Experience in sales, customer service, collections, or account management with measurable results

  • Proven ability to handle high-volume calls and difficult customer conversations

  • Track record of meeting or exceeding goals in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills

  • Basic computer skills with accurate and consistent data entry

Preferred Backgrounds:

Experience in banking, retail, restaurants, hospitality, collections, call centers, insurance, healthcare front office, or similar customer-facing roles is preferred.

Physical and Environmental Requirements:

  • Office based role with standard lighting and noise levels

  • Regular in-person attendance during scheduled work hours is essential; occasional extended hours or weekend work may be required based on business needs

  • Combination of stationary work and regular movement throughout the office, including occasional walking, standing, bending, reaching, and similar activities

  • Occasional light lifting, pushing, or pulling of office materials (generally up to 30 pounds)

  • Ability to perform computer work, handle documents, and communicate information effectively

  • Fast paced environment with shifting priorities and deadlines; requires professionalism, adaptability, collaboration, and multitasking

  • Frequent interaction with customers and coworkers; must communicate clearly and professionally in person, by phone, and electronically

  • May assist with general office upkeep to maintain a professional environment

  • Occasional local travel to offsite locations and banks as required for business purposes

This is a term position; length of the term will be discussed during the interview process. Continuation past the term length discussed will be based on university need, performance, and/or availability of funding.

POSITION SPECIFICS

The Harold and Inge Marcus Department of Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering at The Pennsylvania State University, University Park invites applications for a full-time Assistant Research Professor to lead and support research in advanced manufacturing. The position may involve manufacturing process development, joining and separation, repair and remanufacturing, mechanical design, materials and process characterization, sensing, and data-driven analysis for engineered products and systems.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design and evaluate manufacturing processes, components, structures, fixtures, tooling, and/or experimental systems.

  • Characterize process behavior, material response, defects, interfaces, and performance using appropriate experimental, sensing, or machine learning methods.

  • Prepare peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, presentations, invention disclosures, sponsor deliverables, and research proposals.

  • Collaborate with faculty, students, technical staff, industry partners, and government sponsors in multidisciplinary research projects.

Required Qualifications

  • Earned Ph.D. by the appointment start date in mechanical, industrial, manufacturing, materials, welding, product design, or a closely related engineering field.

  • Demonstrated research experience in manufacturing-process development, joining or materials processing, repair/remanufacturing, mechanical or structural design, or closely related areas.

  • Relevant capability in one or more areas such as CAD, materials characterization, process monitoring, machine learning.

  • Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to work effectively and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary research team.

  • Names and contact information for three professional references.

title: GPU Internships - RTL Design, RTL Power Optimisation & Physical Design
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Multifaceted, amazing people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product! Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple’s customers every single day.

The UK GPU team works on IPs that are part of Apple’s world-class GPU designs for Apple Silicon SoCs. We are seeking highly motivated, innovative and confident individuals to join us, across the following areas: RTL Design. RTL Power Optimisation and Physical Design. You will be at the centre of a chip design effort working with all disciplines, with a critical impact on getting high performant products to millions of Apple customers efficiently.

Locations: These internships can be based in London Bishopsgate, St Albans or Cambridge. You may express your location preferences if selected for interview.

Start dates: Winter 2026 or Spring / Summer 2027.

Key Dates: Applications will close by mid-October. Initial interviews will take place in October, with final round interviews in November.

We are hiring for the below internships in the academic year 2026/2027.

RTL Design: You will assist with delivering high quality IP in order to meet performance, feature, timing, area and power goals. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with Design Engineers, as well as work alongside our platform architecture, functional verification and physical design teams that are responsible for our GPU products. Your designs will need to balance energy efficiency and area constraints with project schedule and maintainability.

RTL Power Optimisation: Join us as a Power Intern and play a pivotal role in shaping cutting-edge IP technology. In this dynamic internship, you'll dive deep into the power estimation/optimisation of next-generation silicon designs. Your responsibilities will include analysing and optimising power takedown strategies, setting targets for future IP, and generating insightful power data to drive critical decisions. You'll also have the exciting opportunity to innovate and enhance methodologies for power data extraction and reporting, making meaningful contributions to the efficiency and performance of our products. Collaborate with top-tier engineers, expand your technical expertise, and gain hands-on experience in the fast-evolving world of silicon hardware.

Physical Design: As an intern you will join the GPU PD team, working on the physical design of new Apple products and learning how a modern ASIC design flow works. With mentorship, you will work through all the aspects of physical design from the floorplanning of blocks, placement and routing. You will partner with engineers to identify metrics and analyse results, help write scripts to automate flows and help to improve these key metrics. You will utilise the latest technologies and learn from experienced engineers. Partnering with the RTL Design teams will be key to understand chip architecture and how physical design needs to work with these teams to achieve world beating results. Are you a confident problem solver who thrives under pressure to find new, creative solutions? Are you ready to help chart the future of Apple's ecosystem? If so, we are excited to hear from you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • At the end of the internship, you must return to school to continue your education or the internship must be the last requirement for you to graduate.
  • A curiosity about GPU / CPU architecture and micro-architecture
  • Strong coding skills with C or C++ for internships in RTL Design and RTL Power Optimisation
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Perl, Python or Ruby
  • Familiarity with SystemVerilog / Verilog / VHDL

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong interpersonal and analytical skills
  • Ability to work well within a team and be productive under tight schedules
  • An understanding of STA and Synthesis for an internship in Physical Design

title: Regional Controller – MENA (Saudi Nationals Only)
description:
Company:

Marsh Corporate

Description:

Regional Controller – MENA | Saudi Nationals Only

Company: Marsh
Location: Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
Business line supported: Consulting – Oliver Wyman and Mercer
Reporting to: KSA Controller / Regional Finance Leadership

Important eligibility requirement

This position is open exclusively to Saudi nationals. Applicants must hold Saudi Arabian citizenship and be eligible to work in Riyadh. Applications from non-Saudi nationals cannot be considered for this vacancy.

About Marsh

Marsh is a global leader in risk, strategy and people, advising clients in more than 130 countries. With approximately 85,000 colleagues worldwide and annual revenue exceeding $23 billion, Marsh operates through four market-leading businesses:

  • Marsh – Commercial insurance broking and risk management

  • Guy Carpenter – Reinsurance broking and strategic advisory

  • Mercer – Health, wealth and career consulting

  • Oliver Wyman – Management consulting and strategy advisory

Together, these businesses help organizations navigate an increasingly dynamic and complex environment.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Regional Controller – MENA to join our finance leadership team in Riyadh. This role is central to the controllership function supporting our consulting businesses, Oliver Wyman and Mercer, across the MENA region.

Oliver Wyman has expanded significantly in the region through acquisitions, organic growth and entry into new country markets. Mercer is similarly scaling through acquisitions and a broader regional presence. This creates a high-impact opportunity for a senior finance professional to shape and strengthen the financial control framework across a rapidly growing portfolio.

You will act as a key finance partner to senior leadership, working closely with partners, business heads and regional stakeholders to ensure financial integrity, regulatory compliance and commercial insight across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country operation.

Based in Riyadh, the role will provide close partnership to KSA leadership while supporting continued expansion across the Gulf and wider MENA region.

Key responsibilities

Financial controllership and reporting

  • Lead the regional controllership function for Oliver Wyman and Mercer across MENA.

  • Manage monthly close, financial consolidation and group reporting in line with global timelines and standards.

  • Oversee statutory reporting, budgeting and forecasting across multiple entities and jurisdictions.

  • Ensure the accuracy, completeness and integrity of financial reporting across the regional portfolio.

Revenue recognition

  • Lead revenue recognition for consulting and project-based engagements, including work-in-progress management, percentage-of-completion accounting and IFRS 15 compliance.

  • Ensure consistent and accurate revenue reporting across Oliver Wyman and Mercer.

  • Partner with commercial and operational stakeholders to address complex engagement-accounting matters.

Tax compliance and advisory

  • Oversee regional tax compliance, with particular focus on applicable Saudi corporate income tax and Zakat requirements.

  • Ensure compliance with VAT requirements in KSA and across the GCC.

  • Monitor corporate tax developments and local filing requirements across MENA.

  • Support transfer-pricing requirements and coordinate with group tax specialists.

  • Liaise with ZATCA and other local tax authorities as required.

Governance, controls and compliance

  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks appropriate for a large global organization.

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, IFRS and group policies.

  • Oversee local statutory and payroll compliance in KSA.

  • Support compliance with Saudi labor requirements and applicable Saudization and localization programs.

  • Identify financial and operational risks and ensure that appropriate mitigating controls are implemented.

Stakeholder engagement

  • Act as a trusted finance partner to senior leaders, partners and business heads at Oliver Wyman and Mercer.

  • Communicate financial performance, risks and opportunities clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.

  • Translate complex financial information into practical and commercially relevant recommendations.

  • Build effective relationships across local, regional and global finance teams.

Business growth and expansion

  • Support acquisitions, integrations and new-country setups as the consulting businesses continue to expand.

  • Help build the financial infrastructure required to support regional growth.

  • Support KSA market expansion, regional-headquarters requirements and local entity setup.

  • Ensure that new businesses and entities are integrated into appropriate reporting, governance and control frameworks.

What we are looking for

Mandatory eligibility and qualifications

  • Saudi national – this vacancy is open exclusively to citizens of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

  • Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CIMA, CPA, CA or an equivalent recognized designation.

  • Approximately 10–16 years of progressive finance experience, with a strong focus on financial controllership.

  • Ability to work from Riyadh and partner closely with KSA-based leadership.

Experience and expertise

  • Proven controllership experience within a large multinational and matrixed organization.

  • Strong revenue-recognition expertise, ideally gained in consulting, professional services or another project-based business.

  • Practical knowledge of IFRS, particularly IFRS 15.

  • Strong understanding of work-in-progress, percentage-of-completion accounting and project profitability.

  • Middle East tax knowledge, particularly Saudi VAT, corporate income tax and Zakat requirements, as well as GCC VAT regimes.

  • Experience managing finance operations across multiple countries and legal entities.

  • Strong understanding of statutory reporting, financial consolidation, budgeting and forecasting.

  • Demonstrated ability to engage with and influence senior stakeholders, including partners and business leaders.

Personal attributes

  • Commercially minded, with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insight.

  • Credible and confident communicator who can build trust with senior leadership.

  • Proactive, detail-oriented and comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • Collaborative, with a track record of working effectively across functions, countries and reporting lines.

  • Comfortable balancing technical controllership requirements with broader commercial priorities.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience in management consulting or professional services.

  • Big Four experience in an advisory, accounting-consulting or finance-transformation capacity, rather than exclusively external audit.

  • Experience with Oracle, SAP, HFM/Hyperion or comparable ERP and consolidation systems.

  • Multi-entity finance experience across MENA.

  • Previous professional experience in Saudi Arabia.

  • Experience supporting acquisitions, finance integrations, regional-headquarters structures or new-country setups.

  • Familiarity with KSA payroll, labor requirements and Saudization or localization programs.

What we offer

  • A senior finance role at the heart of one of the world’s largest and most respected professional-services organizations.

  • Exposure to two of Marsh’s highest-growth businesses in the region: Oliver Wyman and Mercer.

  • The opportunity to shape regional financial operations during a period of significant expansion.

  • Close partnership with senior business and finance leaders across KSA and MENA.

  • A collaborative, high-caliber and internationally connected working environment.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

  • Long-term career development within a global organization.

Application information

Please apply only if you are a Saudi national and meet the mandatory eligibility requirements stated above. Nationality and right-to-work eligibility will be verified as part of the recruitment process.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
