title: Customer Relationship-Japanese
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Role involves managing and optimizing IT infrastructure- good at providing analysis, documenting and diagraming work for hand-off, offering timely solutions, and generally “figuring it out.” This is a hands-on role where your feel for the interaction between a system and its environment will be invaluable to every one of your clients.

There are two halves to this role: First, contributing to current projects where you analyze problems and tech issues, offer solutions, and test, modify, automate, and integrate systems. And second, long-range strategic planning of IT infrastructure and operational execution. This role isn’t specific to any one platform, so you’ll need a good feel for all of them. And because of this, you’ll experience variety and growth at Kyndryl that you won’t find anywhere else.

You’ll be involved early to offer solutions, help decide whether something can be done, and identify the technical and timeline risks up front. This means dealing with both client expectations and internal challenges – in other words, there are plenty of opportunities to make a difference, and a lot of people will witness your contributions. In fact, a frequent sign of success for our Infrastructure Specialists is when clients come back to us and ask for the same person by name. That’s the kind of impact you can have!

This is a project-based role where you’ll enjoy deep involvement throughout the lifespan of a project, as well as the chance to work closely with Architects, Technicians, and PMs. Whatever your current level of tech savvy or where you want your career to lead, you’ll find the right opportunities and a buddy to support your growth. Boredom? Trust us, that won’t be an issue.

Your future at Kyndryl
There are lots of opportunities to gain certification and qualifications on the job, and you’ll continuously grow as a Cloud Hyperscaler. Many of our Infrastructure Specialists are on a path toward becoming either an Architect or Distinguished Engineer, and there are opportunities at every skill level to grow in either of these directions.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Professional Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in an IT or technical setting.
  • Fluent in Japanese (JLPT N3 or above) and English, both written and verbal. Proficiency in IT systems, including networks, hardware, software, and troubleshooting.
  • Experienced in handling client communication and negotiations.
  • Excellent in Japanese skills both translation and interpretation
  • Proven hands-on experience in SCRUM or Project Management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Hands-on experience with cloud technologies, databases, or programming languages is a plus.
  • Experience with IT service management tools (e.g., Service Now, Jira).


Preferred Professional Experience

  • Certifications in Japanese language proficiency JLPT N2 or above
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical information to non-technical individuals
  • Experience in working with Japanese clients or in a multicultural team is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Mainframe domain.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.


Being You

title: Hematology & Oncology Physician
description:
Your job is more than a job.

    Hematology & Oncology Physician

    East Jefferson General Hospital | LCMC Health
    Metairie, Louisiana (Greater New Orleans Area)

    Advance Prostate Cancer Care. Transform Lives.

    East Jefferson General Hospital, a proud member of LCMC Health, is seeking a Board Certified/Board Eligible Hematology & Oncology Physician with expertise or a strong clinical interest in Prostate Oncology to join our growing cancer services team.

    This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a nationally recognized health system committed to delivering innovative, patient-centered cancer care. The ideal candidate will play a key role in the diagnosis, treatment, and long-term management of patients with prostate cancer while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team dedicated to advancing oncology care across the region.

    Located in the heart of the Greater New Orleans area, East Jefferson General Hospital offers physicians the opportunity to practice in a collaborative environment that combines leading-edge medicine with a vibrant and culturally rich community.

    Position Highlights

    • Join an established and growing oncology program within LCMC Health.
    • Focus on the treatment and management of patients with prostate cancer and other genitourinary malignancies.
    • Collaborate closely with urology, radiation oncology, surgery, pathology, radiology, and supportive care teams.
    • Access to advanced cancer treatment technologies and clinical resources.
    • Opportunity to contribute to program development, quality initiatives, and service line growth.
    • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

    Responsibilities

    Clinical Care

    • Provide comprehensive hematology and oncology care with a focus on prostate cancer and genitourinary malignancies.
    • Evaluate, diagnose, and develop individualized treatment plans utilizing evidence-based practices.
    • Manage patients throughout the continuum of care, including diagnosis, active treatment, survivorship, and supportive care.
    • Perform routine examinations, prescribe treatments, and monitor therapeutic outcomes.
    • Collaborate with multidisciplinary cancer teams to optimize patient outcomes and treatment planning.
    • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of patient encounters and clinical decisions.
    • Respond to patient calls, messages, and care concerns in a timely and professional manner.

    Patient Access & Care Coordination

    • Participate in a shared physician call schedule.
    • Support timely patient access and continuity of care.
    • Collaborate with referring providers and specialists to ensure seamless care transitions.

    Quality & Safety

    • Promote patient safety and adherence to infection prevention standards.
    • Participate in quality improvement, regulatory compliance, and patient experience initiatives.
    • Recognize and appropriately respond to emergent clinical situations.

    Leadership & Program Development

    • Support service-line growth and strategic oncology initiatives.
    • Participate in multidisciplinary tumor boards and physician leadership activities.
    • Contribute to efforts that expand access to advanced prostate cancer care throughout the region.

    Qualifications

    Education

    • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) from an accredited institution.

    Training

    • Completion of an accredited Internal Medicine Residency Program.
    • Completion of an accredited Hematology and Medical Oncology Fellowship.

    Licensure & Certifications

    • Eligible for or currently holding unrestricted Louisiana medical licensure.
    • Board Certified or Board Eligible in Hematology and Medical Oncology.
    • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification through the American Heart Association.
    • Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification preferred.
    • Eligible for medical staff membership and clinical privileges at East Jefferson General Hospital.

    Why East Jefferson General Hospital?

    East Jefferson General Hospital has served the Greater New Orleans community for more than 50 years and is recognized for delivering exceptional patient care, clinical excellence, and innovation. As part of LCMC Health, you'll join a physician-led organization committed to improving the health of our communities while supporting professional growth, collaboration, and academic advancement.

    If you are passionate about advancing prostate cancer care and making a lasting impact on the lives of patients and families, we invite you to join our team.

    Apply today and help shape the future of cancer care at East Jefferson General Hospital.

    WORK SHIFT:

    Days (United States of America)

    LCMC Health is a community.

    Our people make health happen. While our NOLA roots run deep, our branches are the vessels that carry our mission of bringing the best possible care to every person and parish in Louisiana and beyond and put a little more heart and soul into healthcare along the way. Celebrating authenticity, originality, equity, inclusion and a little “come on in” attitude is the foundation of LCMC Health’s culture of everyday extraordinary

    About East Jefferson General Hospital

    East Jefferson General Hospital, a landmark of LCMC Health’s incredible community of care, has been the go-to hospital for health, wellness, and one-of-a-kind care in East Jefferson Parish for over 50 years. And we’re only beginning to realize our greatest potential. Learn more about East Jefferson General Hospital and our legacy, our future, and our national recognition as a Nurse Magnet Hospital.

    Your extras

    • Deliver healthcare with heart.
    • Give people a reason to smile.
    • Put a little love in your work.
    • Be honest and real, but with compassion.
    • Bring some lagniappe into everything you do.
    • Forget one-size-fits-all, think one-of-a-kind care.
    • See opportunities, not problems – it’s all about perspective.
    • Cheerlead ideas, differences, and each other.
    • Love what makes you, you - because we do

    You are welcome here.

    LCMC Health is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

    The above job summary is intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by people assigned to this work. This is not an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. LCMC Health reserves the right to amend and change responsibilities to meet organizational needs as necessary.

    Simple things make the difference.

    1. To get started, take your time to fully and accurately complete the application for employment. Incomplete applications get bogged down and are often eliminated due to missing information.

    2. To ensure quality care and service, we may use information on your application to verify your previous employment and background.

    3. To keep our career applications up-to-date, applications are inactive after 6 months and, therefore, require a new application for employment to be completed.

    4. To expedite the hiring process, proof of citizenship or immigration status will be required to verify your lawful right to work in the United States.

title: Deputy Constituency Director, Nee Soon South CO
description:

Partnering with the Constituency Director as the Constituency Master Planner to co-lead the planning, coordinating and implementing community initiatives to build social capital and strengthen People-Government-People connectivity. The role drives ground-level engagement across Grassroots Organisations (GROs), Community Centres/Clubs, and Residents' Committee/Network Centres, ensuring that residents are well-served and that the constituency is a cohesive and harmonious community. Through close collaboration with Grassroots Leaders, volunteers, and community partners, the DCD plays a pivotal role in advancing PA's mission of sparking and nurturing community participation for a caring and united Singapore.

• Co-lead constituency planning and GRO development

Formulate, implement, and review annual constituency workplans and GRO development plans in partnership with the Adviser and key Grassroots Leaders in aligning GROs and community partners to national and PA objectives so as to achieve a liveable and harmonious neighbourhood.

Supervise the planning and implementation of community programmes spanning Wellness, Emergency Preparedness, Community Sports, Integration, Family Life, and Youth to widen outreach and deepen resident engagement.

Guide GROs in communicating government policies to residents, gather and analyse ground sentiments, and channel feedback to relevant agencies to support timely and effective policy communication and community sensing.

Supervise the overall administration of the Constituency Office and oversee proper accounting and cash management of GROs and their sub-committees in compliance with PA Financial Rules and Regulations.

Establish and strengthen partnerships with community stakeholders including Voluntary Welfare Organisations, Merchant Associations, and religious organisations to expand PA's community network and co-create resident-centric programmes.

Lead and motivate staff in the Constituency Office to ensure optimal manpower deployment and delivery of quality services in support of constituency and organisational objectives.

Strong community engagement and ground-sensing capabilities Ability to facilitate dialogue and build consensus among diverse stakeholders including GRLs, residents, and government agencies Sound understanding of government policies and the ability to translate them into accessible community communications Good supervisory and people management skills, with the ability to coach and motivate staff and volunteers Competent in planning, organising, and managing multiple programmes concurrently Demonstrated resilience and adaptability in managing competing priorities and changing ground conditions, with a results-oriented approach to programme delivery (newly added)

description:
Come help build the future, where our work makes the world work!

SUMMARY

Green Infrastructure Partners (GIP) is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Chief Engineer to lead the Temporary Works Engineering team within the GTA Construction Group. title: Lead Hardware Systems Engineer
description:
The Air Traffic Management Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Hardware Systems Engineer to work in our Gaithersburg, MD office. This is an exciting opportunity to be a member of a dynamic team working on the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) En-Route Automation Modernization (ERAM) technology, which is the heart of the national air transportation system. ERAM provides the foundational platform for the National Airspace System (NAS) to monitor and manage high-altitude aircraft, increasing flight efficiency, safety, and capacity.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Independently plan and execute hardware engineering projects and processes with significant impact on project deliverables.
  • Develop solutions to complex hardware problems requiring deep technical analysis of system requirements, interfaces, cost, schedule, risk, supportability, and impacts to the overall system.
  • Develop and maintain hardware designs and documentation, including electrical wiring diagrams, cable schematics, interconnect diagrams, cable lists, CAD drawings, Bills of Material (BOMs), Parts Lists, Cable Marking Specifications, and installation instructions.
  • Perform technical analyses and trade studies to evaluate hardware solutions and support product selection.
  • Support the hardware lifecycle, including design, fabrication, integration, verification, installation, testing, troubleshooting, modification, and fielding.
  • Coordinate with Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Site Activation, Procurement, Manufacturing, Integration and Test, Adaptation, and other organizations to resolve technical and interface issues.
  • Support formal engineering change and configuration management processes, including Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), technical impact assessments, and hardware baseline updates.
  • Independently resolve hardware issues identified during integration, testing, and field installation and ensure approved changes are incorporated into the hardware design baseline.
  • Participate in design reviews and influence internal and client project teams regarding hardware solution design, processes, and implementation approaches.
  • Develop level-of-effort estimates, schedules, resource requirements, and Estimates to Complete (ETCs) for assigned hardware activities.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and training to less-experienced engineering and technical staff.
  • Identify hardware design and process improvements that improve quality, efficiency, supportability, and maintainability.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical discipline with 4–8 years of prior relevant experience, or Master's degree with 2–6 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Experience independently executing hardware engineering projects, products, or processes within a technical area.
  • Experience developing solutions to complex hardware engineering problems requiring technical analysis and consideration of impacts to the overall system.
  • Experience developing hardware designs and documentation such as electrical wiring diagrams, cable schematics, interconnect diagrams, cable lists, CAD drawings, Bills of Material (BOMs), and Parts Lists.
  • Experience supporting formal engineering change processes, including ECNs, ECRs, configuration management, or controlled hardware baseline changes.
  • Experience with system-level hardware integration, verification, installation, testing, troubleshooting, technical problem resolution, and deployment.
  • Experience working across engineering disciplines to evaluate interfaces and resolve system-level integration issues.
  • Experience communicating technical analyses and recommendations to internal and client project teams and influencing technical decisions.
  • Experience providing technical guidance, coaching, or training to less-experienced engineering or technical staff.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access, and Visio.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Inventor, Visio, or other CAD software tools.
  • Experience performing hardware trade studies and product selection based on technical, cost, risk, supportability, and implementation considerations.

description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

At HBO Max, storytelling takes center stage. We’re one of the world’s most iconic entertainment brands — home to bold originals and unforgettable characters. While audiences binge award-winning content, breaking news, and sports around the clock, our teams stay busy at work creating what’s next in streaming. From Succession, Euphoria, and The Sopranos to global franchises like Game of Thrones and Harry Potter, our content sparks conversation and shapes culture.

HBO Max delivers boundary-pushing stories across genres and platforms, connecting millions of viewers across 90 countries globally— and we’re just getting started. We're home to the most talked about shows and movies, granting audiences access to the worlds of HBO, Harry Potter, DC, Warner Bros., ID, Adult Swim, A24, and more. Turn your streaming obsession into a career— we’re hiring!

Your New Role

The English Transcriber Specialist supports the creation of English scripting and transcription deliverables for entertainment content, ensuring technical accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery within WBD’s localization lifecycle. The role applies foundational knowledge of scripting, accessibility materials, and entertainment media content while working within established processes, tools, and specifications.

The English Transcriber Specialist is part of a collaborative team supporting global localization and accessibility initiatives across film, television, streaming, and other entertainment media content. The role focuses on accurate transcription, consistent formatting, quality execution, and ongoing skill development while adapting to evolving technologies and workflows.

If you have experience transcribing, captioning, or creating accessibility materials for entertainment media content and are looking to contribute to global content localization, we encourage you to apply.

This role supports highly confidential content and therefore requires regular on-site attendance to work on secure projects.

Key Responsibilities...

  • The English Transcriber Specialist is responsible for creating English transcription and scripting deliverables, including but not limited to Spotting Lists, English Dialogue Lists, Closed Captions (CCAP), English SDH (Subtitles for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing), and English Templates.

  • The role utilizes WBD-approved in-house tools to transcribe episodic, catalog, and internally approved content. Responsibilities include attentively listening to audio recordings and video content to accurately transcribe spoken dialogue, narration, and relevant audio cues.

  • The English Transcriber Specialist captures required scripted events such as on-screen text, speaker identification, on- and off-screen indicators, scene descriptions where applicable, and basic annotation including sensitive events. The role performs self-review and proofreading to ensure transcripts are free of grammatical, spelling, punctuation, and formatting errors.

  • Additional responsibilities include researching names, terminology, locations, and references using approved sources; applying WBD formatting standards and templates consistently; escalating unclear audio or creative ambiguities to the appropriate reviewer; maintaining confidentiality for sensitive or restricted content.

  • Coordinate assigned workload; meet established deadlines; maintain required quality standards for accuracy and speed; coordinate with team members on daily assignments; and use internal tracking tools for work queue management.

  • All work must comply with brand standards, departmental needs, and applicable.

Qualifications & Experience...

  • Hands-on experience in transcription, captioning, scripting, accessibility, timed text, or a related field within the entertainment media, broadcast, streaming, or post-production industry.

  • Experience using transcription, captioning, or subtitling software is required.

  • Experience working with film, television, streaming, or other entertainment media content is required.

  • The role requires a strong command of written English, including grammar, spelling, punctuation, and usage, as well as excellent listening skills to accurately transcribe spoken content.

  • Must demonstrate attention to detail, the ability to follow established specifications and workflows, solid formatting and proofreading skills, and the ability to research and fact-check information.

  • Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools is expected, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal peers.

  • The role requires the ability to coordinate time and priorities in a deadline-driven environment, adapt to changing production needs, and learn new tools, systems, and technical processes.

Not Required but preferred experience:

Typing speed of 60–75 words per minute is preferred.

title: GPU Internships - Design Verification and Emulation & Driver Live
description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Multifaceted, amazing people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. The people who work here have reinvented entire industries with all Apple Hardware products. The same passion for innovation that goes into our products also applies to our practices strengthening our commitment to leave the world better than we found it. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking Apple product! Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple’s customers every single day.

The UK GPU team works on IPs that are part of Apple’s world-class GPU designs for Apple Silicon SoCs. We are seeking highly motivated, innovative and confident individuals to join us, across the following areas: Unit Design Verification, Top Design Verification and Emulation & Driver Live. You will be at the centre of a chip design effort working with all disciplines, with a critical impact on getting high performant products to millions of Apple customers efficiently.

Locations:
These internships can be based in London Bishopsgate, St Albans or Cambridge. You may express your location preferences if selected for interview.

Start dates: Winter 2026 or Spring / Summer 2027.

Key Dates:
Applications will close by mid-October.
Initial interviews will take place in October, with final round interviews in November.

We will be hiring for the below internships across the available start dates: Winter 2026 or Spring / Summer 2027.

Design Verification: You'll be part of creating comprehensive verification plans and contributing to test bench development, from stimulating real-world scenarios to ensuring designs are robust and complete. Collaborating closely with our expert architects and designers, you'll play a crucial role in identifying and addressing issues early in the design cycle. With hands-on mentorship, you'll not only implement key components of our verification flows but also sharpen your debugging skills as you tackle complex testbench and design challenges. This is a great opportunity to build expertise and make a real impact while working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Emulation: As a Graphics Emulation Intern, you'll develop skills in a range of areas that involve accelerated platforms such as emulation: build GPU models, run cool intensive graphics workloads on those models, debug & resolve potential issues, and contribute to the infrastructure workflow. On top of that, you'll be exposed to the automation portal that pieces all of the previously mentioned areas together using a modern web user interface coupled with a sophisticated backend. Our team partners with teams that use emulation for functional, performance and power verification, through that modern portal - it’s a fantastic opportunity to explore engaging with different teams and build up on communication and interpersonal skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • At the end of the internship, you must return to school to continue your education or the internship must be the last requirement for you to graduate.
  • Strong coding skills with C or C++
  • Strong understanding of common data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
  • A curiosity about GPU / CPU / SOC architecture and micro-architecture
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Perl, Python or Ruby

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong interpersonal and analytical skills
  • Ability to work well within a team and be productive under tight schedules
  • Familiarity with SystemVerilog / Verilog / VHDL
  • Prior experience with hardware description languages

Job Description

Teledyne Tekmar, a division of Teledyne Instruments Inc. has an excellent opportunity for a dynamic individual to join our exceptional team as Buyer at our Mason, OH home office.

Teledyne Tekmar is a leader in the design and manufacturing of analytical instrumentation for the laboratory providing productivity-enhancing instrumentation and solutions to a number of industries. Our world-renowned product lines include Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) systems for Gas Chromatography (GC) Sample Introduction, High-Throughput Purge and Trap sample concentration, and Sample Automation. The Total Organic Carbon (TOC) Analyzers provides unparalleled accuracy, precision, throughput and robustness for water samples.

Summary

The buyer position evaluates, selects, places, and expedites assigned procurement contracts or portions of a procurement contract of high complexity, diversification, or expense. Networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

-Coordinates all activities related to procurement of a commodity beginning with intent to purchase through delivery.

-Analyzes the requirements of the commodity, including preliminary specifications, preferred supplier, and date commodity is needed.

-Works with production planning teams to ensure supply continuity, effectively communicate with vendors to ensure the commodity is delivered on schedule, at the negotiated price, and meets the quality standards of the company.

-Responsible for resolving shortages and issues with suppliers.

-Investigates and/or interviews potential suppliers to determine if they meet the specified requirements. Advises team members or management on the appropriate supplier to be used.

-Implements and ensures usage of globally defined methods, processes and systems to ensure high process efficiency and process compliance (company and government regulations).

Follows all import/export requirements, consulting with facility import/export personnel as required.

title: Material Planner, CVRM (Holly Springs)
description:
The Position

Pharma Technical Manufacturing (PTM) is responsible for managing all aspects of end-to-end drug substance and drug product manufacturing and supply. From the raw material to the final medicine, we contribute to deliver Roche’s ground-breaking therapies to more than 120 million patients around the world. We make our medicines at 9 sites around the world and coordinate all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

To ensure readiness for a step-change in the standard of care that Roche delivers in the area of Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism (CVRM), PTM will construct a new manufacturing site in the U.S. in Holly Springs, North Carolina. The new site will focus on large volume low cost Drug Product manufacturing (Component Prep & Compounding, Liquid PFS Filling, Automated Inspection, Autoinjector Assembly, Packaging/Finished Products).

The Opportunity

We're looking for a highly skilled Material Planner to join our team. In this role, you'll be responsible for maintaining material supply to meet production demand. You will be a key player in our supply chain, bridging the gap between global procurement and production demand. Additionally, this role will act as the artwork change coordinator, ensuring changes to artwork are considered in our procurement and stocking of packaging materials for our finished goods.

What You’ll Do

Start Up Phase:

As part of plant start-up you will manage the material plan to support vendor and site testing of manufacturing equipment during Factory and Site Acceptance Testing through qualification. This will include coordination with multiple vendors, European Roche sites, and procurement. Additionally, you will act as a Materials Management SME for the SAP ERP setup and deployment; responsible for the timeline, deliverables, and adherence to the global template processes related to MRP, material planning, and procurement. You will be responsible for establishing vendor relationships for both material suppliers and local service providers participating in vendor contracting, qualification, and ongoing performance improvement.

Post Start-Up:

  • You will work with Global Procurement to ensure uninterrupted material supply

  • You will ensure MRP can be met and manage long-lead time materials

  • You will develop plans to avoid material shortages

  • You will optimize inventory to minimize expiration and optimize storage space

  • You will act as the artwork change coordinator and work with the global artwork change team to ensure correct packaging artwork is available on time.

  • You will partner with the procurement team to ensure timely availability of raw materials and components needed for production. Monitor inventory levels and work with the production scheduler to adjust the MPS as needed to prevent stockouts or excessive inventory.

  • You will manage vendor relationships to identify areas for improvement and ensure performance to meet business and quality expectations.

  • You will utilize SAP S/4HANA for planning and execution, and OMP for advanced planning and scheduling. You'll need to be proficient in these systems, generating reports, analyzing data, and making informed decisions.

  • You will apply standard Association for Supply Chain Management (ASCM) principles and best practices in all aspects of material planning. A strong understanding of planning, scheduling, and inventory management concepts is essential.

Who You Are

You hold a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, or a related field with 5 years in a material planner or similar supply chain planning role.

  • You have proven experience with ERP planning processes and software (eg. SAP S/4HANA and OMP).

  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to analyze complex data and make data-driven decisions.

  • You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with various teams and stakeholders.

Preferred

  • You have a CPIM (Certified in Planning and Inventory Management) or CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional) certification

  • You have an advanced degree (eg. Masters, MBA)

  • You have experience with the implementation of large scale ERP projects

Relocation assistance is available for this role.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location for this position of Holly Springs, North Carolina is $87,500 - $162,500. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, level, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

title: Supplier Quality Engineer I
description:
About us

At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. By embracing an innovative culture of excellence, we pride ourselves on designing, manufacturing and servicing some of the world’s most transformative products. From life-saving medical technology and mission-critical defense solutions to sophisticated industrial automation, we’re proud to partner with our customers to bring their complex ideas to market.


Visit to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.


Living Our Values

With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. Our values unite and guide us in everything that we do.


Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.


As part of our team, you’ll do impactful work within an inclusive environment where everyone works together to achieve extraordinary outcomes. You’ll be empowered to reach your full potential through managing your own personalised development plan and access to our learning and development programs.


Purpose Statement: The purpose of the Supplier Quality Engineer I role is to assist in driving Plexus Zero Defect Strategies and continual improvement into the supply base for both compliance and risk mitigation within Plexus Operations. This role may have a limited scope and will support representing the supplier quality function to Customers, external auditors and internal teams for all incoming raw material and services. Supplier Quality is a key technical and indirect leadership function that will apply fundamentals of quality in order to influence suppliers in meeting or exceeding expectations.

(Enter specific assignment information, examples: This role will be manufacturing based at our manufacturing facility located in Neenah, Wisconsin focusing on electrical assemblies. Or This role will be regionally based supporting all manufacturing sites with the AMER region for fabrication and machining. This role will be Global, shaping support for supplier quality engineers at varying levels of proficiency in IT system use)

Key Job Accountabilities:

  • Supplier Qualification - Support supplier qualification as a team member in supplier selection and evaluation using a risk based approach. Assist in supplier audits applying good auditing practices and our Quality Management System (QMS) in both new programs and on-going management of suppliers.
  • Part Qualification - Connect part qualification activities into receiving inspection setting both sampling plans and inspection criteria. Use purchased product specifications to identify Critical to Quality features and complete part qualification activities using different elements of Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) to flow requirements from Customers into the supply base. Support Supplier Quality in Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) teams and supplier change requests as an influential member driving Zero Defect strategies into the supply chain.
  • Supplier Management - Lead supplier corrective action activities in multiple levels of the supply chain using non-conforming parts, data trends and supplier audit findings. Assist in analysis of data to identify trends and provide suppliers feedback to drive supplier performance improvements. Assist in categorization of suppliers by risk for additional development or auditing activities.
  • Engineering Expertise - Apply technical aptitude to challenge suppliers processes using a risk based approach. The approach may include design reviews, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans (CP) and statistical process controls (SPC) applied to selected manufacturing technologies.

Education/Experience Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 1 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.

Other Qualifications:

  • ASQ Certification preferred (CQE, CQA, CMQOE)     
  • Broad understanding of materials, manufacturing technologies and processes

Physical Requirements:

  • Role will support operational teams in a manufacturing environment with required personal protective equipment. Facilities include comfortable temperatures, repetitive low noise level and suitable lighting for required tasks. May require walking, standing and sitting, using a computer, and other office equipment. Direct interaction with people and equipment is event driven and will include activities related to inspecting, qualifying, troubleshooting and improving jigs, fixtures, and manufacturing methods using different types of components or material. Role may require working individually on tasks with a prolonged focus on written material, working collectively as part of a team of various disciplines and backgrounds and working in multiple software systems.

Travel Requirements:

  • Less than 40%

title: Network and Security engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Do you want to be at the forefront of designing and implementing cutting-edge network solutions? Within our Network Services team at Kyndryl, you will be the go-to expert for providing top-of-the-line technical solutions throughout the entire solution lifecycle. You will be responsible for creating local and wide-area network solutions that utilize multiple platforms and protocols, ensuring that our customers have the best possible network infrastructure to support their business needs.

Your skills in routers, networking controllers, bridges, and networking software will be essential as you troubleshoot network issues and coordinate with vendors to install the latest hardware and software, such as routers and switches. Not only will you help keep our customer’s networks running smoothly, but you will also work on project implementation, conduct project planning and cost analysis, and build proof-of-concept solutions with networking system technology.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to review project requirements, communicate them accurately to the team, and ensure they are appropriately fulfilled. You will use your expertise to design and implement local and wide-area network solutions, including IP and VOIP, that address customer requirements. You will also provide high-quality technical solutions to our customers to prepare them for implementation, go-live, and maintenance.

If you are excited about using your technical expertise to create innovative network solutions and provide outstanding customer service, then this is the role for you!

Your Future at Kyndryl
At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

•6+ years of experience focused on network support, configuration, and implementation
•6+ years of experience in core switching, routing, MPLS, and firewalls
•Networking and security architecture and engineering support experience across local, regional, and global domains
•Ability to effectively execute multiple IT projects and deadlines with limited supervision

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

•Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) deployment and data center experience
•Experience with design and implementing Software Defined Network (SDN) and large complex networks
•Experience with protocols and technologies such as, BDP, OSPF, MP-FBP EVPN, VXLAN, or VPC


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

We have an exciting opportunity to join Clayton Utz's market-leading Data Intelligence Practice as a Consultant, based in our Sydney office.

Join our nationally collaborative, high-performing team led by industry leaders Owen Bourke (Partner and Head of Data Intelligence), Loren Harper-Moeskops and Scott Murphy. In this role, you’ll contribute to the design and delivery of cutting-edge technology and AI-augmented workflows that enhance and transform our legal service offering.

We are open to candidates who are recent graduates (or will graduate shortly) with the right aptitude and attitude, or candidates with experience in similar roles. We will provide training and coaching to set you up for success.

The Role

As a Consultant in the Data Intelligence practice, you’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team leading the transformation of how legal services are delivered. In this role, you’ll play a key part in delivering legal technology, AI-driven workflows, and eDiscovery services across a range of matters including class actions, regulatory investigations, large-scale disputes, and other data-intensive matters. Partnering closely with our legal teams and clients, you’ll be part of a team dedicated to turning complex data challenges into structured, defensible solutions.

This role harnesses skills in technology, project management, and client engagement to deliver innovative, high-quality, and value driven solutions for our clients and legal teams. Leveraging industry-leading eDiscovery and AI platforms, including advanced AI-powered review technologies, you’ll create customised solutions designed to address the unique challenges of our clients.

To support your success, you’ll have access to industry leading tools such as Harvey AI, Relativity, Mary, and bespoke solutions like CaseTrace (and more), alongside the people and infrastructure needed to deliver exceptional results.

Skills & Experience

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Qualifications: A tertiary qualification in Law, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Commerce, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Problem-Solving Skills: A logical and proactive approach to tackling technical and non-technical challenges, paired with curiosity and a willingness to embrace new skills in a rapidly evolving environment.

  • Analytical Ability: Strong analytical abilities to assess and interpret data effectively, with the capability to prioritise tasks and delegate when necessary.

  • Technical Expertise: Familiarity with legal technology platforms and eDiscovery tools such as Relativity, Harvey, Mary Technology, or similar AI and data analytics tools. While formal experience is a plus, a keen interest and willingness to learn are equally important.

  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail, with the ability to simplify complex data or technology concepts and present them in a clear, accessible way.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling you to explain technical solutions to non-technical audiences, build strong relationships, and positively influence clients and colleagues.

  • Organisational Skills: Solid time management and organisational skills to juggle multiple projects and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced, solutions-driven environment.

  • Teamwork: A collaborative and team-oriented mindset, with the ability to work seamlessly within multidisciplinary teams of lawyers, technologists, and data specialists.

  • Creativity and Innovation: A bold, creative mindset with a passion for challenging the status quo.

Our Data Intelligence Team

Clayton Utz is one of Australia’s leading law firms, representing a diverse range of domestic and international private sector and government clients. As part of our broader Advisory, Risk & Regulation stream, the Data Intelligence practice plays a pivotal role in delivering multidisciplinary solutions tailored for the modern practice of law.

Operating at the intersection of law, data, and technology, the Data Intelligence practice develops innovative solutions that integrate people, processes, and technology. We work closely with legal teams and clients to improve service quality, reduce risk, and deliver defensible outcomes for complex matters.

Our team is a dynamic mix of technologists, lawyers, project management specialists, forensic accountants and data scientists. Together, we form a national collaborative group, leveraging diverse expertise to support matters across all Australian offices and pushing the boundaries to deliver innovative solutions.

Why Join Clayton Utz?


At Clayton Utz, we’re more than just a law firm – we’re a community that values our people and their contributions.

When you join us, you’ll enjoy:

  • Access to professional development programs and career growth opportunities.

  • A focus on health and wellbeing, with initiatives to support your physical and mental health such as discounted health insurance and gym memberships.

  • Up to 26 weeks’ paid parental leave, with flexibility over two years, plus paid superannuation.

  • The option to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave annually.

How to Apply?

We prefer to work directly with candidates, if you are interested in this role, please click the ‘Apply’ button or contact the consultant, details below, for more information. Clayton Utz is an inclusive employer that supports flexible work arrangements, please feel free to discuss your flexibility needs with the recruiter for this role.

Consultant Contact Details

Nicole St John, (02) 9353 4928

Accessibility and Inclusion

We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process. Do you require any support or reasonable adjustments to complete your application? If so, please contact the recruiter via the above telephone number or via email to recruitmentsupport@claytonutz.com.

For more information on Clayton Utz, please visit or follow us on LinkedIn here.

Agency submissions

Clayton Utz does not accept agency submissions unless the agency is specifically contacted by a member of the Clayton Utz Recruitment Team. Please do not forward candidate profiles or resumes to Clayton Utz partners, hiring managers or other employees - this will not constitute as an introduction to the firm and Clayton Utz will not be liable for a fee.

PROJECT/TASK MANAGER - TOP SECRET CLEARANCE REQUIRED

As a DoWIN Operations Section Lead, the work you’ll do at GDIT directly supports the mission of U.S. Army Network Enterprise Technology Command (NETCOM). You will provide focused leadership across a defined section of the program, ensuring technical accuracy, operational consistency, and alignment with program objectives for NIPRNET, SIPRNET, and Deployed Forces (DF) portions of the Department of War Information Network (DOWIN).

Selected candidate will provide full-time onsite support at our Fort Huachuca, AZ facility.


MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

  • Lead day to day execution of assigned technical tasks by coordinating the efforts of capability task leads, monitoring progress, and ensuring alignment with established cost, schedule, and performance goals.
  • Serve as the primary integrator between capability task leads and program leadership, translating program level direction into actionable guidance and ensuring consistent communication across the section.
  • Support planning and resource coordination by identifying section level requirements, assisting with workload distribution, and providing input to program leadership on staffing, risks, and dependencies.
  • Ensure technical and operational quality by reviewing deliverables, validating compliance with Army Enterprise LWN standards, and reinforcing adherence to DoW and Army Cybersecurity Policies (e.g., AR 25 2, AR 25 1).
  • Facilitate issue resolution by identifying section level challenges early, coordinating with task leads and program leadership, and recommending corrective actions to maintain mission effectiveness.
  • Contribute to documentation and reporting by preparing section specific updates, metrics, and technical inputs for program level plans, proposals, and briefings.
  • Provide direct support to government customers and cross‑functional teams across all contract/PWS tasks, ensuring effective delivery of services on customer‑owned technologies.
  • Maintain a working understanding of the systems, tools, and platforms used by the customer, enabling the Section Lead to guide break/fix activities, technology upgrades, cybersecurity requirements, and the integration of new capabilities in accordance with contract and PWS obligations.



WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your leadership, technical expertise, and commitment to mission success to GDIT. The DoWIN Operations Section Lead must have:

Education: Bachelor's Degree. An additional 4 years of experience may be substituted for degree.

Clearance: Minimum of an active Top Secret security clearance required. Must be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI

Certification: 8570.1 M IAT Level II Certification required.

Experience: Minimum of 5 years’ experience.

Technical skills:

  • Experience supporting operations in the information technology field.
  • Prior team or task level leadership.
  • Working knowledge of Army Enterprise LWN capabilities, tools, and operational constructs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, Project, and Microsoft Visio

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.

Accountabilities

1.Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
2.Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
3.Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
4.Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
5.Build High-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high-performing team attributes
6.Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
7.Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable

Assistant Vice President Expectations

To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join Company Barclays as a Scrum Master and play a pivotal role in driving agile delivery across complex technology and business initiatives. You will enable high-performing teams, foster collaboration, and ensure the successful execution of key programmes by removing obstacles and supporting continuous improvement.

To be successful as a Scrum Master, you should have experience with:

• Sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and release planning activities – ensuring effective delivery cadence and continuous team improvement

• Identify and remove delivery impediments – enabling teams to maintain productivity and achieve delivery objectives

• Workflow solution like jBPM/ BAMOE, knowledge of Java, knowledge of API and microservices and database SQL – supporting technical discussions and improving delivery outcomes

Some other highly valued skills may include:

• Knowledge of Payment domain

• Knowledge of Deposit domain

• Coordinate dependencies across technology teams, business stakeholders, and supporting functions

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based of Glasgow.

title: Lokal KAM / Maskinselger - Rosendal Maskin
description:
Vil du være med og løfte Rosendal Maskin på Østlandet?

Maskinselgere – Østlandet

Rosendal Maskin AS

Rosendal Maskin er en familieeid, solid og fremoverlent leverandør av anleggsmaskiner. Vi ble etablert i 1986 og er hovedimportør av Develon og JCB i Norge. I tillegg leverer vi hydraulisk utstyr fra Everdigm og produkter fra flere ledende utstyrsleverandører.

Vi har rundt 60 ansatte og omsatte for 689 millioner kroner i 2025. Hovedkontoret ligger ved E18 i Askim, hvor vi disponerer et område på 40 000 kvadratmeter med et moderne administrasjonsbygg, verksted, delelager og et stort utvalg maskiner.

Nå er Rosendal Maskin i fart.

Vi har gått fra primært å selge til mindre og mellomstore maskineiere til også å vinne frem hos noen av de største entreprenørene og utleieselskapene i Norge. I 2026 leverer vi 39 Develon-dumpere til en uteleiaktør, det er en av de største leveranseneav dumper i Norge noensinne. Vi har også gjort større leveranser til noen av Norges største entreprenører og vist at vi har produkter og et apparat som kan måle seg med de største.

Innen elektriske gravemaskiner over åtte tonn hadde vi en markedsandel på 34,8 prosent i 2025. Mer enn 100 store elektriske maskiner fra Rosendal Maskin er allerede i drift i det norske markedet.

Vi har sterke produkter, gode referanser og en organisasjon som er rigget for videre vekst. Nå skal vi bruke momentet til å ta en vesentlig sterkere posisjon på Østlandet.


Derfor skal vi ansette to:

Lokale KAM / Maskinselgere – Østlandet

Får anleggsmaskiner blodet ditt til å pumpe litt raskere? Liker du å være ute på veien og møte mennesker på anleggsplasser, byggeplasser, verksteder og kontorer? Trives du med å møte nye kunder og skape resultater?

Da kan dette være jobben for deg. Målet er å øke omsetningen på Østlandet med 200 millioner kroner i løpet av to år. Det betyr at vi ser etter selgere som ønsker ansvar, har høye ambisjoner og motiveres av å bygge opp noe.

Om rollen

Du får ansvar for å utvikle Rosendal Maskins posisjon i ditt område. Oppgaven er å komme i dialog med entreprenører, maskineiere og lokale utleieselskaper som vi i liten grad arbeider med i dag – og sørge for at flere velger Develon og JCB når de skal investere i nye maskiner.

Du skal følge med på markedet, forstå hvilke prosjekter som er på vei og vite når kundene skal skifte ut eller utvide maskinparken.

Vi selger ikke bare en maskin. Kundene vurderer også driftssikkerhet, produktivitet, finansiering, service, reservedeler og oppfølging. Du må derfor være nysgjerrig på kundens virksomhet og kunne sette sammen en løsning som fungerer i praksis.

De største nasjonale entreprenørene og utleieselskapene håndteres av vår KAM-funksjon. Du får ansvar for lokale og regionale kunder og vil samarbeide med KAM når kundene har både lokale og sentrale beslutningslinjer.

Tre mulige salgsområder

Vi skal ansette to selgere, men holder den endelige distriktsfordelingen åpen.

Utgangspunktet er:

· Buskerud, Asker og Bærum

· Oslo, Romerike og Kongsvinger

· Østfold og Follo

Vi ønsker først og fremst å finne de riktige menneskene. Derfor tilpasser vi den endelige fordelingen etter hvor de beste kandidatene bor, hvilket nettverk de har og hvor de har størst mulighet til å skape resultater.

Du bor i eller nær det aktuelle distriktet og arbeider hjemmefra, i bilen og ute hos kundene. Det blir også naturlig å besøke hovedkontoret i Askim og delta på messer og kundearrangementer.

Helt konkret vil arbeidsoppgavene dine være å:


· selge tyngre anleggsmaskiner fra Develon og JCB

· kartlegge markedet og prioritere kundene med størst potensial

· etablere kontakt med entreprenører og maskineiere vi ikke jobber aktivt med i dag

· utvikle og følge opp lokale og regionale kunder

· avdekke kommende prosjekter, investeringsplaner og behov for nye maskiner

· planlegge og gjennomføre kundemøter og demonstrasjoner

· utarbeide tilbud og følge salgsprosesser frem til avtale

· samarbeide med KAM, service, ettermarked og resten av salgsteamet

· følge opp leveranser og sørge for at kunden får en god opplevelse

· arbeide strukturert med pipeline, ordreinngang og omsetning

Du får budsjett- og resultatansvar for eget distrikt og stor frihet til å planlegge arbeidshverdagen.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Det er en fordel om du har solgt anleggsmaskiner, men det er ikke et krav.

Du kan også ha bakgrunn fra maskinutleie, redskap, maskinstyring, teknisk utstyr eller andre produkter og tjenester til entreprenører og maskineiere.

Det viktigste er at du kjenner markedet og menneskene som kjøper maskiner. Du vet hvem de maskinansvarlige og andre beslutningstakerne er, og du har relasjoner som gjør at du raskt kan komme i dialog med relevante kunder.

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i dette:

· Du har dokumenterte salgsresultater.

· Du liker å møte nye kunder og skape muligheter selv.

· Du er selvstendig og tar ansvar for eget marked.

· Du arbeider strukturert og følger opp det du har lovet.

· Du skaper tillit hos praktisk orienterte og faglig sterke kunder.

· Du kan snakke naturlig med både mindre maskineiere og profesjonelle maskinansvarlige.

· Du er kommersiell, utholdende og opptatt av å få ting til å skje.

· Du deler informasjon og ønsker at salgsteamet skal lykkes samlet.

Du trenger ikke kunne alt om Develon og JCB før du begynner. Vi gir deg opplæring i produktene, systemene og organisasjonen. Men du må ha interessen, nettverket og salgskraften som skal til for å skape omsetning.

Hvorfor Rosendal Maskin?

Hos oss får du muligheten til å bli med på en offensiv vekstreise.

Vi har korte beslutningsveier, stor fleksibilitet og sterke produkter. Vi har bevist at vi kan konkurrere om store og krevende leveranser, men har fortsatt et betydelig uutnyttet potensial på Østlandet.

Du får:

· et stort marked med mange kunder vi ikke arbeider aktivt med i dag

· sterke produkter fra Develon og JCB

· en ledende posisjon innen elektriske gravemaskiner

· støtte fra KAM, verksted, delelager og ettermarked

· stor frihet til å utvikle eget distrikt

· mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi bygger salget på Østlandet

· konkurransedyktig fastlønn og resultatbasert bonus

· firmabil og det du trenger til hjemmekontoret

· gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Rosendal Maskin skal omsette for én milliard kroner innen 2030. De nye maskinselgerne på Østlandet blir viktige for at vi skal nå målet.

Synes du dette høres spennende ut, så send oss en søknad.

Bare ring Magne Lome i SalesJobs på 913 92 881 dersom det er noe du lurer på. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg.

title: Systems Administrator
description:

Employee ownership, generous 401K, full health/dental/life/vision insurance benefits, interesting assignments, educational reimbursement, competitive salaries, and a pleasant work environment combine to make Radiance Technologies a great place to work and succeed.

Radiance is searching for an experienced Systems Administrator to provide support to critical computer systems and network infrastructure at the corporate facility. The qualified candidate will provide design, maintenance, sustainment, and enhancement support for the architecture in a classified environment; ensure compliance with applicable information assurance requirements; ensure 24/7 continuity of operations; and create and update relevant system documents. Work hours are normal business hours, however, occasional support during non-business hours may be required.

Successful candidates will have the following behavioral competencies:

  • Great attitude with high degree of customer focus.
  • Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Solid trouble-shooter, problem solver.
  • Reliable and committed to getting the job done (including after hours as required).
  • Excellent coping skills and the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • Self-managed; able to work independently or with a team as required.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide daily, on-site, support for the operations and maintenance across multiple classification level environments.
  • Proficient in the installation, configurations, and maintenance of Linux (Ubuntu, Red Hat Linux, CentOS) servers, desktops, and all network devices in accordance with all NIST 800-53A r4, DISA STIG, and SRG requirements.
  • Experience in the installation, configurations, and maintenance of Windows servers, desktops, and all network devices in accordance with all NIST 800-53A r4, DISA STIG, and SRG requirements.
  • Experience performing system design, hardware/software implementation and integration, and general infrastructure support within a software development environment that utilize commercial, GOTS, and custom tooling.
  • Demonstrated experience with information systems deployments in an air-gapped environment.
  • Experience in User account and access control management (Active Directory, LDAP, User Access Control) in a domain or stand-alone environment.
  • Demonstrated experience with integrating Linux workstations and servers with Windows Active Directory.
  • Experience with configuring and executing vulnerability scanning tools (Nessus), SCAP/STIG scans (SCC Tool, OpenSCAP, etc.), and remediating findings.
  • Experience with providing backup and recovery services; manage file systems and disk space.
  • Experience with log aggregation technologies allowing for the collection and filtering of Linux syslog and audit trails.
  • Experience with desktop and server virtualization within VMWare vSphere and EXSI.
  • Ability to gain comprehension of new technologies to assist with new requirement implementation efforts.

Required Experience

  • A minimum of two (2) years of experience as a System Administrator.
  • At least one year of experience as a System Administrator performing patching and configuring systems to be compliant with all applicable STIGs on a classified network.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to effectively interface with numerous cognizant security agencies, customers, and senior management.
  • Ability to manage multiple networks in a dynamic, demanding environment.
  • Basic knowledge of Risk Management Framework requirements and how they impact the IT configuration requirements for Windows and Linux systems.

Required Skills

  • Minimum Secret clearance with the ability to obtain a Top Secret clearance
  • DoD Directive 8570 / 8140 Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level II certification. (e.g., Security+ CE, CCNA Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, CND, SSCP)

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in information technology of a related subject.
  • Previous experience working in a classified Collateral environment / SAP / SCI /.
  • Prior experience as a System Administrator at an organization of similar size and complexity.
  • Understanding of network concepts and Type 1 encryption devices, such as TACLANE.
  • Understanding of networking concepts and cybersecurity related tools to include, Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIG) and Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP), and vulnerability scanners.
  • Knowledge of and ability to securely configure network equipment (switches and firewalls).
  • Knowledge and experience with various network administration, monitoring, and security tools (Wireshark, Nessus, Snort, Netcat and PRTG).
  • Experience with SIEM tools, VMWare, NetApp, endpoint security tools.
  • Familiar with NISPOM/RMF, DAAPM, JSIG, and NIST/DFARS compliance security controls and how to implement on various OS computer systems.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Director Field Performance
description:
For over 15 years, ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers has provided innovative and quality dental implant care to patients across the UnitedStates. Each center is focused on the same mission—to provide quality dental implant treatment for people who are looking for a long-termsolution to chronic dental issues.​

ClearChoice Holdings is a provider in practice management services to a network of affiliated same-day dental implantcenters. ClearChoice provides administrative and non-clinical services to dental implant centers, a network of doctor owned and operated dentaltreatment centers providing dental implant care (similar to ADMI/TAG). In 2022 we received "Top 150 Places to Work" by the Denver Post. ​

The Senior Director of Field Performance serves as a key leader responsible for driving sales execution, revenue growth, operational excellence, performance improvement, and leadership effectiveness across the field organization. This role provides operational and day-to-day management for the company's Field Performance and Improvement Program, ensuring underperforming centers achieve sustainable improvements in operational, financial, and patient experience metrics.

In partnership with leadership and other cross functional teams, the Sr Dir, Field Performance executes and drives adoption of performance acceleration strategies, identifies systemic opportunities for improvement, and drives accountability throughout the field organization. This leader also plays a critical role in the training, development, and ongoing effectiveness of Regional Business Directors (RBDs), strengthening leadership capability, and ensuring consistency in performance management practices across the network.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, operational leadership experience, coaching expertise, and a proven ability to influence outcomes in a multi-site healthcare or service environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Field Performance and Improvement programs

  • Directly oversee a team of field performance leaders.

  • Provide day to day leadership and management of network performance improvement programs, including center selection, performance monitoring, intervention planning, and graduation criteria.

  • Support the development and execution of initiatives designed to improve performance across key sales, operational, financial, and patient experience metrics.

  • Partner with Regional Business Directors, Center leaders, and cross-functional teams to implement targeted improvement strategies.

title: Parts Coordinator
description:
Company Details

Darling Ingredients repurposes and recycles materials from the animal agriculture and food industries - transforming them into essential ingredients that do everything from feeding animals to fertilizing crops to fueling planes and nourishing people. We're the number one publicly traded company of our kind, operating a global family of brands and businesses that span more than 260 facilities in over 15 countries. Our unique scale allows us to make entire industries less wasteful and more sustainable, helping move the world toward a more circular economy.

Darling Ingredients offers full time employees a full suite of benefits including but not limited to the following: 401(k), Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, and Paid Time Off.


Job Summary

The Parts Coordinator is responsible for the movement of parts and equipment in and out of the warehouse.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.
