title: Site AI Transformation Lead (Secondment 12-18 Months)
description:
WHY PATIENTS NEED YOU

This position reports to the Site Leader and leads the Kalamazoo site's AI transformation, connecting business priorities, emerging technologies, and operational excellence into measurable financial results across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering & Tech Services, Safety, Finance, and Quality.

WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE

The Director leads the site AI team — AI Data Engineers, AI Data Scientist, AI IMEx / Continuous Improvement Lead, AI Adoption & Engagement Lead, and AI Data Quality & Compliance Lead — and is the single point of accountability for the team's Front Door engagement model across every site organization.

The Director owns the site AI portfolio and value realization, running the team as an internal consulting and delivery organization — an "innovation factory" — rather than an AI research group. Every initiative is held to a single test: how much money, time, risk, or capacity it saves the business. If a project cannot answer that, it is not the right priority.

The Director sets the operating rhythm (quarterly identification of the top business problems with plant leadership; monthly portfolio, ROI, risk, and adoption review; weekly blocker removal and cross-functional alignment) and serves as the bridge between Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Safety, IT/Digital, Finance, and Executives.

The Director is accountable for talent, enterprise alignment, responsible-AI and GxP compliance posture, and the removal of barriers that prevent successful adoption and scaling of solutions.

HOW YOU WILL ACHIEVE IT

  • Set the vision, strategy, priorities, and operating model for the Kalamazoo Site AI Manufacturing Transformation Team in alignment with site business objectives and enterprise AI, Digital, Quality, and Compliance expectations.

  • Serve as the primary AI transformation partner to the Site Lead and Site Leadership Team, translating business priorities into a prioritized AI, analytics, automation, and data-enabled transformation portfolio.

  • Lead the AI opportunity intake process across site functions and ensure each opportunity is evaluated by business impact, feasibility, speed, risk, compliance impact, data readiness, adoption readiness, and strategic value.

  • Ensure all AI initiatives clearly define expected value, baseline performance, business owner, adoption plan, data requirements, compliance controls, cybersecurity considerations, support model, and transition path before advancing beyond pilot or prototype.

  • Lead and coach the site AI team including AI Data Engineering, AI Data Science, IMEx/Continuous Improvement, Adoption & Engagement, and Data Security/Quality/Compliance capabilities.

  • Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Finance, Digital, Process Automation, IMEx/Operational Excellence, Validation, Cybersecurity, and enterprise AI/Product teams to remove barriers and accelerate high-value use cases.

  • Drive a governance rhythm including leadership portfolio reviews, value realization reviews, risk and compliance reviews, adoption reviews, and execution alignment meetings.

  • Ensure AI solutions are designed for sustainable adoption by integrating process redesign, standard work, training, user feedback, change management, and measurable behavior change into deployment plans.

  • Ensure responsible and compliant AI implementation by embedding quality, GxP, data privacy, data integrity, cybersecurity, model risk, validation, documentation, and audit-readiness expectations into the lifecycle.

  • Own value realization reporting for the site AI portfolio, including savings, productivity, capacity, cycle time, risk reduction, quality improvement, compliance improvement, and colleague experience outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to scale successful site AI solutions across the network and bring enterprise AI capabilities back to the site when they can solve Kalamazoo business problems.

  • Promote a practical AI culture focused on business value, human-centered adoption, informed decision-making, continuous improvement, and patient impact.

QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have

  • Applicant must have a bachelor's degree with at least 6+ years of experience; OR a master's degree with at least 5+ years of experience; OR a PhD with 1+ years of experience.

  • Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, digital, analytics, operational excellence, or business transformation.

  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional transformation, systems, operational improvement, digital enablement, analytics, automation, or AI-related initiatives in a complex business or manufacturing environment.

  • Experience developing business cases, prioritizing portfolios, leading governance rhythms, removing cross-functional barriers, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

  • Strong ability to communicate with site leadership, business process owners, technical teams, quality/compliance partners, and frontline colleagues.

  • Understanding regulated manufacturing expectations, data integrity, quality systems, validation, change control, and sustainable process adoption.

Nice-to-Have

  • Pharmaceutical, GMP, biologics, API, sterile manufacturing, or other highly regulated manufacturing experience preferred.

  • Experience with AI, advanced analytics, automation, data platforms, SAP, MES, LIMS, CMMS, historians, Power BI/Tableau, quality systems, or enterprise digital/product teams preferred.

  • Lean/Six Sigma, IMEx, operational excellence, change management, product management, program management, or financial value realization experience preferred.

  • Experience leading teams or matrix organizations across Data Engineering, Data Science, Continuous Improvement, Adoption/Change, Compliance, Cybersecurity, or Quality preferred.

  • Working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk management, GxP validation, data governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and AI lifecycle documentation preferred.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Normal office role with frequent computer-based work, meetings, executive communication, data review, business process analysis, prioritization, and decision support.

  • Ability to perform complex problem solving, portfolio prioritization, financial and operational value assessment, risk assessment, and written documentation.

  • Periodic presence in manufacturing, laboratory, warehouse, or operational areas may be required; must follow applicable site safety, gowning, data integrity, and GMP expectations.

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • May require support outside normal business hours for critical site priorities, production or compliance impacts, executive reviews, project milestones, or urgent escalations.

  • Occasional travel may be required for site, network, vendor, or enterprise alignment meetings.

OTHER INFORMATION

  • This job is a US/PR Exempt Position.

  • This role is intended to lead a site AI Manufacturing Value Team focused on measurable outcomes rather than technology experimentation.

  • Recommended positioning: business transformation and site value realization leadership role with strong AI, analytics, operational excellence, adoption, and compliance partnership accountability.

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS

  • Site Lead and Site Leadership Team.

  • Kalamazoo Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, Process Automation, Finance, Digital, IMEx/Operational Excellence, Validation, Data Governance, Enterprise AI/Product teams, and external partners as applicable.

  • Direct or matrix partnership with AI Data Engineering Leads, AI Data Science Lead, AI IMEx / Continuous Improvement Lead, AI Adoption & Engagement Lead, and AI Data, Quality & Compliance Lead.

RESOURCES MANAGED

  • Expected to lead or matrix-manage the site AI team: two AI Data Engineer positions, one AI Data Science Lead, one AI IMEx / Continuous Improvement Lead, one AI Adoption & Engagement Lead, and one AI Data Quality & Compliance Lead.

  • May manage contractors, consultants, vendors, or matrix resources as approved to support AI delivery, data enablement, process improvement, adoption, validation, cybersecurity, or compliance activities.

  • Accountable for site AI portfolio prioritization, value realization, governance rhythm, project budget input, business case quality, and escalation of barriers to site leadership.

title: Specimen Processor (Full Time)
location: Hospital Campus - Prairie du Sac, WI
description:
Looking to be part of a team that provides extraordinary healthcare from the heart? You Belong Here.

POSITION SPECIFICS

Title: Specimen Processor

FTE: 1.0FTE (40 hrs/week)

Schedule: 11:00am-7:00pm Monday-Friday

Holiday Rotation: Yes

Weekend Rotation: Yes

On Call Requirements: None

POSITION SUMMARY:

Performs venipuncture and capillary punctures to procure specimens for laboratory analysis. Serves patients of all ages from newborn through geriatric. Performs clerical functions such as filing, word processing, answering telephones, faxing results, scheduling, and preparing specimens to be sent to reference laboratories. Performs urine toxicology and alcohol collections according to DOT guidelines. Maintains toxicology and laboratory supplies. Performs CLIA-waived and moderately complex testing. Maintains billing and coding for laboratory procedures.

POSITION TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Listen attentively, communicate effectively, and meet patient’s needs by answering their questions in order to promote a positive relationship.
  • Identify patient following the proper patient identification procedures.
  • Collect and identify specimens for transfusion service testing.
  • Direct patients to blood drawing area and restroom in order to obtain the ordered sample.
  • Receive specimens delivered to the lab and directly from patients to perform requested lab tests. Documents specimen collection information correctly on all specimen records.
  • Perform CLIA waved and moderately complex testing within the scope of the clinic testing menu.
  • Demonstrate competence and works independently in essential phlebotomy procedures sufficient to perform at a satisfactory level without supervision.
  • Inquire about patient status, including fasting and time of last medication when collecting specimen.
  • Perform venipunctures, finger sticks, heel sticks, blood culture collections to obtain a blood sample for ordered tests. Patient collection settings may include hospital inpatients and outpatients, nursing home residents, pediatric and newborn patients, and emergency and trauma room patients.
  • Use good clinical judgment in the selection of the puncture site appropriate for the age of the patient.
  • Distribute proper specimen containers and instructs patients on collection of random and 24-hour samples.
  • Administer Trutol glucose beverage and collects specimens of blood and urine from patients.
  • Teach Technical and University students in phlebotomy techniques.
  • Coordinate specimen collection procedures.
  • Perform Urine/Blood non-DOT and DOT drug screen collections.
  • Process paperwork for non-DOT and DOT drug screen collections, including faxing MRO copies and mailing employer copies.
  • Maintain adequate supplies, collection containers and Chain of Custody forms for urine drug screen collections.
  • Verify specimen requirements for all laboratory tests including reference laboratory tests. Ability to relay detailed specimen collection information to appropriate personnel.
  • Process samples per specimen collection/processing procedures.
  • Process collected specimen for distribution to the appropriate lab personnel for testing. Communicates special testing requirements to testing personnel (i.e. STAT specimen, Fax results, etc.).
  • Perform Specimen Processing troubleshooting as needed. Alerts Laboratory Director or Hospital Laboratory Liaison about situations where further assistance is needed.
  • Ensure that all blood drawing trays are kept stocked with appropriate blood drawing supplies.
  • Assist leadership in other duties as needed as proficiency in other areas of laboratory testing is demonstrated.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Education:

  • Required
  • Hospital setting: High school diploma or equivalent within 1 year of hire.
  • Clinic setting: High school diploma or equivalent required upon hire.
  • Preferred - None

Experience:

  • Required - None
  • Preferred - Minimum of one-year phlebotomy and medical terminology experience in a healthcare setting

Licenses and Registrations:

  • Required - None
  • Preferred - None

Certification(s):

  • Required - None
  • Preferred - Certification as a Phlebotomy Technician (or equivalent) by a national accrediting agency preferred.

BENEFIT SUMMARY

  • Competitive health and dental insurance options
  • Flexible paid time off to balance work and life
  • Retirement plan with immediate vesting and employer match
  • Discounted membership to our state-of-the-art fitness facility
  • Generous tuition reimbursement
  • Employer provided life and disability insurance
  • Free parking at facility

Job Description:

SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Transform technology into opportunity as a Software Engineer at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT
As a Software Engineer, the work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission. The Software Engineer will design, develop, code, test, and debug complex software products to be deployed in a mission critical environment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on developer with significant experience in scalable data platforms, cloud-based services, and big data analytics, and OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. They must have strong, firsthand technical expertise in a variety of data ingestion/computation technologies and the proven ability to fashion robust scalable solutions that can manage large data sets. They must be at ease working in an agile environment with a cross-functional team. This person should embody a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Work with a team to write new cloud-based applications and tools and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve system performance and usability.

• Design, develop, test, debug, and deploy new software tools that extend or replace existing capabilities to parse raw data for analysis.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, analysts, project managers and other engineers and technical SMEs.

• Deploy new software into an AWS-based data ingest pipeline.

• Write software that interacts with multiple data types and stores data into S3 buckets that is queried by processes running Athena or OpenSearch.

• As an OpenSearch expert, drive the design of indexing strategies, query optimizations, and maintain overall architectural ownership of the OpenSearch data layer.

• Troubleshoot complex problems and provide support to mission areas for software systems and application issues.

• Maintain good documentation for new software written and new procedures to be followed.

• Provide recommendations for continuous improvement.

title: Senior VDI Administrator
description:
Unleash Your Potential

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customer’s success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

The Mission

Leidos is seeking a Senior VDI Administrator to support a large enterprise IT contract for the DOD. The Administrator will provide operations support to customers across multiple geographic locations. They will provide operations and maintenance support to existing virtual desktop environments across multiple enclaves and assist with the implementation of new solutions. The administrator will help drive adoption of trusted thin-client platforms and virtual desktops across a diverse user base by focusing on improving the reliability, functionality, and user experience of the systems. This individual will work in a team environment to ensure mission needs are met for internal and external customers.

Primary Tasks:

  • Individuals in this role will be required to perform remote administration of servers located in offsite data centers.
  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 operations support and be able to rapidly distinguish isolated user problems vs service outages for Citrix technologies to include Citrix XenDesktop, Citrix XenApp, Citrix NetScaler, and Citrix StoreFront in addition to Microsoft M365 Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).
  • Monitor infrastructure and identify system anomalies before they impact customers to include storage availability/capacity, network connectivity, database health, and other daily health checks as required.
  • Work closely with Engineering staff to plan out future modernization efforts to meet customer and administrator requirements.
  • Collaborate to perform network latency analysis to address slow connections and user experience issues with alacrity.
  • Implement version and architectural changes to existing, approved, systems to maintain operability and security of the environment
  • Implement major system upgrades as designed and approved
  • Coordinate with other Tier 2 and Tier 3 teams for testing and deployment of Group Policy modifications
  • Perform periodic backup and restoration of servers
  • Monitor desktop capacity to size the environment based on typical usage trends
  • Monitor License and Certificate status on the systems and coordinate the renewal and installation as needed.
  • Coordinate with customers and stakeholders to collect data, conduct analysis, develop, and implement solutions associated with incident tickets and requirements.
  • Establish comprehensive availability and capacity management solution using lessons learned
  • Develop solutions to technical issues.
  • Provide follow-up reports (technical findings, feedback, resolution steps taken) for root cause analysis, engineering technical assessment and process improvement initiatives.
  • Periodically review, update, and generate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for systems and services under your control.
  • Update operations and monitoring documentation for 24/7/365 IT Operations Center (ITOC) personnel.
  • Respond to after-hours outages when deemed mission critical by ITOC government rep.
  • Conduct routine maintenance following customers prescribed maintenance windows which may include evening and/or weekend maintenance to minimize impact on customers and their mission.
  • Provide mentorship and training for junior team members.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with interacting with customers to handle service inquiries and problems.
  • Experience working as a Tier 2 and Tier 3 system administrator: familiar with using desktop software applications such as web browsing and client software, and IT Service Management software such as ServiceNow.
  • Knowledge of IC IT standards and best practices.
  • Extensive knowledge of Citrix technologies to include, XenDesktop, XenApp, NetScaler, and StoreFront.
  • Experience managing Microsoft M365 Azure Virtual Desktops (AVD).
  • Extensive experience with patch and upgrade methodology for front-end and back-end systems based on Citrix technology.
  • Experience with rapid testing, validation, and deployment of new baseline images
  • Extensive experience with conducting incident and trend analysis via log review, performance baselining/review, and other incident/problem management techniques to develop solutions to ongoing issues impacting customer experience
  • Experience with Scripting/Automation
  • Experience troubleshooting issues in a growing environment.
  • Time management skills.
  • Strong oral and written communications skills.
  • Track record of working effectively within a team and support to peers toward improved processes and results.
  • Experience with support ticket management systems.
  • Experience mentoring others and/or supervising others.
  • Candidate must, at a minimum, meet DoDM 8140.03 (previously DoD 8570) – IT System Admin Intermediate certification requirements (Cloud+, GICSP, SSCP, Security+ CE, GSEC, or higher).
  • Candidate must have a Bachelor's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience, Master’s degree with 6 years, Associate's with 10 years, or High School Diploma with 12 years.
  • TS/SCI with Poly required for Position or TS/SCI and willingness to obtain and maintain a poly. US Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Citrix Certified Administrator (CCA)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty
  • Microsoft 365 Administrator
  • ITIL Foundations Certification

title: Director, Enterprise Transformation Communications
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.

We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world’s most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come. As the Director, Enterprise Transformation Communications at Gilead, you will lead communications for major transformation initiatives across Gilead, helping employees, leaders and key stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters and how the work supports our mission, business priorities, employee experience and impact for patients.

Reporting into the Corporate & Enterprise Communications team, this role will serve as a strategic communications lead for enterprise transformation work, including operating model evolution, organizational change, new ways of working, capability building, digital and AI-enabled transformation, global capability expansion and other cross-functional initiatives that require clear, coordinated and credible communications.

The Director will partner closely with Public Affairs, Human Resources, Information Technology, Finance, Legal, Compliance, business functions and transformation teams to translate complex business and organizational change into clear, people-centered communications that build trust, reduce confusion and enable engagement. This role requires a strategic thinker and hands-on communicator who can operate across a matrixed global organization, advise senior leaders and help connect transformation priorities into one enterprise narrative.

Enterprise Transformation Strategy & Narrative

  • Develop and execute communications strategies that support enterprise transformation priorities, milestones and long-term change journeys.

  • Create clear narratives that connect transformation work to business outcomes, employee experience, operational effectiveness, culture and patient impact.

  • Maintain consistent messaging across workstreams, audiences, channels, leadership teams and enterprise forums.

  • Translate complex operating model, process, technology and organizational changes into accessible communications for broad employee and leader audiences.

  • Identify opportunities to connect individual transformation efforts into a broader enterprise story that helps employees see how the work fits together.

Executive Communications & Strategic Advisory

  • Serve as a strategic communications advisor to senior leaders sponsoring or leading enterprise transformation initiatives.

  • Develop executive presentations, talking points, leader messages, FAQs, cascade materials, town hall content and other leader-ready communications.

  • Support communications for leadership forums, enterprise meetings, Board discussions and other high-visibility business moments tied to transformation work.

  • Help leaders communicate change with clarity, empathy and consistency, including when details are still evolving.

Employee Engagement & Change Communications

  • Lead communications strategies that build employee awareness, understanding, confidence and engagement during periods of significant change.

  • Design communications plans that support change readiness, adoption, feedback, leader enablement and sustained behavior change.

  • Develop practical materials that help employees understand what is changing, what is not changing, what comes next and where to go for support.

  • Create channels and feedback loops to surface employee questions, sentiment and areas of confusion, then adjust communications accordingly.

  • Showcase progress, proof points and employee stories that make transformation work tangible and meaningful.

Transformation Governance, Risk & Message Alignment

  • Partner with transformation teams to ensure communications are integrated into program governance, planning, milestones and decision-making rhythms.

  • Help identify communications risks, employee concerns, reputational considerations and stakeholder needs related to enterprise change.

  • Ensure transformation messaging is clear, credible, aligned and consistent across functions, geographies and leadership levels.

  • Partner with Legal, Compliance, Human Resources and other stakeholders to ensure communications are accurate, responsible and appropriate for the business context.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Enterprise Coordination

  • Lead communications planning and execution for transformation initiatives spanning multiple functions, teams and geographies.

  • Build strong partnerships across Public Affairs, HR, IT, Finance, Legal, Compliance, business functions and transformation teams.

  • Coordinate with internal communications, executive communications, digital, social, brand, media and other Public Affairs partners to activate integrated plans across channels.

  • Drive alignment around priorities, sequencing, messaging, stakeholder engagement and communications deliverables.

  • Manage agency and vendor relationships as appropriate.

Specific Education & Experience Requirements:

  • BA degree in communications, liberal arts, business or science-oriented field and minimum 12+ years of relevant experience OR

  • MS degree in communications, liberal arts, business or science-oriented field and minimum 10+ years of relevant experience OR

  • PhD in communications, liberal arts, business or science-oriented field and a minimum of 8+ years of relevant experience

  • Relevant experience is defined as: years of healthcare public relations experience

Specific Job Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for public relations programming within the Public Affairs group, in particular supporting the company’s growing portfolio of products and pipeline programs

  • Effectively manages all aspects of public relations agency relationships, such as providing direction and project management

  • May manage department staff, as appropriate

  • Manages budgets to target

  • Collaborates and regularly participates as a member of cross-functional teams, representing external communications function; provides public relations recommendations to help achieve company goals

  • Develops and implements media relations strategies for specific areas of responsibility, such as product and/or corporate related initiatives

  • Serves as media spokesperson for product and/or corporate news; responds to media requests and arranges interviews with management and opinion leader spokespeople as appropriate

  • Examines complex issues from a broader organization perspective, determines communications opportunities and helps determine priorities within the Public Affairs group
    Prepares press releases, presentations and other communications materials with minimal oversight

People Leader Accountabilities:

  • Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.

  • Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.

  • Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

title: Full Stack AI Engineer (Contract)
description:
[What the role is]

The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is seeking a skilled Software Engineer to join our Gen AI team and develop next-generation applications powered by advanced AI technologies. This role focuses on hands-on implementation of AI-driven applications using cutting-edge AI frameworks that support MAS’ role in the Singapore's financial sector, whilst ensuring robust governance and operational excellence.

Agentic Web Application Development

Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces that allow users to interact with, monitor, and control AI agents performing complex tasks and workflows.

Search & Retrieval Development

Build data ingestion pipelines and vector indexing workflows that support real-time query processing and document retrieval. Develop robust error handling and fallback mechanisms for search service integration, including query reformulation and result ranking optimisation.

User Interface & Experience Implementation
Build intuitive web interfaces that enable MAS officers to interact with complex AI systems with lower learning curve. Implement dashboards, configuration panels, and monitoring interfaces that provide clear visibility into AI application performance and behaviour.

Performance Optimisation & Scalability
Implement performance optimisations for web applications handling AI workloads. Build caching mechanisms, request queuing systems, and load balancing solutions that ensure responsive user experiences even under heavy AI processing loads.

Security & Compliance Implementation
Implement security measures including authentication, authorisation, and data protection within web applications. Ensure all developments adhere to MAS operational controls and regulatory standards through proper implementation of security features and audit logging.

title: Associate, Infrastructure Credit
description:
About this role

Business Unit Overview:

Global Infrastructure Partners (“GIP”), a part of BlackRock, is a leading infrastructure investment manager with US$193Bn of AUM, comprised of US$112Bn of Global Equity, US$39Bn of Specialized Equity, $31Bn of Credit, and $11Bn of Solutions capital as of September 30th, 2025. The platform has a 20-year track record, ~680 dedicated professionals, and deploys capital globally in four primary infrastructure verticals (i) energy, (ii) transportation, (iii) Digital, and (iv) water & waste.

The GIP Credit Team has 60+ investment professionals that have deployed ~$19Bn of Investment-Grade capital and ~$10Bn of Non-Investment Grade capital in debt, preferred, and structured equity formats. As a member of the Asia-Pacific (APAC) Infrastructure Credit team, you will support the Singapore and Hong Kong based investment professionals in in the originating, assessing, executing, and monitoring infrastructure credit investments across developed and emerging APAC markets. This role provides an opportunity to work on complex infrastructure transactions and contribute to a growing platform with global reach and an established investment track record.

Job Purpose/Background:

The GIP Credit Team has an opportunity for a qualified and experienced candidate to join the investment team in Singapore. The role will have responsibility for project and financial modelling, deal assessment and execution, development and review of investment committee materials, and portfolio monitoring for both investment grade and non-investment grade transactions. The role will also involve assisting in preparing presentations and pitch books, cash flow analysis, researching and report writing. The position offers broad exposure to infrastructure sectors, financing structures, and investment transactions while providing opportunities for professional development within a collaborative and entrepreneurial investment environment.

Key Responsibilities:

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

  • Financial modelling: running and developing bespoke financial models in order to analyze investment opportunities
  • Deal assessment and execution: working with the team to assess and execute project investments. This will include conducting due diligence, financial review, and preparation of investment committee materials.
  • Market research: including research on potential investments, policy, competitors, technology, sectors, etc.
  • Portfolio monitoring: assist in the monitoring of investments in the portfolio
  • Other ad-hoc tasks related to the Infrastructure Credit platform from time to time including fundraising activities

Qualifications:

We are looking for candidates with:

  • 2-4 years of relevant work experience (e.g. Project Finance, Infrastructure Investing, Leverage Finance, M&A, or Restructuring, or related fields)
  • Bachelor’s degree required with a strong academic record – Major in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, or engineering a plus
  • Strong financial modelling skills, particularly focused on cash flow and capital structure analysis
  • Experience of undertaking infrastructure due diligence processes and reviewing finance and/or project legal documentation
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Quick learner who is highly organized, has exceptional project management skills and is able to manage multiple workstreams effectively and deliver quality work on schedule
  • Enthusiasm and commitment to working in a friendly, entrepreneurial, team environment
  • A keen interest in the infrastructure and debt markets
  • Strong understanding of the infrastructure sectors and financing structures across Asia Pacific markets including Emerging Markets APAC
  • Strong attention to detail, commercial judgment and problem-solving capabilities
  • Fluency in English - additional Asian language a plus

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

POSITION SPECIFICS

The Department of Astronomy and Astrophysics at Penn State invites applications for a full-time Lecturer or Assistant Teaching Professor position (non-tenure track) to begin by January 2027. The successful candidate will join a team that runs very large online interdomain classes in astronomy and art. They will be responsible for working on the day-to-day operations of the classes, including availability on Zoom office hours, answering student emails, grading assignments, and making course announcements. They will also be partners in efforts to improve and update the course materials, which include the University of Mars video game (written in Unity 3D), astronomy art projects, creative writing assignments, and telescope observation quests with the Slooh network. They can also participate in new video game development for other astronomy courses at Penn State, in instructional design, programming, or art design.

Education and Experience

The successful candidate should have a master’s degree (Lecturer) or a Ph.D. (Assistant Teaching Professor) in Astronomy, Physics, Art, or in a related field. The successful candidate should have teaching experience, a strong interest in teaching in an online format, and a student-centered, experiential teaching philosophy. They should also have experience and interest in a combination of astronomical art, video game design, video game programming, and astronomy education research.

Applications must be submitted electronically and include the following:

  • Cover letter detailing qualifications for the position including relevant educational background as well as any related teaching experience.

Vi leder efter dig, som motiveres af at løse tekniske problemer samt reparere og servicere teknologiske avancerede produkter.

  • Du er god til at prioritere og planlægge dit arbejde.
  • Du har en god evne til og vane med at arbejde selvstændigt og du sikrer på egen hånd struktur og overblik blandt flere opgaver.
  • Du trives med kunde- og brugerkontakt, hvor du agerer tillidsfuldt og roligt – også når der foregår meget på samme tid.

Et meget selvstændigt job med gode kolleger, en god løn med pensionsordning, sundheds- og heltidsulykkesforsikring. Der stilles egen servicevogn med værktøj og mobiltelefon til rådighed samt arbejdstøj.

Jobbet er spændende med mange rutiner og udfordringer med tilhørende løbende efteruddannelse i et uformelt og trygt arbejdsmiljø.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Servicechef Rene Toft på mobil: 40 76 00 15 .

Om os:

OTIS Danmark er inde i en meget positiv udvikling og er med sine dygtige medarbejdere og gode økonomiske resultater et af de største elevatorfirma i Danmark.

OTIS er verdens største producent af elevatorer, rulletrapper og rullende fortove. Vi producerer og opstiller nye elevatorer samt moderniserer og udfører service på alle typer elevatorer. Kernen i vores forretning er kundeorienteret problemløsning.

I Danmark er vi ca. 225 ansatte med hovedkontor i Herlev og et mindre kontor i Viby J. nær Århus.

If you live in a city, chances are we will give you a lift or play a role in keeping you moving every day.

You may recognize our products in some of the world’s most famous landmarks including the Eiffel Tower, Empire State Building, Burj Khalifa and the Petronas Twin Towers! We are 72,000 people strong, including engineers, digital technology experts, sales, and functional specialists, as well as factory and field technicians, all committed to meeting the diverse needs of our customers and passengers in more than 200 countries and territories worldwide. We are proud to be a diverse, global team with a proven legacy of innovation that continues to be the bedrock of a fast-moving, high-performance company.

When you join Otis, you become part of an innovative global industry leader with a resilient business model. You’ll belong to a diverse, trusted, and caring community where your contributions, and the skills and capabilities you’ll gain working alongside the best and brightest, keep us connected and on the cutting edge.

We provide opportunities, training, and resources, that build leadership and capabilities in Sales, Field, Engineering and Major Projects and our Employee Scholar Program is a notable point of pride, through which Otis sponsors colleagues to pursue degrees or certification programs.

Today, our focus more than ever is on people. As a global, people-powered company, we put people – passengers, customers, and colleagues – at the center of everything we do. title: Deputy Technical Director, Electron-Ion Collider
description:
Brookhaven National Laboratory (BNL) is the site for the new Electron-Ion Collider (EIC), a one-of-a-kind nuclear physics research facility. The EIC will be a discovery machine for unlocking the secrets of the “glue” that binds the building blocks of visible matter in the universe. The machine design is based on the existing and highly optimized RHIC Ion-Ion collider. It will consist of two intersecting accelerators, one producing an intense beam of electrons, the other a beam of protons or heavier atomic nuclei which are steered into collisions. Beyond sparking scientific discoveries in a new frontier of fundamental physics, the Electron-Ion Collider will trigger technological breakthroughs that have broad-ranging impact on human health and national challenges.

Position Description:

The EIC Deputy Technical Director reports to the EIC Technical Director and serves as the principal deputy responsible for supporting the Technical Director in all technical aspects of the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) Project, including design, integration, construction, commissioning, and technical performance. The Deputy Technical Director oversees the Chief Systems Engineer and the Systems Engineering organization, providing leadership for systems engineering, technical integration, requirements management, interface control, and configuration management across all EIC project systems. Working closely with Brookhaven National Laboratory, Thomas Jefferson National Accelerator Facility, partner laboratories, and collaborating institutions, this position coordinates project-wide accelerator physics, technology, and engineering activities to ensure successful technical integration and design convergence. The Deputy Technical Director serves as one of key interfaces with the U.S. Department of Energy, Laboratory management, and external review bodies on matters of technical performance, readiness, and risk; acts on behalf of the Technical Director when delegated or in their absence; and serves as a member of the EIC Executive Management Team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist the Technical Director in setting and maintaining an overall technical vision, strategy, and direction for the EIC project

  • Support the Technical Director in providing technical leadership for the design, integration, construction, installation, commissioning, and operational readiness of the EIC Project.

  • Direct and oversee the EIC Systems Engineering organization, including direct supervision of the Chief Systems Engineer and indirect supervision of the Systems Engineering staff.

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and documentation of project technical reviews, including system, design, readiness, and acceptance reviews, to ensure compliance with DOE requirements and project standards.

  • Facilitate technical integration and design convergence across the accelerator, detector, and conventional facilities subsystems, ensuring that cross-system dependencies and interfaces are identified and managed.

  • Support implementation and maintenance of the EIC technical baseline through systems engineering, requirements management, interface control, and configuration management processes.

  • Identify, evaluate, and resolve technical risks and integration issues in collaboration with project leadership, System Managers, and engineering teams.

  • Coordinate technical activities among Brookhaven National Laboratory, Jefferson Lab, partner laboratories, universities, and international collaborators to ensure successful execution of the EIC technical scope.

  • Support preparation for DOE project reviews, including Critical Decision milestones and Accelerator Readiness Reviews, ensuring technical documentation and engineering readiness requirements are satisfied.

  • Serve as a member of the EIC Change Control Board, providing technical evaluation and recommendations for proposed engineering changes and technical baseline modifications.

  • Provide technical leadership and engineering input to project planning, technical basis of estimate development, risk management, and project cost, schedule, and performance reporting.

  • Represent the Technical Director in project reviews, technical meetings, and interactions with DOE and external stakeholders as delegated, and act on behalf of the Technical Director when required.

  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing culture.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Master's degree in engineering, physics, or a related technical discipline.

  • Twelve (12) years of related experience, including at least eight (8) years of progressively responsible technical leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering or scientific organizations. Experience leading the technical execution of large, complex scientific, engineering, or accelerator projects/programs is required.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of particle accelerators, colliders, and all associated technologies.

  • Experience coordinating and/or leading international multidisciplinary teams and technical activities across multiple organizations and institutions.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of design, technical risk management, and project execution for complex scientific or technical facilities.

  • Excellent presentation, written, and oral communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage, motivate, direct, and lead effectively among a diverse group of scientific, engineering, technical, and administrative personnel.

  • Demonstrated commitment to working safely, acting ethically, and taking personal accountability for operational excellence.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Certification as Project Management Professional

  • National or international recognition in the field of particle accelerators and associated technologies.

  • Experience with management of DOE Office of Science capital asset projects or international large-science projects.

  • Experience with leading design, engineering and technical integration activities for large accelerator, scientific, or research facilities.

  • Experience with commissioning and operating particle colliders and subsystems.

  • Knowledge of DOE configuration management and project management requirements.

  • Experience supporting DOE Critical Decision reviews, Independent Project Reviews, and Accelerator Readiness Reviews.

  • In-depth knowledge of DOE policies, procedures, and engineering standards and practices.

Other Information

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

  • This is an on-site position in Upton, NY.

  • For consideration, please apply by: 9/15/26

Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to providing fair, equitable and competitive compensation. Salary offers will be commensurate with the final candidate’s qualification, education and experience and considered with the internal peer group.


Brookhaven National Laboratory is committed to employee success and we believe that a comprehensive employee benefits program is an important and meaningful part of the compensation employees receive. Review more information at BNL | Benefits Program

This is due to nationwide identification requirements for federal site access as required by the federal REAL ID Act. Those not in possession of a REAL ID-compliant document will not be permitted to access the site which includes access to the Laboratory for interviews.

The credentialing process is completed as part of onboarding and enables access to DOE facilities and information systems. About Us

Brookhaven National Laboratory (www.bnl.gov) delivers discovery science and transformative technology to power and secure the nation’s future. Brookhaven Lab is a multidisciplinary laboratory with seven Nobel Prize-winning discoveries, 37 R&D 100 Awards, and more than 70 years of pioneering research. The Lab is primarily supported by the U.S. Department of Energy’s (DOE) Office of Science. Brookhaven Science Associates (BSA) operates and manages the Laboratory for DOE. title: Director, North America Operations Finance & Controller
description:
Job Responsibilities & Requirements

The Director, North America Operations Finance & Controller is responsible for leading accounting, manufacturing FP&A, and fixed asset management across the United States and Canada. This position serves as the finance strategic business partner to Supply Chain and Manufacturing and executive leadership while ensuring financial integrity, accurate reporting, effective internal controls, and actionable business insights.

The Director will oversee month-end close activities, manufacturing financial planning and analysis, capital investment governance, fixed asset accounting, and financial support for operational decision-making. The role will lead a team of finance and accounting professionals who support 10 manufacturing plants and play a critical role in driving profitability, operational efficiency, and continuous process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Lead accounting activities for North American manufacturing operations, ensuring compliance with U.S. GAAP and company policies.
  • Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, including general ledger ownership of the manufacturing P&L & balance sheet accounts, account reconciliations, journal entry approvals, and balance sheet reviews.
  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting and analysis for business and finance leadership.
  • Maintain strong internal controls.
  • Partner with Corporate Accounting on complex accounting matters, policy implementation, and compliance initiatives.
  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes, standardization, and automation.
  • Serve as a key stakeholder and business process owner for finance-related systems and data governance, partnering with IT and cross-functional teams to maintain data accuracy, optimize system performance, and support ongoing business transformation initiatives.

Manufacturing FP&A

  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, and monthly financial performance reviews for manufacturing operations.
  • Partner with plant leadership to analyze operational performance, including material, labor, overhead and freight productivity and cost variances.
  • Provide actionable insights on revenue, margins, manufacturing costs, inventory, and working capital.
  • Develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational dashboards.
  • Support strategic initiatives, including footprint optimization, productivity programs, and capital investments.
  • Lead financial analysis of operational risks and opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
  • Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, and Plant Leadership to plan, execute, and monitor annual and cycle count inventory programs. Evaluate inventory accuracy, investigate significant variances, ensure timely resolution of discrepancies, and assess financial statement impacts.

Fixed Assets & Capital Management

  • Oversee fixed asset accounting and reporting for North America.
  • Establish governance processes for capital expenditures, project approvals, capitalization, depreciation, and asset retirements.
  • Partner with Operations to evaluate capital investment proposals and expected returns.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies related to fixed assets and lease accounting.
  • Monitor capital spending against approved budgets and provide regular reporting to leadership.

Business Partnership & Strategic Support

  • Act as a trusted advisor to Manufacturing, Operations, Commercial and Finance leaders.
  • Provide financial leadership for major business initiatives, acquisitions, system implementations, and process transformations.
  • Support pricing, cost reduction, productivity, and margin improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and cash flow performance.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team.
  • Establish clear objectives and accountability for key team members.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and business partnership.
  • Promote strong financial acumen throughout the organization.
  • Ability to effectively delegate responsibility while empowering team members to make decisions and assume greater ownership.
  • Strong people leadership skills with ability to inspire and influence teams through periods of growth, change and transformation.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience within manufacturing, industrial, or operational finance environments. Ability to translate financial data into operational insights.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and internal controls.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing or multi-site operations.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and business partnering skills.
  • Proven track record of leading change, improving processes, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders to achieve business objectives.
  • Strong strategic thinking and foresight with the ability to anticipate business needs, assess financial implications an develop actionable solutions.

Preferred

  • CPA, CMA, or MBA.
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems.
  • Experience leading finance functions within a multinational organization.
  • Knowledge of standard costing, inventory accounting, and manufacturing performance metrics.
  • Experience supporting operations across both the United States and Canada.

Critical Success Factors

  • Strong business acumen and operational finance expertise.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Proven track record of influencing senior leaders and driving change.
  • High degree of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Exceptional leadership and talent development capabilities.
  • Proactive leader who demonstrates initiative, anticipates challenges and opportunities, and drives results.

Additional Requirements

Ability to travel up to 20% to support manufacturing sites, business reviews, and operational initiatives across North America.

This role is primarily office-based but may require periodic access to manufacturing facilities, including exposure to standard factory conditions such as noise, temperature variation, machinery, and other operational environments.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Vice President, Regional Finance North America

Direct Oversight:

  • Manufacturing Accounting Team
  • Fixed Asset Accounting

title: Senior Product Manager - Partner Algorithms
description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role:

This is a critical role at the heart of an ambitious, customer-obsessed, world-leading technology company. This is a senior role to build customer facing recommendation/ranking algorithms within the Customer department.

This specific role focuses on the Partner recommendations product which includes our home page ranking and recommendation systems. It would suit someone who is passionate about solving customer problems and loves working with data, who has extensive experience working with engineering and data science on ML challenges and is eager for more.

Algorithms are used to match customers to the right supply, guiding them to partners that will deliver a great experience and food they will love. They are used to shape demand to achieve operational/commercial goals and to optimise revenue by maximising spend and promoting sponsored restaurants and products. The work we do makes a tangible difference to our customers’ lives and to the success of our partners.

These are some of the key ingredients to the role:

  • Define and own product vision, strategy, and roadmap for ranking/recommendation systems.

  • Understand user behavior and identify improvement opportunities through data analysis and experimentation.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and engineering teams to translate requirements into algorithms.

  • Lead product discovery, including user research and competitive analysis.

  • Define and analyze KPIs to measure success and identify optimization areas.

  • Design and execute A/B tests to validate hypotheses and iterate on features.

  • Prioritize the product backlog and communicate product plans to stakeholders.

What will you bring to the table?

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager focused on data-driven products, particularly in ranking, recommendations, search, or personalization.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and use data science or ML solutions.

  • Obsession for understanding and influencing user behavior and improving customer experience through data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including, growth and other product teams, engineers, analytics, and data scientists.

  • Comfort and proficiency in working with numbers and quantitative data, with familiarity with data analysis tools.

  • Experience with agile development environments and an understanding of Data Science model development.

At JET, this is on the menu:

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

The position requires solid leadership, project management skills, and stakeholder coordination. The incumbent must be independent, goal-oriented, flexible, able to work efficiently across multiple projects, enthusiastic, and innovative, with a solid understanding of good manufacturing practices and technologies to support the needs of the Site/Network Manufacturing Teams.

Shift Available:

  • Monday-Friday 9:00am-5:00pm

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a subject matter expert in data analytics, closely working with Manufacturing and Technical.

  • Operations subject matter experts to define, prioritize, and document business needs and solution requirements; work with external and internal BI&T partners to develop data analytics and data science solutions, serving as the key conduit between business and BI&T.

  • Create dashboards and visualizations using data analytics tools and conduct ad-hoc data analysis to support operational and business decision-making.

  • Provide technical direction and expertise to Site teams (Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Shared Services, etc.) to support and improve capacity, quality, and cost, or to establish root cause.

  • Work closely with end users and process owners to establish and maintain service level expectations across all functions and site systems.

  • Support the Automation and Data Intake (assessment) and backlog of proposals and requests to utilize resources efficiently and ensure alignment with Site objectives, Network policies, practices, and Senior Leadership direction.

  • Deliver key improvements across the manufacturing network by deploying recipe updates, manufacturing data analysis reports, and technical insight; provide MES product impact assessments to support investigations and product release.

  • Contribute to the development and configuration of digital solutions — such as electronic batch records and process automation technologies — ensuring solutions are fit for intended use per business requirements throughout the full solution lifecycle.

  • Support lifecycle management and project implementation at the site level, including participation in project teams to prepare schedules, execute technical projects, and develop presentations for stakeholders and management.

  • Translate business requirements into functional and design specifications that are compliant, efficient, and effective.

Knowledge & Skills:

title: Instrumentation & Electrical Technician
description:
ABOUT POET

At POET, it is our mission to be good stewards of the Earth by converting renewable resources to energy and other valuable goods as effectively as humanly possible. For over thirty years our drive and passion to change the world has enabled us to become the largest producer and marketer of bioethanol and a leader in sustainable products in the world.


BENEFITS & PERKS

Eligible Team Members may receive

  • $$ Competitive BONUS opportunities - up to SIX bonuses per year (Quarterly Profit Sharing & Value Share)

  • Paid time off and paid holidays - 40 hours of PTO available on Day 1, on top of a biweekly PTO accrual program!

  • Comprehensive benefits package; Individual and family plans for health, dental, & vision insurance, including a generous employer Health Savings Account contribution

  • Competitive pay, including shift premium pay for qualifying positions

  • 401K with company match

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • Attractive Relocation Assistance and Bonus Programs for qualifying positions and/or locations

  • Safety and cold weather gear reimbursements

  • Discounted home and auto insurance

All POET Team Members enjoy

  • A multifaceted wellness program encompassing the whole person – mentally, physically, and spiritually

  • 'Family-first' culture

  • Onsite fitness centers or fitness reimbursements

JOB SUMMARY & RESPONSIBILITIES

The Instrumentation & Electrical Technician is responsible for troubleshooting and identifying root-cause issues, repairing or replacing parts and rewiring and installing related instrument/electrical goods at the bioprocessing facility. The Instrumentation & Electrical Technician ensures that all work performed follows electrical codes and tests and inspects and repairs issues when they occur. Team members in this position will communicate any problems or concerns to the management team. This role is also responsible for reviewing all electrical procedures for the bioprocessing facility, assisting in developing pertinent electrical programs and training team members. Continuous plant operation includes 24/7 schedules. Team member must be able to meet call-in requirements as needed.

This is an on-site role located in Coon Rapids, IA. Responsibilities include:

  • Troubleshoot and identify a root cause, repair, or replace parts, rewire and install related instrument/electrical goods including conduit and/or wiring.

  • Ensure that all work performed is completed by following all local electrical codes. Including 4160V, 480V, 220V, 110V, 24V DC and 4-20 mA loops and circuits as applicable to the location.

  • Troubleshoot PLC/DCS I/O including 4-20mA loops, 120V/24DC I/O.

  • Responsible for all preventative and proactive electrical maintenance and compliance procedures.

  • Assist with emergency and scheduled shutdowns while performing regular mechanical duties as directed.

  • Calibrate, configure, and repair of measurement/control instruments for flow, level, pressure, temperature, and pH including associated valves and valve actuators.

  • Understand electrical and instrumentation equipment associated with plant processing equipment.

  • Possess a strong understanding of motor control circuits and electric motors.

  • Inform management of any instrument/electrical parts needed and assist with maintaining the required instrument/electronic/electrical parts inventories.

  • Document and record: utilizing inventory control systems, maintaining calibration records, ordering parts, work with outside contractors, etc.

  • Work with the management team and all staff daily to ensure the operation and all facilities are operating to standards.

  • Understand how equipment and instrument/electronic controls operate and are utilized to operate the plant.

  • Maintain work area to include cleanliness, serviceability, and accountability of all tools and supplies.

  • Accomplish all other tasks, work orders, cleaning assignments or other duties as assigned by the management team.

  • Assist in developing, training, and reviewing all pertinent instrument/electrical programs and procedures including Arc Flash Hazards and electrical integrity.

  • Maintain licensing by attending state required code classes as required by location/leader.

  • Be expected to receive calls after hours, including weekends and holidays, in the event of an emergency bioprocessing situation that would require electronic or instrument/electrical expertise.

  • Always maintain a team environment and champion POET in the community.

  • Foster a culture of safe behavior and environmental compliance at all times.

  • Maintain and advance the food safety and quality of POET’s products and processes to deliver a best-in-class culture of quality.

  • Since we’re all about teamwork and getting the job done, your skills may be put to a lot of other uses!

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Associate’s degree in an electrical training program or equivalent is required.

  • Journeyman or Master License preferred but may be required based on location.

  • Thorough knowledge of standard electrical equipment and work practices is required.

  • Ability to troubleshoot, maintain, and install 4160V, 480V, 220V, 110V motors and breakers, protective relays, PLC’s, transformers, motor control centers, lights, breakers, panels, and other miscellaneous electrical equipment as applicable to the work location.

  • Troubleshoot PLC/DCS I/O including 4-20mA loops, 120V/24DC I/O.

  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills as well as the ability to embrace change.

  • You know the basics of Microsoft Office Suite. You’re capable of learning new programs.

  • Read and translate the information found within all: PLC code, Schematic wiring, and Ladder and P&ID’S process diagrams.

  • Industrial network experience.

  • Minimum of 1-3 year(s) of related work experience

  • Experience with 3 phase electrical systems up to 4160V 3 phase.

A SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE

  • High level of personal integrity

  • Interpersonal skills – ability to effectively interact with individuals at all levels within/outside the organization

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and critical thinking skills

  • Ability to embrace and promote change

  • Innovative mindset

  • Ability to think objectively

  • Self-awareness in the face of uncertainty

  • Ability to work in a team environment

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role has some physical requirements that our team members will need to be able to perform, such as:

  • Occasionally lifting weight up to sixty (60) pounds.

  • Climbing several flights of stairs and ladders.

  • Opening valves.

  • Occasionally bending, twisting and turning while lifting weight of less than fifty (50) pounds.

  • Data entry while seated for greater than one (1) hour.

  • Walking up to two (2) or more miles per day.

  • Pushing brooms, shovels, etc.

  • Working at heights, in confined spaces and at temperatures from -20 to +100 degrees.

  • Standing for extended periods of time.

  • Wearing Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

  • Using hand and power tools.

This position is largely self-directed and requires a thorough understanding of company policy, procedures, and values. Team members will be required to adhere to all safety requirements at all times and in all work environments. This position is exposed to work in multiple environments, including plant, laboratory, as well as an office environment. The team member may be exposed to high noise levels, moving mechanical parts, dusty conditions, internal and external temperature/weather conditions, and chemicals.

Due to the physical and safety sensitive nature of this job, you will be subject to a physical and expected to pass a drug screen during the pre-screen process. During employment, you’ll be subject to random drug and alcohol testing.

CULTURE IS KING AT POET

We’re all on the same team. We always communicate. And we park our egos at the door. These aren’t just slogans on our walls. It’s the way we do things at POET. We provide an environment for team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance. It’s the best way to optimize health, wellness, and productivity in a sustainable way. We work hard. We play hard. We have frequent team events, volunteer efforts, and we know how to celebrate wins!

GROWTH & DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES

At POET we encourage internal development and growth by allowing team members to carve their own path to success. Leaders support team members with the necessary resources to develop their skills, achieve goals, and create the most value. We believe in developing our team members to their highest potential and recognizing contributions that add value to the organization. Each new team member’s position and compensation are carefully determined by considering their unique qualifications and skillset.

POET is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, abilities, merit, and other legitimate business factors, without regard to any legally protected characteristic. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, working conditions, promotion, and termination.
