title: Associate, FX Hedging Oversight
description:
About this role

FX Hedging Oversight | Associate


BlackRock is one of the world’s preeminent asset management firms and a premier provider of global investment management, risk management and advisory services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors around the world. BlackRock offers a range of solutions — from rigorous fundamental and quantitative active management approaches aimed at maximizing performance to highly efficient indexing strategies designed to gain broad exposure to the capital markets. Our clients can access our investment solutions through a variety of product structures, including individual and institutional separate accounts, mutual funds and other pooled investment vehicles, and the industry-leading iShares® ETFs.


Team Overview


Enablement Platforms for Innovation and Change (EPIC) is a team within BlackRock's Technology & Operations division. We develop strategy and execute initiatives central to our indexing and firm-wide growth aspirations and priorities. In our day-to-day, the team brings together change professionals and domain specialists to deliver scale and innovation for BlackRock’s ETF products.


We place tremendous focus on empowering and developing our people, improving their leadership and delivery skills and broadening their firm and industry knowledge. Projects and roles are assigned not just based on successful delivery, but also on individual development objectives and career aspirations.


Looking forward to the next decade of exciting developments in ETFs, we are helping drive the multi-year transformation of our ETF platform. The new operating model will scale to support the next phase of growth across the ETF industry and ecosystem.


EPIC is building out the capability to be able to provide oversight and act as subject matter experts within the firm for the Currency hedged products in our ETF and mutual fund ranges.


Role Responsibility

  • Act as a subject matter expert in currency hedging for teams looking to launch currency hedged products.
  • Develop a deep operational understanding of our currency hedged ETFs and mutual funds.
  • Be able to work with both internal partners, across the organization, and external parties including currency managers and fund administrators, to find effective business solutions to meet client requirements.
  • Ensure the robustness of our products by identifying enhancements and process improvements and working with operational and technology teams to develop and implement solutions.

Key Functions include:

  • Provide oversight for the launch and operational management of products such as our currency hedged ETFs and mutual funds
  • As we take pride in delivering a varied pipeline of BlackRock products, you will be the bridge between product development, service providers and internal teams to develop and deliver on implementation plans.
  • Collect and ensure the integrity of critical data related to products, mandates, regulations and investment operations in partnership with BlackRock Data Services (BDS).
  • Manage the implementation process through use of Aladdin tools and coordinate the approval of all impacted partners.

Experience

  • You are degree qualified
  • Validated expertise in either asset management, custody, securities from a regional or global perspective
  • Good subject matter knowledge of the participants in the asset management business and their roles – fund managers, administrators, brokers, consultants and custodians
  • Strong knowledge of the asset management funds industry and experience of operational workflows in trading, compliance, middle-office, data & analytics or in the field of client reporting & performance attribution
  • Knowledge of SQL and Python is required. Knowledge of Aladdin is preferred.
  • Knowledge of FX markets and/or currency hedging preferred
  • Basic knowledge of fixed income, equity, and derivative instruments.
  • Ability to design and implement business process improvements.
  • Has a high level of self-motivation, with integrity & ethics. Has the ability to flex and to adapt to changing circumstances as the business and group grows.
  • Strong written and verbal presentation skills.
  • Strong social and relationship management ability.
  • Able to work with multiple work streams.
  • Capable of working independently, as well as being an effective and collaborative teammate.
  • Natural team player able to work in an innovative, entrepreneurial, and fast paced environment

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status and other statuses protected by law. BlackRock will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.


BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

In this role, you'll create high-impact visual content that inspires fans, enhances customer experience, and drives online sales across some of the world's most iconic football and motorsport brands.

From web shop banners and landing pages to email campaigns, social content, animations, and video assets, you'll bring campaigns to life across multiple digital touchpoints. You know how to translate commercial goals, customer insights, and brand guidelines into engaging creative that attracts customers, strengthens brand loyalty, and increases conversion.

Your work will be seen across the official online stores of world-renowned brands including McLaren Formula 1 Team, Manchester City Football Club, Aston Martin Aramco Formula One™ Team, and Fuel for Fans, the world's leading motorsport merchandise platform.

Your Mission

  • Design visually appealing banners and promotional assets for ecommerce campaigns, product launches, seasonal events, and commercial initiatives;
  • Create creative assets for:
    • Website homepage banners
    • Category and product landing pages
    • Email marketing campaigns and newsletters
    • Paid and organic social media channels
    • Display advertising and retargeting campaigns;
  • Design and create motion graphics, animations, short-form videos, and dynamic content for social media, digital marketing campaigns, and ecommerce channels;
  • Translate marketing briefs and campaign concepts into engaging visual designs that align with brand guidelines;
  • Collaborate closely with our assets to ensure consistent messaging across all customer touchpoints;
  • Design and optimize landing pages that support campaign objectives and improve conversion rates;
  • Create templates and scalable design assets that can be reused across channels and campaigns;
  • Ensure all designs are optimized for mobile first experiences;
  • Support A/B testing initiatives by developing alternative creative concepts and visual variations;
  • Maintain brand consistency across all digital channels while continuously introducing fresh and innovative creative ideas;
  • Stay up to date with design, social media, and ecommerce trends and apply best practices to improve performance.

Your Talent

We're looking for a designer who combines creative excellence with commercial awareness and a passion for digital experiences.

  • You hold a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Digital Design, Multimedia Design, UX/UI Design or a related field;
  • Experience creating digital content for ecommerce, retail, sports, fashion or lifestyle brands;
  • A strong portfolio showcasing ecommerce, digital marketing and social media projects;
  • Advanced skills in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign;
  • Experience creating motion graphics, animations and video content;
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and content best practices across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn;
  • An eye for detail and a pixel-perfect approach to design;
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills;
  • A proactive, hands-on mindset and a passion for continuous improvement;
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken;
  • We're excited about the opportunities AI brings to the creative process. Experience with AI-powered design tools, content creation workflows and emerging technologies is considered a strong advantage.

Please apply in English and enclose your portfolio link.

While we appreciate the interest from freelancers and independent professionals, we are looking for someone to join our team as an employee and are therefore only considering candidates seeking a permanent employment relationship.

This role is based in Den Bosch, the Netherlands. Working remotely from other countries is not possible.

To apply for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. We will not apply for work or residence permits.

We Offer

  • Our salaries are based on 38 hours per week, but fulltime work is 40 hours per week. Instead, you choose between a lot of holidays; 40 per year ór choose for a 40-hour salary per month with still 28 holidays. You can switch every six months;
  • Annual bonus scheme;
  • New hires (introduction) days;
  • Great offer of e-learnings and a training offer for personal development;
  • Enough free fruit for you daily vitamins;
  • Provided lunch for low cost;
  • Choose between lease-bike, NS Business Card or travel by car for € 0,25 per km (>10km).
  • 8% holiday allowance, employee insurances and a good pension scheme;
  • Employee discount on the PUMA, Levi’s, Fuelforfans and BMW Lifestyle websites;
  • Hybrid working. On fulltime basis 3 days in the office and 2 days at home (incl. allowance for home working);
  • Flexible working hours, modern workspace and a good working atmosphere;
  • International working environment with colleagues of more than 50 different nationalities;
  • Wellbeing activities (f.e. yoga, pilates and bootcamp) and an inhouse gym;
  • Community involvement (STICHD impact tool);
  • STICHD drinks 5/6x per year in the city center of Den Bosch;
  • Work hard, play hard. Our STICHD-events are legendary.

About Us

We like to think of ourselves as a family of experts.

Ok, we know what you’re thinking: at over 700 members, that’s a pretty big family. But what we really mean is that, whatever our skills or our story, whatever the task or the time pressure, we’re in it together. Pushing each other, backing each other and believing in each other, always.

We’re one STICHD. And that matters, because this one company does a lot.

We partner with some of the world’s most iconic brands to create products that people love. From socks and underwear to swim and fanwear. From PUMA and Levi’s to Formula 1 and Manchester City. From design and logistics to retail and events. From our HQ in the Netherlands to sales offices and logistics centres all over the world. Like we said: a lot.

Why join us?

Because at STICHD, you get the best of both worlds. The buzz and exposure of working on a global scale with the world’s biggest brands. The freedom and flexibility to find your own passion and follow your own path. But most of all, because we care. We really care. About our brands and products. About each package and every fan’s experience. About one another.

We have some amazing people at STICHD. People with different backgrounds and skillsets, perspectives and personalities. Global leaders in their field who always stay curious, grounded and never stop learning.

Does this sound like it could be you? Click ‘apply’ and show us what you’ve got!

AQCUISITION AS A RESULT OF VACANIES IS NOT APPRECIATED

title: Vehicle Prep Porter / PDI Technician
description:
Build Your Career in Automotive While Helping Keep Our Dealership Moving

We’re looking for a dependable, energetic, and detail-oriented Vehicle Prep Porter / PDI Technician to join our fast-paced dealership team.

This is an important role within our Reconditioning and Sales operations. You’ll help make sure vehicles move efficiently through the dealership and are clean, inspected, organized, and ready for display, customer delivery, or the next step in the recon process.

If you enjoy working around vehicles, take pride in doing quality work, and like staying busy in a team-oriented environment, we’d love to meet you.

A Career Path — Not Just a Job

This position is designed to provide a clear path for growth within our dealership.

Team members begin by learning the fundamentals of vehicle preparation, lot organization, vehicle movement, cleaning, merchandising, and delivery preparation. As your knowledge, speed, and proficiency grow, you can advance into a Vehicle Prep Porter II / PDI Technician role with expanded responsibilities supporting new vehicle inventory and Honda Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) operations.

You don’t need extensive automotive experience to get started. We’ll provide training and help you develop the skills needed to advance.

Schedule

This is a full-time position with a rotating schedule:

  • Monday–Thursday: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM or 10:00 AM–7:00 PM
  • Friday: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • Every other Saturday: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM
  • When you work a Saturday, you will receive a weekday off during that same week.

Because this is a busy dealership environment, flexibility, punctuality, and reliable attendance are essential.

What You’ll Do

As a Vehicle Prep Porter / PDI Technician, you’ll help keep vehicles and the dealership moving efficiently.

Vehicle Preparation & Reconditioning Support

  • Prepare new and pre-owned vehicles for customer delivery and dealership display.
  • Wash, clean, fuel, and detail vehicles according to dealership standards.
  • Prepare vehicles for the Sales team and online merchandising.
  • Take inventory photos and ensure vehicles are properly prepared for online presentation.
  • Install buyer’s guides, stock tags, license plate brackets, stickers, and required addendums.
  • Apply windshield protection products according to dealership standards.
  • Move vehicles safely throughout dealership, sales, service, and reconditioning areas.
  • Transport vehicles to and from outside/sublet services when needed.
  • Help maintain organized vehicle lots and ensure inventory is parked in the appropriate locations.
  • Assist with maintaining dealership cleanliness, including trash removal and tire disposal.
  • Communicate with Sales, Service, Parts, and Reconditioning to help keep vehicles moving through the workflow.
  • Perform other related responsibilities as needed to support dealership operations.

Growth Into PDI / New Vehicle Inventory

As you gain experience and demonstrate proficiency, you may advance into expanded responsibilities, including:

  • Preparing new Honda inventory for Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI).
  • Performing PDI-related preparation according to Honda standards and dealership procedures.
  • Installing factory and dealer accessories according to Honda iN standards.
  • Completing new vehicle check-in documentation accurately and efficiently.
  • Performing vehicle damage inspections during transportation and inventory unloads.
  • Coordinating with Sales, Service, and Parts to prepare incoming new vehicle inventory.
  • Helping ensure new vehicles are properly processed and ready for the next stage of the sales and delivery process.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is reliable, coachable, self-motivated, and takes pride in their work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • Ability to safely operate automatic and manual-transmission vehicles preferred.
  • Strong work ethic and excellent attendance.
  • Positive attitude and customer-first mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working both independently and with multiple departments.
  • Basic computer and technology skills.
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to stand, bend, walk, and lift up to 50 pounds throughout the workday.
  • Previous dealership, automotive, detailing, porter, recon, service, or parts experience is helpful but not required.
  • Ability to successfully complete a pre-employment background check and drug screening.

The Right Person for This Role

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Enjoy working with vehicles.
  • Like staying busy and being productive throughout the day.
  • Notice the small details others may miss.
  • Take pride in clean, properly prepared vehicles.
  • Show up on time and can be counted on by your team.
  • Are willing to learn and take direction.
  • Want an opportunity to build a long-term career in the automotive industry.

Why Join Our Team?

  • Career advancement opportunities
  • Paid training and professional development
  • Team-oriented, supportive work environment
  • Ongoing automotive and dealership training
  • Employee discounts on parts and services
  • Health and dental insurance
  • Supplemental vision, dental, and life insurance
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Closed on major holidays
  • Short-term disability insurance
  • Employer-paid life insurance coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Fitness Club Discount
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Opportunities to learn new skills and take on additional responsibilities

Ready to Get Started?

If you’re dependable, enjoy working around vehicles, and want an opportunity to learn, grow, and build a career in the automotive industry, we want to hear from you.

You’ll be joining a team that values teamwork, quality, accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement while playing an important role in getting our inventory ready for our customers.

Click HERE for a video of one of our PDI Techs!

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

As the Lead/Principal of AI Ecosystem GTM strategy, you will sit at the intersection of product strategy, partner ecosystem enablement, and go-to-market (GTM) execution. You will be the primary storyteller and strategic marketing force driving the adoption of our cutting-edge Generative AI capabilities across our partner network. In this role, you will design and execute product marketing strategies that articulate the value of agentic workflows and LLM orchestration, while directly leading technical workshops with AI ecosystem partners to co-create high-impact use cases. This is a high-visibility opportunity to fuel customer growth, shape the market narrative, and position Cloud Air’s platforms as the premier foundation for enterprise automation.

  • Drive AI Ecosystem GTM Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive product marketing plans tailored to AI ecosystem initiatives, translating complex technical capabilities into compelling, value-driven positioning and messaging.

  • Facilitate AI & Generative AI Workshops: Design, launch, and host interactive, collaborative workshops for AI ecosystem partners to explore advanced generative AI use cases, accelerating partner-led customer acquisition and expansion.

  • Create Value-Driven Collateral: Build high-impact marketing assets, including technical blueprints, solution briefs, ROI models, and customer success narratives that demonstrate the power of Cloud Air's platforms.

  • Accelerate Customer Growth: Partner closely with GTM, Product, and Sales Engineering teams to identify emerging enterprise growth opportunities and create pipeline-generating campaigns powered by partner integrations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • The AI & Ecosystem Mindset: Deep understanding of the Generative AI ecosystem, with exposure to multi-agent frameworks, LLM orchestration, and how partners integrate with enterprise platform architectures.

  • Elite Storytelling & Communication: Exceptional ability to craft compelling narrative arcs, presenting complex AI technical architectures and prompt designs as clear, business-impacting value propositions.

  • Workshop Facilitation & Engagement: Proven track record of commanding a room, leading highly collaborative, unstructured brainstorming sessions or workshops with executive and technical stakeholders.

  • Entrepreneurial & High-Energy: A curious, self-starting professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about defining the next era of enterprise AI marketing.

Preferred Experience

  • 4–7+ years of professional experience split between Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, or GTM Strategy, and a highly technical, customer-facing role (e.g., Solution Architecture or Sales Engineering) at an AI or SaaS enterprise platform.

  • Direct experience developing marketing campaigns or hosting enablement programs centered on multi-agent orchestration frameworks, cloud infrastructure, or advanced data analytics.

  • Proven success in driving customer growth and scaling enterprise software adoption through robust partner ecosystems.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field; an MBA or advanced technical background is a strong plus.

title: Tier III O&M Network Engineer
description:
The Digital Modernization Sector at Leidos has an opening for a Tier III Network operations and maintenance (O&M) engineer to support the customer’s various WAN and LAN networks. Will provide incident resolution, routing changes, firewall changes; act as subject matter expert in WAN and LAN technologies; support customer’s intra- and inter- net and other data communications systems or segments of networked system.

Description of Job Duties/Responsibilities:

• Support operations and maintenance activities and administer networks including LAN and WAN technologies such as OSPF, BGP, VRF’s, VLAN’s, VRRP, MPLS.
• Monitor the performance of systems and networks
• Configure, and test hardware, networking software and operating system software
• Review user requests for upgrades or additions to the network to assess impact on network performance and provide advice and guidance on the most practical technical approach to meeting user requirements
• Perform long term O&M activities to include tier 3 troubleshooting and problem resolution
• Prepare troubleshooting procedures for restoring the network to optimal performance levels
• Provide fault management for the network and supports performance management functions
• Respond, isolate, and resolve network troubles
• Execute reporting functions and data input associated with network management
• Coordinate with configuration management and implementation teams
• Analyze network characteristics (e.g., traffic, connect time, transmission speeds, packet sizes, and throughput); recommend procurement, removals, and modifications to network components
• Optimize network topologies and site configurations.
• Coordinate requirements with users
• Assess and document current site network configuration and user requirements
• Maintain operating systems, communications software, data base packages, compilers, assemblers, and utility programs
• Apply software, hardware, and standards information technology skills in the analysis, specification, development, integration, and acquisition of open systems for Information Management (IM) applications
• Ensure these systems and applications are compliant with standards for open systems architectures, reference models, and profiles of standards - such as the IEEE Open Systems Environment (OSE) reference model - as they apply to the implementation and specification of IM solutions on the application platform, across the application program interface (API), and the external environment/software application
• May have up to 10% COMSEC responsibilities, as needed.
• Subject to be called in during afterhours for incident resolution.

Basic Qualifications:
• TS SCI CI Poly
• Candidate must have 16 years of experience that can be a combination of work history and education. This equates to a Doctorate and 8 years, master’s and 10 years, bachelor’s and 12 years, associates and 14 years or HS diploma and 16 years.
• Must comply with DoD 8570 Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level 2.
• Experience in configuring and troubleshooting boundary protection technologies such as Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, and Forcepoint appliances
• Experience with configuring and troubleshooting Juniper and Cisco routers and switches.
• Experience with protocols such as OSPF, BGP, VPN’s, VRF’s, MPLS.
• Working knowledge of boundary protection best practices
• Understanding of routing, switching, Internet Protocol (IP) subnet, Network Address Translation (NAT) and security technologies
• Demonstrated ability to engineer and modify rulesets to allow connectivity for new customer requirements
• Demonstrated ability to read, understand, and develop schematic diagrams, technical manuals, and documentation such that the supported equipment and software can be maintained with minimal training
• Working knowledge of Service Now or similar IT Service Management (ITSM) products
• Superior verbal and written communication skills

Job Summary:

Under supervision and in collaboration with other health care professionals, assist in performing a variety of nursing care services for patients.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Receives patient care assignment from the registered nurse (RN) in charge. Initiates delegated tasks based on demonstrated competence in performing nursing activities for specific patient age group served.
  • Collects and documents data for the admission assessment, reassessment and/or scheduling appointments or surgeries at specific times for patient population. May document and provide appropriate data to the RN and/or LPN for analysis and validation of patient’s response to care or treatment and when significant change occurs in the patient’s condition.
  • Informs licensed nurse of any changes in patient condition/needs, of patient complaints, and of patient/significant other educational needs.
  • Stocks and maintains supplies and equipment in keeping with patient care needs and cost containment. Utilizes time and supplies economically and conscientiously.

  • In an inpatient environment, responsibilities may also include the following: answers patients’ calls for help, takes their vital signs, and monitors their behavior and physical condition for progress or deterioration. Assists with baths, ambulating, feeding, skin care, personal and oral hygiene and making occupied and unoccupied beds. Performs dressing changes, enemas, ostomy care, toileting, turning, cough and deep breathing, catheter care, collection of biological specimens, measuring and recording intake and output of fluids.
  • In an inpatient environment, prepares patients for discharge and accompanies them upon dismissal as indicated. Orients new patients and significant others to the nursing unit.
  • In an outpatient environment, manages referrals for medical and surgical specialist appointments. Provides assistance in patient care to patients three years of age or older.

We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

What do our Pest Control Technicians do?

The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for residential customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from residential properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Conduct thorough inspections of client properties to identify signs of pest infestations, damage, and entry points

  • Apply approved pest control products, including chemicals, baits, and traps, to effectively eliminate pests while adhering to safety standards

  • Educate customers on pest prevention methods and the importance of maintaining a pest-free environment. Provide advice on how to reduce the risk of future infestations.

  • Build relationships with customers, schedule and confirm their appointments, help with sales to current customers, and expand our product to new customers

  • Ensure that all pest control equipment is properly maintained, stocked, and in good working condition

  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding pest control products and safety protocols

  • Drive and safely operate a company provided service vehicle (we provide routine maintenance)

Essential Job Functions:

  • Working in tight, confined spaces such as basements, attics, crawl spaces, narrow aisles, or passageways

  • Working around animals, insects and termites

  • You’ll sometimes be working around mechanical parts, vehicles, electrical current, heights and scaffolding, fumes, dust, and chemicals, and we’ll train you how to handle all of these conditions safely

  • Able to work both inside and outside in your local climate in company-provided weather gear

  • Lots of moving around — regularly sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, up and down stairs, ladders, scaffolding, ramps, and poles

  • You’ll need to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), like an OSHA-compliant respirator

  • Clean shaven face- for safety reasons (rebreathers have to be able to seal your face)

  • Possess a valid driver’s license from state of residence.

  • Licenses/certificates as required by federal, state, and/or local regulations (covered by us)

  • Available to work Monday-Friday and weekends as needed

  • Open to learning and becoming knowledgeable in all areas of pest control

  • Solid reading, writing, and verbal communication skills

  • Basic math skills — You’ll need to be able to follow instructions for mixing on product labels

  • Customer-facing experience preferred

Job Description:

GDIT is looking for a Senior Cloud Solutions Engineer to join our National Institutes of Health (NIH) CIT Hosting and Storage Services Program.

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused cloud engineer to design and deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions for customers whose requirements extend beyond our standard cloud infrastructure and platform offerings. Our ideal candidate combines broad AWS and Azure expertise with an understanding of application architecture, infrastructure, security, networking, identity, automation, and modern DevOps practices.

As a member of our Cloud DevOps team, this engineer will work directly with customers to understand business, application, data, and scientific requirements and translate them into well-designed cloud solutions. They will take ownership of solutions from discovery and architecture through engineering and delivery, leveraging standard platform capabilities where appropriate while developing custom Infrastructure as Code, automation, and integrations where needed. The successful candidate will bring strong technical judgment, consider the downstream impacts and tradeoffs of design decisions, and operate as a trusted technical consultant to customers throughout their cloud journey.

● Location: Remote working candidates will be considered; however the preference is for candidates to go onsite to Bethesda, MD 3 days out of the week. If you're within 60 miles of customer site, we would look for you to go onsite, as needed.

This role will require you to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and will require you to provide onsite fingerprinting at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner directly with customers to discover and document business, application, data, security, and technical requirements and translate them into cloud architectures and actionable engineering plans.

  • Design and implement custom solutions in AWS and Azure for application and data hosting, including scientific and research platforms such as REDCap, Posit, and other specialized workloads that do not align with standard IaaS or PaaS offerings.

  • Engineer end-to-end cloud solutions incorporating compute, storage, databases, networking, identity and access management, security, monitoring, backup/recovery, application architecture, and other required cloud services.

  • Develop and maintain Terraform modules, configuration, scripts, and automation required to provision and manage custom solutions, leveraging standard reusable services and patterns wherever practical.

  • Design and integrate DevOps and CI/CD capabilities that support application deployment, infrastructure delivery, security scanning, testing, monitoring, and ongoing lifecycle management.

  • Apply sound engineering judgment and second-order thinking to evaluate technical alternatives, dependencies, security risks, operational impacts, scalability, maintainability, and long-term consequences when recommending solutions.

  • Independently drive assigned solutions through delivery while collaborating within an Agile Cloud DevOps team, participating in sprint planning, technical design and code reviews, and coordinating with security, infrastructure, application, and other engineering teams as needed.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/BA and 8+ years of relevant IT experience, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong hands-on AWS and Azure experience across compute, storage, databases, networking, identity, security, monitoring, and related cloud services.

  • Experience designing and implementing cloud solutions for applications and data, with knowledge of application architectures, availability, scalability, resiliency, security, and lifecycle requirements.

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, including developing custom modules, leveraging reusable modules, and working within shared Git-based code repositories.

  • Experience with cloud networking, identity and access management, security, and DevOps/CI/CD practices, including automated infrastructure and application deployment, testing, security scanning, and monitoring.

  • Experience independently owning technical solutions from requirements gathering and architecture through implementation, troubleshooting, documentation, and transition to operations.

  • Strong consulting, communication, and analytical skills, with experience engaging customers, translating requirements into technical architectures, evaluating tradeoffs and downstream impacts, and delivering solutions within an Agile sprint-based environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience architecting and supporting scientific, research, healthcare, or data-intensive applications in the cloud, including platforms such as REDCap, Posit, or comparable research technologies.

  • Experience with containerized and cloud-native architectures, managed cloud services, application modernization, cloud migrations, and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.

  • Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, Terraform, DevOps, or architecture certifications and experience supporting federal government, healthcare, life sciences, or similarly regulated environments.

title: Lead Technical Business Analyst
description:
Data Collections Development APAC comprises several teams who are responsible for the development of real-time systems that collect data from stock exchanges in Asia and Pacific; this data is critical to hundreds of thousands of customers around the globe. The group delivers over 1500 requests bundled into 500+ software releases each year to support the constant changes demanded by both customers and exchanges alike.

The Lead Technical Business Analyst Position entails managing multiple projects & resources with shifting priorities in a real-time environment. Lead Technical Business Analysts are both the market data/logic experts for assigned feeds and a backup for the team manager who assists with overall squad management. They gather and document business and technical data-related requirements for internally developed data processing software applications. They are also responsible for testing the data/market logic accuracy of those software applications and supporting them through the release cycle into production environment. The Lead Technical Business Analyst would also assist with tracking progress of other projects within the team, providing guidance to team members, and likely take on additional non-project responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Work Oversight: Monitoring exchange notifications and enhancement requests. Escalating & Articulating all changes requiring action and initiating plans of action. Potentially serving as a backup for multiple venues – ensuring notifications aren’t missed & impacts are assessed in a timely manner.
  • Liaison: Liaising with Stock Exchanges, Project and Delivery Managers, Business Sponsors, Internal and External Clients, Software Developers, etc. to manage demand for new work. Establishing successful and results-oriented working relationships with a diverse set of personalities.
  • Project Oversight: Attending and contributing in status meetings. Assist squad members with scope, requirements, and testing guidance/oversight. Attending meetings where not serving as project BA – just providing support/guidance. Assisting with squad management as needed to track progress and keep work progressing.
  • Documentation: Documenting business and technical requirements for software developers, support staff, internal and external clients, etc. Documenting test cases and results. Documentation by a Lead BA should be the gold standard – can serve as an example to others.
  • Service: Providing Production Support teams with troubleshooting/analysis of service disruptions. Takes responsibility to ensure that issues are addressed/resolved even when the primary BA isn’t available.
  • Participation: Contributing to cross-departmental meetings and cross-train with other team members. Work as a team to document, track, and produce reports for all projects pertinent to the group. General expectation for Lead BAs to take on some responsibility or effort outside of venue delivery projects.
  • Transparency: Providing regular feedback regarding changes in scope, roadblocks, concerns, etc. that may impact clients & deliverables.
  • Process Improvement: Producing and deploying new ideas on improving method-of-work within the Business Analyst space and beyond.
  • Training: Assist with training/mentoring new staff.
  • Agility: A level of BA expertise that allows for taking on virtually any project in any team/venue sector with little assistance or supervision.
  • Continuous Improvement & Automation Support: Provide strategic and tactical feedback on process improvement and automation initiatives, ensuring alignment with business goals and operational feasibility.
  • Establish clear ownership and accountability structures to ensure sustained adoption and maintenance of implemented processes.
  • Actively support the piloting and deployment phases of new solutions, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth transitions and minimal disruption.

Preferred Skills

  • Exceptional requirements gathering and documentation ability
  • High attention to detail concerning data, testing, and analysis
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and decision-making abilities
  • Computer and data input skills
  • Knowledge of project management and systems analysis methodologies
  • 5+ years Technical Business Analyst experience
  • Management experience or aptitude for mentoring and development of talent
  • Experience with process improvement (Lean, Six Sigma) and project management (Agile, Scrum).
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and data analysis skills (Excel, Power BI, or similar).

Desired Skills

  • Interest in worldwide financial markets.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with shifting priorities in a real-time environment.
  • Must grasp concepts quickly. Aptitude and interest in technical concepts essential.
  • Self-motivated and the capability to work without supervision.
  • A wide degree of creativity, latitude, and patience is expected.
  • Knowledge of Finance industry.
  • Experience with production systems.
  • Experience in a high volume, real-time transaction-based environment.
  • Experience in an agile work environment.
  • Quick and effective risk-based decision-making
  • Familiarity with automation tools and basic scripting.
  • Knowledge of change management, user experience, and documentation best practices.

title: Practice Engineer - API
description:
The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the international organization for public-private cooperation.

The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.

Why we are recruiting

The Forum is building world-leading digital collaboration platforms, knowledge and data tools, and digital event experiences for our constituents. As part of the evolution of our engineering operating model, durable product teams own delivery while horizontal practices safeguard the craft. We are looking for a Practice Engineer to lead the API platform practice across product streams: setting the standards and staying hands-on in real engineering work.

In this model, the principle earns its authority through artefacts — standards and paved paths. You will be the steward of architectural coherence and engineering excellence for your platform across all product teams.

Reporting Lines & Interactions

Part of the Forum IT Team, the Practice Engineer reports to the Head of Engineering. You will work across product teams in partnership with Engineering Managers — coaching engineers through weekly office hours, code reviews and RFC reviews — and sit on hiring loops as the technical-bar interviewer. You will also collaborate with the IT Systems & IT Security teams on infrastructure stability and security, and with fellow Practice Engineers in the architecture council.

The successful candidate will be assessed on

  • Author and maintain platform craft standards — a set of specific, actionable guidelines — and maintain architectural coherence across product teams. Write paved paths and skills that enable engineers and agents to build compliant applications by default.
  • Own API design standards (REST/GraphQL/Event-Driven), the OpenAPI documentation process, versioning and deprecation policy, the API gateway setup and the service catalog.
  • Surface and drive resolution of cross-cutting technical debt across product streams.
  • Run platform rituals: weekly office hours, technical demos, and RFC reviews; coach engineers across teams through the craft line.
  • Serve as the technical-bar interviewer on hiring loops, partnering with Engineering Managers who lead hiring.
  • Own the deployment processes and CI/CD tooling that support product teams, document infrastructure specifications, and collaborate with the IT & ITS teams to ensure stability and security.

Requirements

  • University-level education in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience with deep expertise in API management and a track record of shipping and operating products at scale.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical standards, leading architecture decisions, and driving their adoption across multiple teams through influence rather than authority.
  • Deep command of API design and governance — REST plus at least one of GraphQL, gRPC, or event-driven; OpenAPI/schema-first design; and clear versioning, deprecation, and governance practices applied across teams.
  • Strong command of at least one major API/web development language and framework — such as Node.js, Python, Ruby on Rails, or Go — with the breadth to read, review, and contribute across related product engineering domains.
  • Familiar with modern infrastructure, CI/CD tooling and deployment processes, with a working knowledge of security and stability practices.
  • Practical experience with agent-assisted (AI-assisted) development and building paved paths, templates or tooling that other engineers (and agents) build on.
  • Experience interviewing and holding the technical bar in engineering hiring.
  • Fluency in English, with excellent written, digital, and verbal communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a complex, international organization.

Why join us?


Join an independent and impartial organization with over 55 years of connecting leaders to make sense of global challenges and move the world forward together.

title: Head of Strategy

This role requires a visionary leader with a strong track record in corporate strategy, investment management, and business transformation, particularly within the Nigerian context. title: Principal Business Strategist – Digital
description:
Candidates who advance in the selection process may be asked to complete a time-limited case study and deliver a brief presentation via a panel interview process. The exercise is designed to assess strategic synthesis, executive storytelling, business judgment and cross-functional thinking.


Role Overview

The Principal Business Strategist for AT&T Digital is responsible for supporting the Director–Chief of Staff and Head of Digital in articulating and communicating AT&T Digital’s business strategy through compelling executive storytelling and disciplined strategic execution.


This role will synthesize strategic priorities, transformation initiatives and business performance into clear, cohesive narratives for AT&T’s senior leadership team, Board of Directors and other executive audiences. The strategist will work across Digital and its key partners to connect complex information, align executive communications with established KPIs and translate leadership direction into coordinated action.


This role will serve as a senior strategic resource responsible for the quality, consistency and execution of assigned strategic deliverables supporting the Head of Digital and Digital leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

- Support the articulation and communication of AT&T Digital’s business strategy by developing clear, compelling narratives for senior executive and Board-level audiences.

- Coordinate executive presentations, business reviews and strategic updates, ensuring messaging is concise, consistent and aligned with leadership direction, Digital priorities and AT&T’s broader business objectives.

- Synthesize complex business, customer, operational, financial and technology information into executive-level insights, recommendations and decision-ready materials.

- Connect Digital’s initiatives and transformation progress to established KPIs, customer outcomes and business performance, clearly communicating results, risks, dependencies and opportunities.

- Partner with Digital leaders and subject-matter experts to integrate cross-functional inputs into a cohesive view of the organization’s strategy and execution.

- Support and project-manage priority initiatives as directed by the Director–Chief of Staff, establishing clear deliverables, milestones, owners and success measures while tracking progress and executive commitments.

- Surface emerging themes, gaps and matters requiring leadership attention, providing insights and recommendations to help inform decisions and strengthen execution.

- Build alignment and accountability across Digital and its enterprise partners by facilitating collaboration and influencing teams without direct authority.

- Maintain high standards for message clarity, data integrity, presentation quality and confidentiality.

Required Skills

- Exceptional executive storytelling, business-writing and presentation-development skills.

- Strong strategic thinking, critical-thinking and problem-solving capabilities in a highly complex and matrix organization.

- Ability to synthesize complex or incomplete information into clear insights, implications and recommendations.

- Strong understanding of KPIs and their connection to strategic priorities, customer outcomes and business performance.

- Executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Strong program and project-management skills, with disciplined attention to priorities, milestones, risks and follow-through.

- Ability to influence and create alignment across teams without direct authority.

- Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work within accelerated timelines.

Preferred Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in business, strategy, eCommerce, finance, technology or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

- Significant experience in business strategy, strategic planning, management consulting, or corporate transformation organization.

- Demonstrated success developing strategic narratives and presentations for senior executives, Boards of Directors or other high-level stakeholders.

- Experience supporting complex digital, customer-experience, omnichannel or enterprise transformation initiatives and connecting strategic priorities to measurable business, financial and customer outcomes.

- Strong understanding of digital customer journeys, product development, sales and service channels, operations or technology organizations.

- Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional work and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

- Telecommunications, media, technology or a similarly complex industry background preferred.

title: Hardware Systems Engineer
description:
The Air Traffic Management Sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Hardware Systems Engineer to work in our Gaithersburg, MD office. This is an exciting opportunity to be a member of a dynamic team working on the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) En-Route Automation Modernization (ERAM) technology, which is the heart of the national air transportation system. ERAM provides the foundational platform for the National Airspace System (NAS) to monitor and manage high-altitude aircraft, increasing flight efficiency, safety, and capacity.

Primary Responsibilities

• Create and update Computer Aided Design (CAD) drawings, Microsoft Visio drawings, Cable Marking Specifications, Retrofit and Workbook Installation Instructions, System Bills of Material (BOMs) and Parts Lists, and support Computer Rack and Operator Console builds.

• Participate in the Systems Engineering (SE) hardware design lifecycle including research, development, technical analyses, cost estimates, process improvements, and technical support to meet program objectives.

• Develop hardware designs, electrical wiring diagrams, cable schematics, interconnect diagrams, and cable lists for system installation and integration activities.

• Support hardware fabrication, assembly, integration, testing, troubleshooting, repair, and modification activities using standard engineering principles and diagnostic tools.

• Collaborate with vendors, suppliers, and cross-functional teams including Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Site Activation, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Program Management to support system implementation and integration.

• Develop and maintain engineering drawings, source control drawings, system specifications, verification procedures, and other technical documentation.

• Support requirements analysis, project planning, schedules, status reporting, and technical execution activities based on Statements of Work (SOWs).

• Support engineering change activities including Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), discrepancy resolution, and configuration management processes.

• Apply engineering concepts and technical problem-solving skills independently while working effectively within a multi-disciplinary team environment.

• Support occasional extended work hours or off-shift activities as required to meet integration, testing, or deployment schedules. Deployment schedules may require some travel between 25%-50%.

• Demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced technical environment.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline and 2 – 4 years of prior relevant experience, or Master’s degree with less than 2 years of relevant experience.

• Experience supporting Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), configuration management, or formal design change processes.

• Experience supporting hardware engineering activities such as system integration, hardware documentation, cable design, CAD modeling, testing, or technical troubleshooting.

• Experience supporting hardware integration, installation, and troubleshooting activities in a lab or production environment.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Word and Visio.

• Ability to work independently on moderately complex technical assignments with general supervision.

• Experience communicating technical concepts, analysis results, and engineering solutions to peers, program stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Proficiency with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Inventor, VISIO, or other CAD software tools.

• Proficiency designing parts and assemblies using 3D modeling software.

• Experience with Artificial Intelligence (AI) and/or Machine Learning (ML) technologies.

• Experience utilizing automation methods or scripting techniques to improve technical documentation or engineering workflows.

• Experience working in one or more of the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) facilities including Continental United States (CONUS) Air Route Traffic Control Centers (ARTCCs), the FAA William J. Hughes Technical Center (WJHTC), or the FAA Air Traffic Controller Academy (FAAAC).

Additional Requirements

• Candidates must have the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

In the role of Senior AI Agent Engineer in the Engineering Excellence team within Software Solutions, you will contribute to our purpose of Bringing People Closer. The Team you will be part of:

We explore how work happens across the software organisation, identify where automation adds value and where human judgement remains essential, and build practical solutions ourselves. Job Description:

GDIT is your place. You make it your own by bringing your ideas and unique perspective to our culture. By owning your opportunity at GDIT, you are helping us ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. We are seeking a Cloud Application Engineer to join our team supporting the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID).

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Cloud Application Engineer, you will help run and modernize the hosting platform behind NIAID's scientific and business applications — a hybrid estate spanning AWS and Windows, supporting research into infectious and immunologic disease. You will define infrastructure in Terraform rather than in tickets, ship it through GitHub, and instrument what you build so the team knows something is wrong before a researcher does. You will also help move the remaining on-prem Windows workloads into AWS and improve them once they land. We will want your opinion on operational processes, deployment patterns, tooling, and where the platform should go next. A focus on always-up, always-available applications is a plus.

In this role, a typical day will include the following:

  • Deploying, hardening, and troubleshooting Windows applications on Windows Server and IIS — including .NET workloads, TLS certificate lifecycle, vulnerability remediation, and performance tuning.
  • Administering SQL Server databases across on-prem instances and Amazon RDS, including migrations, performance tuning, and backup and recovery.
  • Defining AWS infrastructure as code in Terraform — writing modules, managing state, and building reusable patterns other teams can adopt.
  • Building and maintaining deployment pipelines in GitHub Actions and AWS CodeBuild so that changes are reviewable, repeatable, and safe to ship.
  • Fronting applications with AWS load balancing and web application firewall services — building target groups and health checks, and writing WAF rules that protect the application without breaking it.
  • Instrumenting the platform: dashboards, service level objectives, and alerts that surface real degradation instead of noise, and retiring the alerts that do not.
  • Migrating and modernizing Windows applications as they move from on-prem infrastructure to AWS, refactoring architecture where it makes sense along the way.
  • Working closely with application owners and software engineers to identify requirements, plan, and implement projects — installing new custom applications with web services, database components, data hosting, and load balancing.

  • Monitoring application health and responding to alerts such as service down, failed backup, slow response time, or full file systems.
  • Documenting day-to-day administrative processes and configuration information for the applications we support.
  • Occasionally presenting to your team or our software developer colleagues on DevOps and cloud practices, new technologies, and how you approached and solved challenging technical problems.
  • After hours and weekend work may occasionally be required for pre-planned maintenance or for troubleshooting service-impacting outages.

*This is a remote position. However, candidate must be local and/or able to come onsite once a week in Rockville, MD*

Required Skills:

  • BA/BS or equivalent and six to eight years of related experience, including a minimum of three years hands-on with AWS.
  • Minimum of three years hands-on AWS experience across commonly used services — IAM, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, Route 53, SSM, and CloudTrail — including designing and operating production workloads.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring Terraform from scratch — modules, remote state, and lifecycle management — not solely modifying existing configurations.
  • Minimum of five years hands-on experience deploying, configuring, hardening, and troubleshooting applications on Windows Server 2019, 2022, or 2025 and IIS v8.5 and v10, including .NET 8 and .NET 9 workloads.
  • Strong experience administering Microsoft SQL Server (2017, 2019, 2022, or 2025) and Amazon RDS for SQL Server, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, and migration between the two.
  • Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or AWS CodeBuild, with Git-based branching and pull request workflows as the default way of working.
  • Strong scripting experience with PowerShell, plus Python or Bash.
  • Working knowledge of observability and site reliability practices — metrics, logs, traces, service level objectives, and alerting — using a platform such as Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent.
  • Experience creating, applying, and troubleshooting TLS or SSL certificates for web servers such as IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or nginx, and managing certificates through AWS Certificate Manager.
  • Experience analyzing solution components, understanding systems integration challenges, and identifying technology gaps that must be resolved to reach future performance and functionality targets.
  • Able to clearly present ideas to both technical and non-technical users and staff to further the adoption of cloud and DevOps practices.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an NIH Public Trust security clearance.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with AWS edge and traffic services — Application and Network Load Balancers, AWS WAF, CloudFront, and Route 53 routing policies.
  • Experience migrating and modernizing Windows-based applications on AWS — moving IIS, .NET, and SQL Server workloads off legacy infrastructure and improving them once they land.
  • Experience building the automation others depend on: reusable Terraform modules, pipeline tooling, automated validation and drift detection, and self-service capabilities that let application owners handle routine tasks independently.
  • Experience breaking down monolithic applications into containers and running them on AWS ECS.
  • Experience managing secrets and credential lifecycle using AWS Secrets Manager or Parameter Store, including automated rotation of service accounts and certificates.
  • Experience with fleet configuration and patch automation at scale using SSM State Manager and Patch Manager, or PowerShell DSC.
  • Familiarity with application-level resilience and availability patterns — health checks, graceful degradation, multi-AZ deployment, and recovery testing.
  • Experience with access and authentication technologies such as LDAP, SAML, or Kerberos.
  • Current AWS certification — Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or DevOps Engineer.
  • Depth in Datadog or mature site reliability practice — service level objective design, error budgets, and incident response and postmortem process.
  • Familiarity with AI and large language model workflows using Amazon Bedrock or Amazon Q / Amazon Quick, and interest in applying them to operational and documentation work.

description:

Qualifications:

• B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science or Engineering

• 8+ years of proven experience

Skills and Experience:

  • Proven experience operating as a Senior Engineer or Team Lead, defining and owning technical direction across initiatives with Agile Practices such as Lean or Scaled Agile.

  • A proven foundation in modern languages such Core Java and UI technologies such as React & Angular.

  • Demonstrated ability to act as a work definer at scale: shaping ambiguous problem spaces into well-structured initiatives, clear architectural runways, and executable delivery plans.

  • Strong background designing enterprise scale, distributed systems, balancing functional requirements with non-functional concerns such as resiliency, scalability, latency, and operability.

Hand-on experience with AI enabled SDLC / PDLC practices, including:

  • Using AI to accelerate design exploration, prototyping, and architectural decision making

  • Applying AI assisted development, testing, code review, and documentation practices

  • Frameworks such as Windsurf & Cursor and GitHub Copilot

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to articulate complex architectural concepts to senior stakeholders and align diverse teams behind a shared technical vision.

  • Track record at articulating architectural tradeoffs and design options, including impacts on scalability, resilience, cost, and delivery velocity.

  • Strong architectural governance skills: setting standards, guiding design reviews, managing technical debt, and ensuring long term platform sustainability.

  • Experience of API design principles & Event Driven Architecture.

  • Rigorous approach to quality through demonstrable TDD & BDD experience.

Nice to have and opportunities to learn:

  • Expertise in Domain Driven Design (DDD), including domain modelling and aligning architecture to complex business domains.

  • Front office Portfolio Management or Wealth Management domain experience, with a strong understanding of investment workflows, decision making processes, and the role of technology in supporting portfolio managers and advisors.

  • Domain knowledge of asset classes & analytics (e.g., equities, fixed income, multi asset, alternatives) and how their characteristics influence risk, performance, liquidity, and system design.

  • Experience with portfolio construction concepts, including asset allocation, constraints, benchmarks, rebalancing, and optimization, and how these map to scalable platform and architecture decisions.

  • Exposure to event-driven architectures at scale, including microservices, messaging, and streaming platforms aligned to business domains.

  • Experience shaping or contributing to platform strategies that enable multiple product teams to move faster with consistency and autonomy.

  • Familiarity with cloud native and hybrid architectures, including patterns for scalability, resilience, and cost aware design in large enterprises – including frameworks like Kubernetes.

  • Exposure to modern DevOps and platform engineering practices that support high throughput, high quality delivery at enterprise scale, and demonstrable improvements across DORA metrics.

  • Familiarity with micro frontend architectures, including their use in large scale, multi team environments to enable independent domain ownership, parallel delivery, and consistent user experiences across complex platform

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

title: Systems Administrator - Network Information Center
description:
Leidos' Chief Information Office (CIO), reporting through the Digital sector, is seeking a highly motivated Systems Administrator to join the Network Information Center (NIC) within our Data Center Network Solutions (DCNS).

The NIC is a small team that owns critical enterprise services including Enterprise DNS, IP Address Management (IPAM), F5 Load Balancing, enterprise UPS management, carrier circuit lifecycle management, and supporting platforms that enable secure, reliable connectivity across the company. This role supports more than 4,000 network-connected infrastructure devices and over 750 WAN circuits while partnering closely with Network Operations, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Applications, Authentication Engineering, Access Engineering, Risk Management, and external vendors. The ideal candidate is a technically curious, detail-oriented professional with strong troubleshooting skills, an ownership mindset, and the ability to support mission-critical enterprise infrastructure while collaborating across multiple engineering and operations teams.

Location: This position allows for 100% telework from any U.S. based location; it is preferred that you are able to support U.S. Pacific Time Zone hours.

Citizenship: This position requires U.S. Citizenship.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Configure, deploy, maintain, and monitor enterprise infrastructure devices

  • Administer Enterprise DNS, IPAM, DHCP reservations, IP allocation, subnet management, DNS forwarding, and namespace administration.

  • Support F5 BIG-IP, pools, SSL certificates, VIP lifecycle management.

  • Design, deploy, monitor, and maintain enterprise UPS solutions including firmware, monitoring, capacity planning, vulnerability remediation, and BOM development.

  • Manage lifecycle of WAN circuits including MPLS, Metro Ethernet, DIA, Broadband, DSL, T1, DS3, and related carrier technologies.

  • Troubleshoot enterprise LAN/WAN issues.

  • Deploy production network changes using Python/PowerShell automations.

  • Develop SOPs, improve operational processes, support automation initiatives, and maintain operational documentation.

  • Work closely with the Corporate NOC, Network Engineering, Access Engineering, Network Security, Authentication Engineering, Enterprise Applications, Risk Management, business units, telecommunications carriers, and vendors.

Basic Qualifications.

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field coupled with 2 years of relevant experience; equivalent relevant experience and/or industry certifications (CCNA, F5, Network+, etc.) may be considered in lieu of degree.

  • Experience administering enterprise networking environments.

  • Experience supporting Cisco routing and switching.

  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, routing, switching, VLANs, ACLs

  • Experience managing WAN carrier circuits.

  • Experience with enterprise monitoring and syslog.

  • Experience in data center environments with structured cabling and power

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications /Experience:

Hours: Able to support Pacific Time zone hours.

Technology & Certs: F5 BIG-IP, BlueCat IPAM, Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, Digi Console Servers, CyberPower, APC, Aruba EdgeConnect, Riverbed, Aruba Wireless, SolarWinds, Splunk, Python/PowerShell automation, ITIL, and relevant certifications such as CCNA, F5, or Network+.

Would you like to join a truly international, talent driven company that values Safety, Ethics, Quality, Innovation and Employee Opportunity?

Otis is growing and is looking for a Quality Inspection Technician for our Malaysian market. Your priority is to fulfill all of the duties as prescribed under the Occupational Safety And Health (PLANT REQUIRING CERTIFICATE OF FITNESS) Regulation 2024 and as below.

Responsibilities
